articles.title: 书上的白色小狗
articles.summary: 小林在学校图书馆找到一本有白色小狗的书，并把书借回家和妹妹一起看。
articles.topic: 书上的白色小狗
paragraphs: 星期一上午，小林去学校图书馆看书。他想找一本小狗的书，可是桌上没有。
王老师问他要什么书。小林说：“我想看有小狗的书。”王老师从桌子下面拿出一本书，说：“这本书可以借回家。”
小林很高兴。他下午和妹妹一起看这本书。妹妹说：“书上的白色小狗真可爱！”
pinyin: xīng qī yī shàng wǔ ， xiǎo lín qù xué xiào tú shū guǎn kàn shū 。 tā xiǎng zhǎo yī běn xiǎo gǒu de shū ， kě shì zhuō shàng méi yǒu 。
wáng lǎo shī wèn tā yào shén me shū 。 xiǎo lín shuō ：“ wǒ xiǎng kàn yǒu xiǎo gǒu de shū 。” wáng lǎo shī cóng zhuō zi xià miàn ná chū yī běn shū ， shuō ：“ zhè běn shū kě yǐ jiè huí jiā 。”
xiǎo lín hěn gāo xìng 。 tā xià wǔ hé mèi mèi yì qǐ kàn zhè běn shū 。 mèi mèi shuō ：“ shū shàng de bái sè xiǎo gǒu zhēn kě ài ！”
translation: On Monday morning, Xiaolin went to the school library to read. He wanted to find a book about a puppy, but there was none on the table.

Teacher Wang asked him what book he wanted. Xiaolin said, “I want to read a book with a puppy in it.” Teacher Wang took a book from under the table and said, “You can borrow this book and take it home.”
Xiaolin was very happy. He read the book with his younger sister in the afternoon. His sister said, “The white puppy in the book is so cute!”

articles.title: 王月和妈妈去公园
articles.summary: 王月和妈妈去公园。她给水里的小鱼吃鱼食。鱼食没有了，她和妈妈一起回家。
articles.topic: 王月给公园里的小鱼喂食
paragraphs: 星期二上午，王月和妈妈一起去公园。公园里有很多人，还有一个大水池。水里有很多小鱼。
王月有一小包鱼食。她坐下来，给小鱼吃鱼食。小鱼游过来，吃了鱼食。王月看见小鱼吃东西，很高兴。
鱼食没有了，王月不喂小鱼了。妈妈说：“以后我们还来。”她们又看了看小鱼，然后一起回家了。
pinyin: xīng qī èr shàng wǔ ， wáng yuè hé mā mā yì qǐ qù gōng yuán 。 gōng yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén ， hái yǒu yí gè dà shuǐ chí 。 shuǐ lǐ yǒu hěn duō xiǎo yú 。
wáng yuè yǒu yī xiǎo bāo yú shí 。 tā zuò xià lái ， gěi xiǎo yú chī yú shí 。 xiǎo yú yóu guò lái ， chī le yú shí 。 wáng yuè kàn jiàn xiǎo yú chī dōng xī ， hěn gāo xìng 。
yú shí méi yǒu le ， wáng yuè bù wèi xiǎo yú le 。 mā mā shuō ：“ yǐ hòu wǒ men hái lái 。” tā men yòu kàn le kàn xiǎo yú ， rán hòu yì qǐ huí jiā le 。
translation: On Tuesday morning, Wang Yue went to the park with her mother. There were many people in the park and also a large pond. There were many small fish in the water.
Wang Yue had a small bag of fish food. She sat down and fed the small fish. The fish swam over and ate the fish food. Wang Yue was very happy to see the fish eating.
The fish food was gone, so Wang Yue stopped feeding the fish. Her mother said, “We will come again.” They looked at the fish again and then went home together.

articles.title: 两个苹果，一人一个
articles.summary: 李明和妈妈去商店买东西，并和妈妈一起吃苹果。
articles.topic: 两个苹果，一人一个
paragraphs: 今天上午，李明和妈妈去商店买东西。妈妈想买水和米，李明看见桌子上有很多苹果。
苹果有红的，也有大的。李明问：“这个红苹果多少钱？”店里的人说：“三块钱一个。”
李明买了两个红苹果。他和妈妈回家，他给妈妈一个，他吃一个。妈妈很高兴，说苹果很好吃。
pinyin: jīn tiān shàng wǔ ， lǐ míng hé mā mā qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī 。 mā mā xiǎng mǎi shuǐ hé mǐ ， lǐ míng kàn jiàn zhuō zi shàng yǒu hěn duō píng guǒ 。
píng guǒ yǒu hóng de ， yě yǒu dà de 。 lǐ míng wèn ：“ zhè ge hóng píng guǒ duō shǎo qián ？” diàn lǐ de rén shuō ：“ sān kuài qián yí gè 。”
lǐ míng mǎi le liǎng gè hóng píng guǒ 。 tā hé mā mā huí jiā ， tā gěi mā mā yí gè ， tā chī yí gè 。 mā mā hěn gāo xìng ， shuō píng guǒ hěn hǎo chī 。
translation: This morning, Li Ming and his mother went to the store to buy some things. His mother wanted to buy water and rice, and Li Ming saw many apples on a table.
There were red apples as well as big ones. Li Ming asked, “How much is this red apple?” The person in the store said, “Three yuan each.”
Li Ming bought two red apples. He went home with his mother, gave one to her, and ate the other one. His mother was very happy and said that the apple was delicious.

articles.title: 张丽帮老师拿书
articles.summary: 今天下午，张丽和王老师坐车回学校。到了学校，张丽帮王老师拿书。晚上，爸爸问张丽今天高兴不高兴，张丽和爸爸都很高兴。
articles.topic: 张丽帮老师拿书
paragraphs: 今天下午，爸爸给张丽打电话。爸爸问：“你在哪儿？”张丽说：“我在车上。我和王老师回学校。”
车到了学校。王老师有很多书。张丽说：“老师，我帮你拿书吧。”张丽拿了老师的书。她和老师走到学校里。王老师说：“谢谢你！”
张丽说：“不谢。”她坐车回家。晚上，爸爸问：“你今天高兴吗？”张丽说：“我很高兴。”爸爸也很高兴。
pinyin: jīn tiān xià wǔ ， bà bà gěi zhāng lì dǎ diàn huà 。 bà bà wèn ：“ nǐ zài nǎ ér ？” zhāng lì shuō ：“ wǒ zài chē shàng 。 wǒ hé wáng lǎo shī huí xué xiào 。”

chē dào le xué xiào 。 wáng lǎo shī yǒu hěn duō shū 。 zhāng lì shuō ：“ lǎo shī ， wǒ bāng nǐ ná shū ba 。” zhāng lì ná le lǎo shī de shū 。 tā hé lǎo shī zǒu dào xué xiào lǐ 。 wáng lǎo shī shuō ：“ xiè xiè nǐ ！”
zhāng lì shuō ：“ bù xiè 。” tā zuò chē huí jiā 。 wǎn shàng ， bà bà wèn ：“ nǐ jīn tiān gāo xìng ma ？” zhāng lì shuō ：“ wǒ hěn gāo xìng 。” bà bà yě hěn gāo xìng 。
translation: This afternoon, Dad called Zhang Li. Dad asked, “Where are you?” Zhang Li said, “I am in the car. Teacher Wang and I are going back to school.”

The car arrived at the school. Teacher Wang had many books. Zhang Li said, “Teacher, I’ll carry your books for you.” Zhang Li took the teacher’s books. She walked into the school with the teacher. Teacher Wang said, “Thank you!”
Zhang Li said, “You’re welcome.” She went home by car. In the evening, Dad asked, “Are you happy today?” Zhang Li said, “I am very happy.” Dad was happy too.

articles.title: 陈雨和李明去学校
articles.summary: 星期五，陈雨去车站接李明。他们一起吃饭、去学校、看学生踢球，最后回家喝茶。
articles.topic: 陈雨踢十分钟球后回家
paragraphs: 星期五上午，陈雨去车站接朋友李明。李明家在北京。他有一个小包。陈雨看见李明，很高兴。
中午，两个人在车站边的小饭店吃饭。他们吃米饭和菜。李明说：“我想去你的学校。”
学校里有很多学生。他们在踢球。陈雨也踢球，李明看他踢球。十分钟后，两个人一起回家喝茶。
pinyin: xīng qī wǔ shàng wǔ ， chén yǔ qù chē zhàn jiē péng yǒu lǐ míng 。 lǐ míng jiā zài běi jīng 。 tā yǒu yí gè xiǎo bāo 。 chén yǔ kàn jiàn lǐ míng ， hěn gāo xìng 。
zhōng wǔ ， liǎng gè rén zài chē zhàn biān de xiǎo fàn diàn chī fàn 。 tā men chī mǐ fàn hé cài 。 lǐ míng shuō ：“ wǒ xiǎng qù nǐ de xué xiào 。”
xué xiào lǐ yǒu hěn duō xué shēng 。 tā men zài tī qiú 。 chén yǔ yě tī qiú ， lǐ míng kàn tā tī qiú 。 shí fēn zhōng hòu ， liǎng gè rén yì qǐ huí jiā hē chá 。
translation: On Friday morning, Chen Yu went to the station to meet his friend Li Ming. Li Ming's home is in Beijing. He had a small bag. Chen Yu was very happy when he saw Li Ming.
At noon, the two of them ate at a small restaurant beside the station. They ate rice and vegetables. Li Ming said, "I want to go to your school."
There were many students at the school. They were playing soccer. Chen Yu played soccer too, and Li Ming watched him play. Ten minutes later, the two of them went home together and drank tea.

articles.title: 刘安给姐姐买水
articles.summary: 星期六，刘安和妈妈去商店。他喝了热茶，还给喜欢喝水的姐姐买了水。
articles.topic: 热茶和姐姐的水
paragraphs: 星期六上午，刘安和妈妈一起去商店。商店里有很多人。妈妈买了三个苹果，刘安也买了一些水果。
今天很冷。刘安想喝茶。他在商店里喝了一杯热茶。茶很热，刘安喝了茶，很高兴。
姐姐今天工作，不能和他们一起去。姐姐喜欢喝水。刘安给姐姐买了水。中午，他去姐姐那里，给姐姐水。
pinyin: xīng qī liù shàng wǔ ， liú ān hé mā mā yì qǐ qù shāng diàn 。 shāng diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén 。 mā mā mǎi le sān gè píng guǒ ， liú ān yě mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ 。
jīn tiān hěn lěng 。 liú ān xiǎng hē chá 。 tā zài shāng diàn lǐ hē le yī bēi rè chá 。 chá hěn rè ， liú ān hē le chá ， hěn gāo xìng 。
jiě jiě jīn tiān gōng zuò ， bù néng hé tā men yì qǐ qù 。 jiě jiě xǐ huān hē shuǐ 。 liú ān gěi jiě jiě mǎi le shuǐ 。 zhōng wǔ ， tā qù jiě jiě nà lǐ ， gěi jiě jiě shuǐ 。
translation: On Saturday morning, Liu An went to the store with his mother. There were many people in the store. His mother bought three apples, and Liu An also bought some fruit.
It was very cold today. Liu An wanted to drink tea. He drank a cup of hot tea in the store. The tea was hot, and Liu An was very happy after drinking it.
His older sister was working today and could not go with them. She liked drinking water. Liu An bought water for her. At noon, he went to where his sister was and gave her the water.

articles.title: 电影里的白猫
articles.summary: 赵新看电影时看到一只白猫，回家后画了猫给妈妈看。
articles.topic: 电影里的白猫
paragraphs: 今天上午，赵新去电影院看电影。他买了一张票和一杯水。电影十点开始，他先喝水，再看电影。
电影里有一个小女孩，她家有一只白猫。白猫喜欢在桌子下面睡觉，也喜欢和女孩一起玩。赵新看见它，就笑了。
看完电影，赵新很高兴。他回家画了一只白猫，又把画给妈妈看。妈妈说：“这只猫很漂亮，我也喜欢它。”

diàn yǐng lǐ yǒu yí gè xiǎo nǚ hái ， tā jiā yǒu yī zhī bái māo 。 bái māo xǐ huān zài zhuō zi xià miàn shuì jiào ， yě xǐ huān hé nǚ hái yì qǐ wán 。 zhào xīn kàn jiàn tā ， jiù xiào le 。

translation: This morning, Zhao Xin went to the movie theater to watch a movie. He bought a ticket and a cup of water. The movie started at ten. He drank some water first and then watched the movie.

articles.title: 孙华在书店买了一本汉语词典
articles.summary: 星期一下午，孙华在书店买了一本红色的汉语词典。晚上，她和丈夫一起看书、学新词。
articles.topic: 孙华在书店找到一本新词典
paragraphs: 星期一下午，孙华的丈夫给她打电话。他问：“你在哪儿？”孙华说：“我在学校旁边的书店。”
她想买一本汉语词典。书店里有很多词典。她看了三本。红色的那本很好，也不太贵。她买了那一本。
孙华也给丈夫买了一本小书。晚上她回家。两个人一起看书。他们学了五个新词，都很高兴。

tā xiǎng mǎi yī běn hàn yǔ cí diǎn 。 shū diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō cí diǎn 。 tā kàn le sān běn 。 hóng sè de nà běn hěn hǎo ， yě bù tài guì 。 tā mǎi le nà yī běn 。
sūn huá yě gěi zhàng fū mǎi le yī běn xiǎo shū 。 wǎn shàng tā huí jiā 。 liǎng gè rén yì qǐ kàn shū 。 tā men xué le wǔ gè xīn cí ， dōu hěn gāo xìng 。
translation: On Monday afternoon, Sun Hua's husband called her. He asked, "Where are you?" Sun Hua said, "I am at the bookstore next to the school."
She wanted to buy a Chinese dictionary. There were many dictionaries in the bookstore. She looked at three. The red one was good and not too expensive. She bought that one.
Sun Hua also bought a small book for her husband. She went home in the evening. The two of them read together. They learned five new words and were both very happy.

articles.title: 周平带甜橙去看朋友
articles.summary: 周平上午去邮局寄书，下午带着甜橙到医院看望朋友李月。
articles.topic: 周平带甜橙看朋友
paragraphs: 星期三上午，周平先去邮局寄一本书。出来以后，他给朋友李月打电话。李月说她在医院，下午可以回家。
周平买了六个甜橙，下午去医院看她。李月在喝水，看见周平很高兴。两个人一起吃橙子，也说了很多话。
晚上六点，李月的妈妈来了。周平和她们说再见，就坐车回家了。
pinyin: xīng qī sān shàng wǔ ， zhōu píng xiān qù yóu jú jì yī běn shū 。 chū lái yǐ hòu ， tā gěi péng yǒu lǐ yuè dǎ diàn huà 。 lǐ yuè shuō tā zài yī yuàn ， xià wǔ kě yǐ huí jiā 。
zhōu píng mǎi le liù gè tián chéng ， xià wǔ qù yī yuàn kàn tā 。 lǐ yuè zài hē shuǐ ， kàn jiàn zhōu píng hěn gāo xìng 。 liǎng gè rén yì qǐ chī chéng zi ， yě shuō le hěn duō huà 。
wǎn shàng liù diǎn ， lǐ yuè de mā mā lái le 。 zhōu píng hé tā men shuō zài jiàn ， jiù zuò chē huí jiā le 。
translation: On Wednesday morning, Zhou Ping first went to the post office to mail a book. After leaving, he called his friend Li Yue. Li Yue said that she was at the hospital and could go home in the afternoon.
Zhou Ping bought six sweet oranges and went to the hospital to see her in the afternoon. Li Yue was drinking water and was very happy to see Zhou Ping. They ate oranges together and talked a lot.
At six in the evening, Li Yue's mother arrived. Zhou Ping said goodbye to them and then went home by car.

articles.title: 吴芳和奶奶做面条
articles.summary: 星期六，吴芳第一次和奶奶一起做面条。她给奶奶一大碗，自己吃一小碗。
articles.topic: 吴芳做长面条
paragraphs: 星期六中午，吴芳去奶奶家。奶奶说：“今天我们吃面条。你和我一起做吧。”吴芳很高兴。
吴芳和奶奶一起做面条。她做了长面条，也做了短面条。这是吴芳第一次做面条。奶奶说：“很好！”
面条好了。吴芳给奶奶一大碗，吴芳吃一小碗。面条很好吃。吴芳说：“下个星期我还要做面条。”
pinyin: xīng qī liù zhōng wǔ ， wú fāng qù nǎi nǎi jiā 。 nǎi nǎi shuō ：“ jīn tiān wǒ men chī miàn tiáo 。 nǐ hé wǒ yì qǐ zuò ba 。” wú fāng hěn gāo xìng 。
wú fāng hé nǎi nǎi yì qǐ zuò miàn tiáo 。 tā zuò le zhǎng miàn tiáo ， yě zuò le duǎn miàn tiáo 。 zhè shì wú fāng dì yī cì zuò miàn tiáo 。 nǎi nǎi shuō ：“ hěn hǎo ！”
miàn tiáo hǎo le 。 wú fāng gěi nǎi nǎi yī dà wǎn ， wú fāng chī yī xiǎo wǎn 。 miàn tiáo hěn hǎo chī 。 wú fāng shuō ：“ xià gè xīng qī wǒ hái yào zuò miàn tiáo 。”
translation: At noon on Saturday, Wu Fang went to her grandmother's home. Her grandmother said, “We’re having noodles today. Let’s make them together.” Wu Fang was very happy.
Wu Fang and her grandmother made noodles together. She made long noodles and also made short noodles. This was Wu Fang's first time making noodles. Her grandmother said, “Very good!”

The noodles were ready. Wu Fang gave her grandmother a large bowl of noodles, and she ate a small bowl of noodles herself. The noodles were delicious. Wu Fang said, “I want to make noodles again next week.”

articles.title: 何平带花回家
articles.summary: 何平给妈妈买花，在车站等了五分钟，并在车上请小女孩坐下。
articles.topic: 何平带花回家
paragraphs: 今天上午，何平坐车去花店。今天是妈妈的生日，他想买一些红花送给她。
买了花，何平来到车站。车站人很多，他等了五分钟，车才来。
上车后，何平看见一个小女孩没有地方坐。他请小女孩坐下，自己没有坐。回到家，妈妈看到红花，很高兴。
pinyin: jīn tiān shàng wǔ ， hé píng zuò chē qù huā diàn 。 jīn tiān shì mā mā de shēng rì ， tā xiǎng mǎi yī xiē hóng huā sòng gěi tā 。
mǎi le huā ， hé píng lái dào chē zhàn 。 chē zhàn rén hěn duō ， tā děng le wǔ fēn zhōng ， chē cái lái 。
shàng chē hòu ， hé píng kàn jiàn yí gè xiǎo nǚ hái méi yǒu dì fāng zuò 。 tā qǐng xiǎo nǚ hái zuò xià ， zì jǐ méi yǒu zuò 。 huí dào jiā ， mā mā kàn dào hóng huā ， hěn gāo xìng 。
translation: This morning, He Ping went to a flower shop by bus. It was his mother's birthday, and he wanted to buy her some red flowers.
After buying the flowers, He Ping came to the bus station. There were many people at the station, and the bus came only after he had waited for five minutes.

After getting on the bus, He Ping saw a little girl who had nowhere to sit. He invited the girl to sit down while he remained standing. When he arrived home, his mother was very happy to see the red flowers.

articles.title: 鸡蛋呢？
articles.summary: 马琳去商店买牛奶和鸡蛋，却只带回了牛奶和苹果。她发现忘了鸡蛋以后，又去商店买了一次。
articles.topic: 鸡蛋呢？
paragraphs: 星期五下午，弟弟给马琳打电话：“姐姐，你在哪儿？家里没有牛奶，也没有鸡蛋。”
马琳说：“我在学校，现在去商店。”她到了商店，买了牛奶，还买了两个苹果。
回家以后，弟弟看了看她的东西，问：“鸡蛋呢？”马琳这才知道，她忘了买鸡蛋。说完对不起，她又去商店买鸡蛋了。

translation: On Friday afternoon, Ma Lin's younger brother called her. "Sister, where are you? There is no milk or eggs at home."
Ma Lin said, "I am at school. I am going to the store now." She arrived at the store and bought some milk and two apples.

After she came home, her younger brother looked at her things and asked, "Where are the eggs?" Only then did Ma Lin realize that she had forgotten to buy them. After saying sorry, she went back to the store to buy eggs.

articles.title: 动物园里的熊猫画
articles.summary: 星期日，高峰和妈妈一起去动物园看熊猫，他还画了一只熊猫。
articles.topic: 动物园里的熊猫画
paragraphs: 星期日上午，高峰和妈妈一起坐车去动物园。天气很好，动物园里的人很多。他们先看了小鸟，又去看熊猫。
熊猫在树下吃东西，也在水边喝水。高峰很高兴。他看了很久，还画了一只大熊猫。
中午，高峰和妈妈在门口吃米饭。回家后，他把画放在桌子上。他说：“下个星期，我还想来看熊猫。”

translation: On Sunday morning, Gao Feng and his mother went to the zoo together by car. The weather was very good, and there were many people in the zoo. They first watched the birds and then went to see the pandas.
The panda ate under a tree and also drank water by the water's edge. Gao Feng was very happy. He watched it for a long time and also drew a big panda.
At noon, Gao Feng and his mother ate rice near the entrance. After returning home, he put the picture on the table. He said, “Next week, I want to come and see the pandas again.”

articles.title: 谢红坐车去学校
articles.summary: 谢红第一次坐车去女儿的学校。她问一个女孩，坐五站以后下车，八点半到了学校。
articles.topic: 谢红第一次坐地铁
paragraphs: 星期四早上，谢红要去女儿的学校。她第一次坐车去学校，不知道怎么去。
她问一个女孩：“学校在哪儿？我要坐几站？”女孩说：“坐五站以后下车。”

After five stops, Xie Hong got off. She arrived at the school at eight thirty. Her daughter was waiting for her at the school. Xie Hong was very happy to see her daughter.

articles.title: 唐乐还想来
articles.summary: 唐乐和妈妈在家旁边的饭店吃午饭，他很喜欢这里的青菜和米饭。
articles.topic: 唐乐还想来
paragraphs: 今天中午，唐乐和妈妈去家旁边的饭店吃饭。饭店里人不多，他们坐在一个大桌子旁。
唐乐想吃米饭和青菜，妈妈想吃面条。他们还要了两杯水。菜来了，唐乐先吃青菜，再吃米饭。

translation: At noon today, Tang Le and his mother went to eat at a restaurant near their home. There were not many people in the restaurant, and they sat by a large table.
Tang Le wanted rice and green vegetables, while his mother wanted noodles. They also ordered two glasses of water. When the food arrived, Tang Le ate the vegetables first and then the rice.
After the meal, his mother asked, “How is the food here?” Tang Le said, “It is delicious. I want to come again next time.”

articles.title: 给妈妈的生日卡
articles.summary: 冯雪给妈妈买了一张生日卡，写下生日祝福，并把卡交给邮局的人。

articles.title: 照片里的三只小鸟
articles.summary: 曹阳拿照片回家时，在河边看见三只小鸟，又给它们照了一张照片。
articles.topic: 照片里的三只小鸟
paragraphs: 星期三上午，曹阳去照相馆拿照片。照片里有他和妈妈，他们都很高兴。
回家的时候，他走到河边。他看见河边有三只小鸟：一只白的，两只黑的。它们在吃东西。
曹阳停下来看，也给小鸟照了一张照片。回家后，他给妈妈看这张照片。妈妈说：“小鸟真好看！”

translation: On Wednesday morning, Cao Yang went to the photo shop to pick up some photos. He and his mother were in the photos, and they were both very happy.
On his way home, he came to the riverside. He saw three little birds there: one was white, and two were black. They were eating something.
Cao Yang stopped to watch and also took a photo of the birds. After returning home, he showed this photo to his mother. His mother said, “The birds are so beautiful!”

蒋欣拿了药。她没有回家。她坐下来，打开故事书，给奶奶读了一页。
奶奶听故事，很高兴。她说故事很好，蒋欣也笑了。下午，她们回到家，又一起读这本书。

Jiang Xin got the medicine. She did not go home. She sat down, opened the storybook, and read one page to her grandmother.
Her grandmother was very happy as she listened to the story. She said the story was very good, and Jiang Xin smiled too. In the afternoon, they returned home and read the book together again.

articles.title: 雨后去西湖
articles.summary: 王明和姐姐去杭州旅行，因为下雨改变了计划，却发现了新的快乐。
articles.topic: 雨后去西湖
paragraphs: 王明周末要和姐姐去杭州玩。他们买了早上八点的火车票，还准备了水、面包和一把雨伞。星期五晚上，姐姐看见天气预报说杭州周六有雨。
王明本来想在西湖边骑自行车。因为下雨，他们先去了一家小茶馆。两个人一边喝茶，一边看窗外的雨，还请老板介绍杭州好吃的东西。
下午雨停了，太阳出来了。他们走到西湖边，看见湖上有很多小船。王明觉得，旅行和计划不一样也没关系，慢一点也可以玩得很开心。
pinyin: wáng míng zhōu mò yào hé jiě jiě qù háng zhōu wán 。 tā men mǎi le zǎo shàng bā diǎn de huǒ chē piào ， hái zhǔn bèi le shuǐ 、 miàn bāo hé yī bǎ yǔ sǎn 。 xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng ， jiě jiě kàn jiàn tiān qì yù bào shuō háng zhōu zhōu liù yǒu yǔ 。

wáng míng běn lái xiǎng zài xī hú biān qí zì xíng chē 。 yīn wèi xià yǔ ， tā men xiān qù le yī jiā xiǎo chá guǎn 。 liǎng gè rén yī biān hē chá ， yī biān kàn chuāng wài de yǔ ， hái qǐng lǎo bǎn jiè shào háng zhōu hǎo chī de dōng xī 。

xià wǔ yǔ tíng le ， tài yáng chū lái le 。 tā men zǒu dào xī hú biān ， kàn jiàn hú shàng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo chuán 。 wáng míng jué de ， lǚ xíng hé jì huà bù yí yàng yě méi guān xì ， màn yì diǎn yě kě yǐ wán dé hěn kāi xīn 。
translation: Wang Ming is going to visit Hangzhou with his older sister this weekend. They bought train tickets for eight in the morning and prepared water, bread, and an umbrella. On Friday evening, his sister saw in the weather forecast that it would rain in Hangzhou on Saturday.

Wang Ming originally wanted to ride a bicycle beside West Lake. Because it was raining, they first went to a small teahouse. The two of them drank tea while watching the rain outside the window, and they also asked the owner to recommend delicious food in Hangzhou.

In the afternoon, the rain stopped and the sun came out. They walked to West Lake and saw many small boats on the lake. Wang Ming felt that it did not matter if a trip was different from the plan; they could still have a wonderful time by slowing down.

articles.title: 更近的汽车站
articles.summary: 李娜因为公共汽车站离家更近、车票也不贵，改坐公共汽车去苏州看朋友，并和朋友一起逛公园、拍照和吃面。
articles.topic: 更近的汽车站
paragraphs: 星期六早上，李娜要去苏州看朋友。她先想坐火车。因为公共汽车站离她家更近，车票也不贵，所以她最后坐了公共汽车。
路上，她看见窗外有很多小河和白色的房子。两个小时后，汽车到了苏州。朋友在车站等她，还给她买了一杯热茶。
下午，她们一起去公园走路、拍照，又在一家小店吃面。晚上回家时，李娜觉得坐公共汽车很方便。她说，下次还想这样去苏州。
pinyin: xīng qī liù zǎo shàng ， lǐ nà yào qù sū zhōu kàn péng yǒu 。 tā xiān xiǎng zuò huǒ chē 。 yīn wèi gōng gòng qì chē zhàn lí tā jiā gèng jìn ， chē piào yě bù guì ， suǒ yǐ tā zuì hòu zuò le gōng gòng qì chē 。
lù shàng ， tā kàn jiàn chuāng wài yǒu hěn duō xiǎo hé hé bái sè de fáng zi 。 liǎng gè xiǎo shí hòu ， qì chē dào le sū zhōu 。 péng yǒu zài chē zhàn děng tā ， huán gěi tā mǎi le yī bēi rè chá 。

xià wǔ ， tā men yì qǐ qù gōng yuán zǒu lù 、 pāi zhào ， yòu zài yī jiā xiǎo diàn chī miàn 。 wǎn shàng huí jiā shí ， lǐ nà jué de zuò gōng gòng qì chē hěn fāng biàn 。 tā shuō ， xià cì hái xiǎng zhè yàng qù sū zhōu 。
translation: On Saturday morning, Li Na was going to Suzhou to visit a friend. At first, she wanted to take the train. Because the bus station was closer to her home and the ticket was not expensive, she took the bus in the end.
On the way, she saw many small rivers and white houses outside the window. Two hours later, the bus arrived in Suzhou. Her friend waited for her at the station and bought her a cup of hot tea.

In the afternoon, they walked and took photos in a park, and then ate noodles at a small restaurant. On her way home that evening, Li Na felt that traveling by bus was very convenient. She said that she wanted to go to Suzhou this way again next time.

articles.title: 南京下雨以后
articles.summary: 张伟因为下雨改变了旅行安排，却在书店和公园度过了有意思的一天。
articles.topic: 南京下雨以后
paragraphs: 去南京以前，张伟想坐地铁去几个地方。他先在网上看了地图，然后问了住在南京的朋友。朋友告诉他，早上可以坐公共汽车到河边，再坐船去公园。
张伟到南京的那天，雨下得很大，所以船不开了。他不想一直等，就坐公共汽车去了一个小书店。那里人很少，他喝了一杯热茶，还看了一本介绍南京的书。
下午雨停了，张伟从书店走到公园。路上，他看见很多老房子，也买了一个小礼物。他没有坐船，可是去了一个没想到的地方，觉得这一天很有意思。
pinyin: qù nán jīng yǐ qián ， zhāng wěi xiǎng zuò dì tiě qù jǐ gè dì fāng 。 tā xiān zài wǎng shàng kàn le dì tú ， rán hòu wèn le zhù zài nán jīng de péng yǒu 。 péng yǒu gào sù tā ， zǎo shàng kě yǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē dào hé biān ， zài zuò chuán qù gōng yuán 。

zhāng wěi dào nán jīng de nà tiān ， yǔ xià dé hěn dà ， suǒ yǐ chuán bù kāi le 。 tā bù xiǎng yì zhí děng ， jiù zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù le yí gè xiǎo shū diàn 。 nà lǐ rén hěn shǎo ， tā hē le yī bēi rè chá ， hái kàn le yī běn jiè shào nán jīng de shū 。

translation: Before going to Nanjing, Zhang Wei wanted to take the subway to several places. He first looked at a map online and then asked a friend who lived in Nanjing. His friend told him that in the morning he could take a bus to the riverside and then take a boat to the park.

On the day Zhang Wei arrived in Nanjing, it was raining heavily, so the boat was not running. He did not want to keep waiting, so he took a bus to a small bookstore. There were few people there. He drank a cup of hot tea and read a book about Nanjing.

The rain stopped in the afternoon, and Zhang Wei walked from the bookstore to the park. On the way, he saw many old houses and bought a small gift. He did not take the boat, but he visited a place he had not expected to visit and thought the day was very interesting.

articles.title: 去青岛的时间变了
articles.summary: 天气不好，陈洁和小雨下午才坐飞机去青岛。她们上午在机场旁边吃饭，还认识了一位老师。
articles.topic: 去青岛前的新安排
paragraphs: 陈洁和朋友小雨想星期六去青岛看海。她们要坐早上的飞机。星期五晚上，她们知道明天天气不好，飞机要晚三个小时。
陈洁不想在机场等三个小时。她问小雨：“我们下午再坐飞机，好吗？”小雨说好。星期六上午，她们在机场旁边的小店吃饭，也认识了一位老师。老师也要去青岛。
下午天气好了，她们坐飞机去了青岛。到青岛的时候，天还没有黑。她们很快就到了海边。坐飞机的时间变了，可是这个上午也很有意思。

translation: Chen Jie and her friend Xiaoyu wanted to go to Qingdao to see the sea on Saturday. They planned to take a morning flight. On Friday evening, they learned that the weather would be bad the next day and that the plane would be three hours late.

Chen Jie did not want to wait at the airport for three hours. She asked Xiaoyu, “Shall we take the plane in the afternoon instead?” Xiaoyu agreed. On Saturday morning, they ate at a small restaurant beside the airport and met a teacher. The teacher was also going to Qingdao.

The weather improved in the afternoon, and they flew to Qingdao. When they arrived in Qingdao, it was not dark yet. They soon reached the seaside. The time of their flight had changed, but the morning was interesting too.

articles.title: 晚两小时的成都旅行
articles.summary: 刘洋发现火车时间和自己原来想的不一样，因此改变了成都旅行计划，也度过了一个轻松的周末。
articles.topic: 晚两小时的成都旅行
paragraphs: 刘洋周末想去成都看朋友。他本来准备坐六点的火车，星期五晚上却发现车票上的时间是八点。这样，他可以多睡一会儿，也不用很早到火车站。
到了成都，朋友问他想先去哪里。刘洋没有马上去有名的饭店，而是跟朋友坐地铁去了一个小公园。他们一边走路，一边聊天，还拍了几张照片。
下午下雨了，两个人就在公园旁边的小店里喝茶。刘洋觉得，旅行不一定要去很多地方。因为火车时间跟他原来想的不一样，他的计划也变了，可是这个周末比他想的更轻松。
pinyin: liú yáng zhōu mò xiǎng qù chéng dū kàn péng yǒu 。 tā běn lái zhǔn bèi zuò liù diǎn de huǒ chē ， xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng què fā xiàn chē piào shàng de shí jiān shì bā diǎn 。 zhè yàng ， tā kě yǐ duō shuì yī huì er ， yě bù yòng hěn zǎo dào huǒ chē zhàn 。

xià wǔ xià yǔ le ， liǎng gè rén jiù zài gōng yuán páng biān de xiǎo diàn lǐ hē chá 。 liú yáng jué de ， lǚ xíng bù yí dìng yào qù hěn duō dì fāng 。 yīn wèi huǒ chē shí jiān gēn tā yuán lái xiǎng de bù yí yàng ， tā de jì huà yě biàn le ， kě shì zhè ge zhōu mò bǐ tā xiǎng de gèng qīng sōng 。
translation: Liu Yang wanted to visit a friend in Chengdu over the weekend. He had planned to take the six o’clock train, but on Friday evening he discovered that the time on his ticket was eight o’clock. This meant that he could sleep a little longer and did not need to arrive at the train station very early.

After arriving in Chengdu, his friend asked where he wanted to go first. Liu Yang did not immediately go to a famous restaurant. Instead, he took the subway with his friend to a small park. They walked and talked at the same time, and they also took several photos.

It rained in the afternoon, so the two of them drank tea in a small shop beside the park. Liu Yang felt that a trip did not have to include many places. Because the train time was different from what he had originally thought, his plan changed too, but the weekend was more relaxing than he had expected.

articles.title: 在天津改坐地铁
articles.summary: 赵敏到天津看朋友，因为路上车多，她改坐地铁，并发现这样又快又方便。
articles.topic: 在天津改坐地铁
paragraphs: 星期六早上，赵敏坐火车到了天津。她本来想坐公共汽车去见朋友，可是朋友说周末路上车很多，坐地铁更快。于是，她在火车站买了一张地铁票。
地铁里人不少，但是很干净。赵敏坐了六站，在一个小公园旁边下车。朋友已经在门口等她，还带了两杯热茶。
下午，她们一起看花、拍照片，又去吃了天津的小吃。回家前，赵敏觉得坐地铁又快又方便。她决定下次来天津，还坐地铁去看朋友。
pinyin: xīng qī liù zǎo shàng ， zhào mǐn zuò huǒ chē dào le tiān jīn 。 tā běn lái xiǎng zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù jiàn péng yǒu ， kě shì péng yǒu shuō zhōu mò lù shàng chē hěn duō ， zuò dì tiě gèng kuài 。 yú shì ， tā zài huǒ chē zhàn mǎi le yī zhāng dì tiě piào 。

xià wǔ ， tā men yì qǐ kàn huā 、 pāi zhào piān ， yòu qù chī le tiān jīn de xiǎo chī 。 huí jiā qián ， zhào mǐn jué de zuò dì tiě yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn 。 tā jué dìng xià cì lái tiān jīn ， hái zuò dì tiě qù kàn péng yǒu 。
translation: On Saturday morning, Zhao Min arrived in Tianjin by train. She had planned to take a bus to meet her friend, but her friend said there were many cars on the road during the weekend and the subway was faster. So she bought a subway ticket at the railway station.

There were quite a few people on the subway, but it was very clean. Zhao Min traveled six stops and got off beside a small park. Her friend was already waiting for her at the entrance and had brought two cups of hot tea.

In the afternoon, they looked at flowers, took photos, and then went to eat some Tianjin snacks. Before going home, Zhao Min felt that taking the subway was both fast and convenient. She decided to take the subway to visit her friend the next time she came to Tianjin.

articles.title: 厦门旅行中的小变化
articles.summary: 孙强到厦门旅行时改坐公共汽车，只花了两元钱，还在回酒店的路上发现一家小书店，买到了一本喜欢的书。
articles.topic: 厦门旅行中的小变化
paragraphs: 去厦门以前，孙强看了地图。他原来想每天坐出租车，因为觉得这样又快又简单。到了酒店以后，里面的人告诉他，门口的公共汽车也能到海边。
第二天早上，他没有叫出租车，第一次坐公共汽车出门。车上人不多，他一边看窗外，一边听站名。四十分钟后，他在海边下车，只花了两元钱。
回酒店时，孙强还是坐公共汽车。路上，他看见一家小书店，就早下了一站。虽然多走了十分钟，但是他买到了一本喜欢的书，也觉得这一天更有意思。
pinyin: qù xià mén yǐ qián ， sūn qiáng kàn le dì tú 。 tā yuán lái xiǎng měi tiān zuò chū zū chē ， yīn wèi jué de zhè yàng yòu kuài yòu jiǎn dān 。 dào le jiǔ diàn yǐ hòu ， lǐ miàn de rén gào sù tā ， mén kǒu de gōng gòng qì chē yě néng dào hǎi biān 。

dì èr tiān zǎo shàng ， tā méi yǒu jiào chū zū chē ， dì yī cì zuò gōng gòng qì chē chū mén 。 chē shàng rén bù duō ， tā yī biān kàn chuāng wài ， yī biān tīng zhàn míng 。 sì shí fēn zhōng hòu ， tā zài hǎi biān xià chē ， zhǐ huā le liǎng yuán qián 。

translation: Before going to Xiamen, Sun Qiang looked at a map. He had planned to take a taxi every day because he thought it would be fast and simple. After arriving at the hotel, someone there told him that the bus at the entrance could also take him to the seaside.

The next morning, he did not call a taxi and took a bus for the first time. There were not many people on the bus. He looked out of the window while listening to the names of the stops. Forty minutes later, he got off at the seaside and spent only two yuan.

When returning to the hotel, Sun Qiang took the bus again. On the way, he saw a small bookstore, so he got off one stop early. Although he walked for ten more minutes, he bought a book he liked and felt that the day was more interesting.

articles.title: 雨中的武汉周末
articles.summary: 周兰因为大雨改变了出发时间，也改变了旅行安排，但她还是度过了一个开心的周末。
articles.topic: 雨中的武汉周末
paragraphs: 周兰本来想星期六早上坐火车去武汉。出门前，她看到天气不好，雨也越来越大。妈妈说：“下午再走吧，路上更安全。”她觉得有道理，就把车票换到了下午。
到了武汉，雨已经停了。因为晚到了两个小时，她没有先去公园，而是直接去找大学同学小林。小林带她去吃热干面，还请她喝了一杯茶。
第二天早上，天气很好。周兰和小林一起去了东湖，走了很长时间，也拍了很多照片。回家时，周兰说：“计划变了一点，可是这个周末还是很开心。”
pinyin: zhōu lán běn lái xiǎng xīng qī liù zǎo shàng zuò huǒ chē qù wǔ hàn 。 chū mén qián ， tā kàn dào tiān qì bù hǎo ， yǔ yě yuè lái yuè dà 。 mā mā shuō ：“ xià wǔ zài zǒu ba ， lù shàng gèng ān quán 。” tā jué de yǒu dào lǐ ， jiù bǎ chē piào huàn dào le xià wǔ 。

dào le wǔ hàn ， yǔ yǐ jīng tíng le 。 yīn wèi wǎn dào le liǎng gè xiǎo shí ， tā méi yǒu xiān qù gōng yuán ， ér shì zhí jiē qù zhǎo dà xué tóng xué xiǎo lín 。 xiǎo lín dài tā qù chī rè gàn miàn ， hái qǐng tā hē le yī bēi chá 。

dì èr tiān zǎo shàng ， tiān qì hěn hǎo 。 zhōu lán hé xiǎo lín yì qǐ qù le dōng hú ， zǒu le hěn zhǎng shí jiān ， yě pāi le hěn duō zhào piān 。 huí jiā shí ， zhōu lán shuō ：“ jì huà biàn le yì diǎn ， kě shì zhè ge zhōu mò hái shì hěn kāi xīn 。”
translation: Zhou Lan originally planned to take a train to Wuhan on Saturday morning. Before leaving home, she saw that the weather was bad and the rain was getting heavier. Her mother said, “Go in the afternoon. It will be safer on the road.” Zhou Lan thought that made sense, so she changed her ticket to the afternoon.

When she arrived in Wuhan, the rain had already stopped. Because she arrived two hours late, she did not go to the park first. Instead, she went directly to meet her university classmate Xiaolin. Xiaolin took her to eat hot dry noodles and also bought her a cup of tea.

The weather was very good the next morning. Zhou Lan and Xiaolin went to East Lake together, walked for a long time, and took many photos. On her way home, Zhou Lan said, “The plan changed a little, but this weekend was still very enjoyable.”

articles.title: 晚到西安以后
articles.summary: 吴刚因为找手机错过火车，却在改变计划后看到了西安美丽的夜景。
articles.topic: 晚到西安以后
paragraphs: 吴刚周末去西安玩。他本来想坐早上八点的火车，可是出门时发现手机不见了。他回家找了十分钟，在桌子下面找到了手机，所以没有赶上火车。
他买了下一班车票，中午才到西安。因为时间少了，他没有马上去看兵马俑，而是先在城里走一走。他吃了一碗面，还认识了一个卖水果的老人。
老人告诉他，晚上看城墙很漂亮。吴刚去了城墙，看见很多灯，觉得这次小变化也很好。他决定第二天再去看兵马俑。
pinyin: wú gāng zhōu mò qù xī ān wán 。 tā běn lái xiǎng zuò zǎo shàng bā diǎn de huǒ chē ， kě shì chū mén shí fā xiàn shǒu jī bú jiàn le 。 tā huí jiā zhǎo le shí fēn zhōng ， zài zhuō zi xià miàn zhǎo dào le shǒu jī ， suǒ yǐ méi yǒu gǎn shàng huǒ chē 。

tā mǎi le xià yī bān chē piào ， zhōng wǔ cái dào xī ān 。 yīn wèi shí jiān shǎo le ， tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng qù kàn bīng mǎ yǒng ， ér shì xiān zài chéng lǐ zǒu yī zǒu 。 tā chī le yī wǎn miàn ， hái rèn shí le yí gè mài shuǐ guǒ de lǎo rén 。

translation: Wu Gang went to Xi'an for the weekend. He had planned to take the train at eight in the morning, but when he was leaving home, he found that his phone was missing. He went back and searched for ten minutes, found it under the table, and therefore missed the train.

He bought a ticket for the next train and did not arrive in Xi'an until noon. Because he had less time, he did not go to see the Terracotta Warriors right away. Instead, he first took a walk around the city. He ate a bowl of noodles and also met an elderly fruit seller.

The elderly man told him that the city wall was beautiful at night. Wu Gang went to the city wall, saw many lights, and felt that this small change had also turned out well. He decided to see the Terracotta Warriors the next day.

articles.title: 一张飞往昆明的票
articles.summary: 黄梅因为路远改坐飞机去昆明，并发现飞机比她想的更方便。
articles.topic: 一张飞往昆明的票
paragraphs: 黄梅住在北京，五月要和朋友去昆明玩。她先看了火车票。因为路很远，坐火车要很长时间，所以她最后买了飞机票。
到了昆明，黄梅发现那里比北京暖和。她把厚衣服放在酒店，只穿一件白衣服。下午，她和朋友坐公共汽车去公园，看了很多漂亮的花，也照了不少照片。
回北京的时候，黄梅说：“以前我觉得坐飞机有点麻烦，这次发现它又快又方便。下次去远的地方，我还会坐飞机。”朋友听了，也笑着点点头。
pinyin: huáng méi zhù zài běi jīng ， wǔ yuè yào hé péng yǒu qù kūn míng wán 。 tā xiān kàn le huǒ chē piào 。 yīn wèi lù hěn yuǎn ， zuò huǒ chē yào hěn zhǎng shí jiān ， suǒ yǐ tā zuì hòu mǎi le fēi jī piào 。

dào le kūn míng ， huáng méi fā xiàn nà lǐ bǐ běi jīng nuǎn huo 。 tā bǎ hòu yī fú fàng zài jiǔ diàn ， zhǐ chuān yī jiàn bái yī fú 。 xià wǔ ， tā hé péng yǒu zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù gōng yuán ， kàn le hěn duō piào liàng de huā ， yě zhào le bù shǎo zhào piān 。

huí běi jīng de shí hòu ， huáng méi shuō ：“ yǐ qián wǒ jué de zuò fēi jī yǒu diǎn má fán ， zhè cì fā xiàn tā yòu kuài yòu fāng biàn 。 xià cì qù yuǎn de dì fāng ， wǒ hái huì zuò fēi jī 。” péng yǒu tīng le ， yě xiào zhe diǎn diǎn tóu 。
translation: Huang Mei lives in Beijing and planned to visit Kunming with a friend in May. She first looked at train tickets. Because the journey was long and traveling by train would take a lot of time, she finally bought a plane ticket.

After arriving in Kunming, Huang Mei found that it was warmer there than in Beijing. She left her thick clothes at the hotel and wore only one white garment. In the afternoon, she and her friend took a bus to a park, saw many beautiful flowers, and took quite a few photos.

When returning to Beijing, Huang Mei said, “I used to think that flying was a little troublesome, but this time I found it both fast and convenient. The next time I go somewhere far away, I will fly again.” Her friend listened and nodded with a smile.

articles.title: 慢一点的济南周末
articles.summary: 何雨选择坐火车去济南，并在慢慢游览时发现了新的地方。
articles.topic: 慢一点的济南周末
paragraphs: 星期五晚上，何雨准备去济南看朋友。她先比较了火车、汽车和飞机。汽车便宜，可是要坐很久；因为飞机票太贵，所以她没有买。最后，她买了早上七点的火车票。
到了济南，她没有请朋友开车来接，自己坐公共汽车去大明湖。车开得有点儿慢，她却看见了老街、小店和很多树。
第二天，她本来要坐车去看泉，后来决定走路。她一边看地图，一边问路，还找到一家安静的书店。何雨觉得，慢一点也能发现新的地方。
pinyin: xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng ， hé yǔ zhǔn bèi qù jǐ nán kàn péng yǒu 。 tā xiān bǐ jiào le huǒ chē 、 qì chē hé fēi jī 。 qì chē pián yi ， kě shì yào zuò hěn jiǔ ； yīn wèi fēi jī piào tài guì ， suǒ yǐ tā méi yǒu mǎi 。 zuì hòu ， tā mǎi le zǎo shàng qī diǎn de huǒ chē piào 。
dào le jǐ nán ， tā méi yǒu qǐng péng yǒu kāi chē lái jiē ， zì jǐ zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù dà míng hú 。 chē kāi dé yǒu diǎn ér màn ， tā què kàn jiàn le lǎo jiē 、 xiǎo diàn hé hěn duō shù 。

dì èr tiān ， tā běn lái yào zuò chē qù kàn quán ， hòu lái jué dìng zǒu lù 。 tā yī biān kàn dì tú ， yī biān wèn lù ， hái zhǎo dào yī jiā ān jìng de shū diàn 。 hé yǔ jué de ， màn yì diǎn yě néng fā xiàn xīn de dì fāng 。
translation: On Friday evening, He Yu prepared to visit a friend in Jinan. She first compared trains, buses, and airplanes. The bus was inexpensive, but the journey would take a long time. Because the plane ticket was too expensive, she did not buy one. In the end, she bought a train ticket for seven in the morning.

After arriving in Jinan, she did not ask her friend to pick her up by car. She took a public bus to Daming Lake by herself. The bus moved a little slowly, but she saw old streets, small shops, and many trees.

The next day, she originally planned to take a vehicle to see the springs, but later decided to walk. She looked at the map while asking for directions and also found a quiet bookstore. He Yu felt that moving more slowly could also help her discover new places.

articles.title: 雨中的长沙周末
articles.summary: 马欣没有因为下雨改变旅行时间，而是换了鞋、带上伞，在长沙和姐姐度过了一个轻松的周末。
articles.topic: 雨中的长沙周末
paragraphs: 马欣的周末计划早就定好了。星期六早上，她坐飞机去长沙，下午去看住在那里的姐姐。她想和姐姐一起吃饭，还想看看长沙的晚上。
星期五夜里，姐姐打电话说长沙可能下雨。马欣没有换时间，只把白色的鞋换成旧鞋，又在包里放了一把伞。飞机到长沙时，外面真的下着雨。
姐姐来机场接她。因为下雨，所以她们没有去远的地方，只在家附近吃了热饭。后来雨停了，两个人慢慢走回家。马欣觉得，计划有一点变化，周末还是很好。
pinyin: mǎ xīn de zhōu mò jì huà zǎo jiù dìng hǎo le 。 xīng qī liù zǎo shàng ， tā zuò fēi jī qù cháng shā ， xià wǔ qù kàn zhù zài nà lǐ de jiě jiě 。 tā xiǎng hé jiě jiě yì qǐ chī fàn ， hái xiǎng kàn kàn cháng shā de wǎn shàng 。

xīng qī wǔ yè lǐ ， jiě jiě dǎ diàn huà shuō cháng shā kě néng xià yǔ 。 mǎ xīn méi yǒu huàn shí jiān ， zhǐ bǎ bái sè de xié huàn chéng jiù xié ， yòu zài bāo lǐ fàng le yī bǎ sǎn 。 fēi jī dào cháng shā shí ， wài miàn zhēn de xià zhe yǔ 。

jiě jiě lái jī chǎng jiē tā 。 yīn wèi xià yǔ ， suǒ yǐ tā men méi yǒu qù yuǎn de dì fāng ， zhǐ zài jiā fù jìn chī le rè fàn 。 hòu lái yǔ tíng le ， liǎng gè rén màn màn zǒu huí jiā 。 mǎ xīn jué de ， jì huà yǒu yì diǎn biàn huà ， zhōu mò hái shì hěn hǎo 。
translation: Ma Xin had already made her weekend plans. On Saturday morning, she would fly to Changsha and visit her older sister who lived there in the afternoon. She wanted to have a meal with her sister and also see Changsha at night.

On Friday night, her sister called and said it might rain in Changsha. Ma Xin did not change the time of her trip. She only changed from her white shoes into an old pair and put an umbrella in her bag. When the plane arrived in Changsha, it was really raining outside.

Her sister came to the airport to meet her. Because it was raining, they did not go anywhere far and only had a hot meal near home. Later, the rain stopped, and they slowly walked home together. Ma Xin felt that although the plan had changed a little, the weekend was still very nice.

articles.title: 晚一点去大连
articles.summary: 高杰因为下雨改了火车时间，也因此有了一次轻松的周末旅行。
articles.topic: 晚一点去大连
paragraphs: 高杰周末想坐火车去大连，看海，也看看住在那里的朋友小林。星期五晚上，小林来电话，说星期六早上下雨，请他晚一点出门。
高杰把早上七点的票换成了十点的票。他多睡了两个小时，还在家吃了早饭。到大连时，雨已经停了，小林正在车站等他。
他们先去海边走了走，下午又一起吃鱼。回家前，高杰买了两张海边的照片。他觉得，旅行晚一点开始也很好，因为人不累，天气也更好了。
pinyin: gāo jié zhōu mò xiǎng zuò huǒ chē qù dà lián ， kàn hǎi ， yě kàn kàn zhù zài nà lǐ de péng yǒu xiǎo lín 。 xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng ， xiǎo lín lái diàn huà ， shuō xīng qī liù zǎo shàng xià yǔ ， qǐng tā wǎn yì diǎn chū mén 。

gāo jié bǎ zǎo shàng qī diǎn de piào huàn chéng le shí diǎn de piào 。 tā duō shuì le liǎng gè xiǎo shí ， hái zài jiā chī le zǎo fàn 。 dào dà lián shí ， yǔ yǐ jīng tíng le ， xiǎo lín zhèng zài chē zhàn děng tā 。

tā men xiān qù hǎi biān zǒu le zǒu ， xià wǔ yòu yì qǐ chī yú 。 huí jiā qián ， gāo jié mǎi le liǎng zhāng hǎi biān de zhào piān 。 tā jué de ， lǚ xíng wǎn yì diǎn kāi shǐ yě hěn hǎo ， yīn wèi rén bù lèi ， tiān qì yě gèng hǎo le 。
translation: Gao Jie wanted to take a train to Dalian on the weekend to see the sea and visit his friend Xiaolin, who lived there. On Friday evening, Xiaolin called and said it would rain on Saturday morning, so he asked Gao Jie to leave home a little later.

Gao Jie changed his ticket from seven in the morning to ten. He slept for two more hours and ate breakfast at home. When he arrived in Dalian, the rain had already stopped, and Xiaolin was waiting for him at the station.

They first took a walk by the sea and then ate fish together in the afternoon. Before going home, Gao Jie bought two photos of the seaside. He thought that starting the trip a little later was also nice because he was not tired and the weather had improved.

articles.title: 第一次坐动车去福州
articles.summary: 谢宁听朋友介绍后改变了出行计划，第一次坐动车去福州。因为路上不累，她到达后直接和朋友去吃鱼丸、逛公园。
articles.topic: 动车窗外的福州周末
paragraphs: 谢宁星期六要去福州看朋友。她想坐汽车去。朋友说，早上有很多动车去福州，也不用换车。谢宁听了朋友的话，第一次坐动车去福州。
出发那天，谢宁早起了半小时。她带了一本小书。动车很快，座位也很舒服。她先看书，后来又看窗外。两个小时后，她到了福州。
朋友在车站等谢宁。谢宁在车上不累，所以她没有先回朋友家休息。她和朋友去吃鱼丸，还去公园玩。谢宁觉得，这次坐动车很轻松。

translation: Xie Ning was going to Fuzhou to visit a friend on Saturday. She wanted to go by bus. Her friend said that there were many high-speed trains to Fuzhou in the morning and that she would not need to change trains. After hearing her friend's words, Xie Ning took a high-speed train to Fuzhou for the first time.

On the day of departure, Xie Ning got up half an hour early. She took a small book with her. The train was fast, and the seat was comfortable. She first read her book and later looked out of the window. Two hours later, she arrived in Fuzhou.

Her friend waited for Xie Ning at the station. Xie Ning was not tired on the train, so she did not go to her friend's home to rest first. She went to eat fish balls with her friend and also went to a park. Xie Ning thought that taking the high-speed train this time was very relaxing.

articles.summary: 唐悦改变了原来的交通和游玩计划，发现慢一点的旅行更有意思。
articles.topic: 郑州旅行中的小变化
paragraphs: 去郑州以前，唐悦想坐飞机，因为飞机快。可是她看了时间和价钱，发现坐火车也很方便。火车站离她家不远，早上出发，中午就能到。所以她最后坐火车去了郑州。
到了郑州，她本来要坐车去酒店。下车后，她看见天气很好，路边还有很多花，就决定先走一走。她走了二十分钟，还在一家小店买了水。
第二天，唐悦没有去很远的地方，只去了酒店附近的公园。她和一位老人说了几句话，也拍了几张照片。回家时，她觉得这次旅行慢了一点，却更有意思。
pinyin: qù zhèng zhōu yǐ qián ， táng yuè xiǎng zuò fēi jī ， yīn wèi fēi jī kuài 。 kě shì tā kàn le shí jiān hé jià qián ， fā xiàn zuò huǒ chē yě hěn fāng biàn 。 huǒ chē zhàn lí tā jiā bù yuǎn ， zǎo shàng chū fā ， zhōng wǔ jiù néng dào 。 suǒ yǐ tā zuì hòu zuò huǒ chē qù le zhèng zhōu 。

dào le zhèng zhōu ， tā běn lái yào zuò chē qù jiǔ diàn 。 xià chē hòu ， tā kàn jiàn tiān qì hěn hǎo ， lù biān hái yǒu hěn duō huā ， jiù jué dìng xiān zǒu yī zǒu 。 tā zǒu le èr shí fēn zhōng ， hái zài yī jiā xiǎo diàn mǎi le shuǐ 。

dì èr tiān ， táng yuè méi yǒu qù hěn yuǎn de dì fāng ， zhǐ qù le jiǔ diàn fù jìn de gōng yuán 。 tā hé yī wèi lǎo rén shuō le jǐ jù huà ， yě pāi le jǐ zhāng zhào piān 。 huí jiā shí ， tā jué de zhè cì lǚ xíng màn le yì diǎn ， què gèng yǒu yì si 。
translation: Before going to Zhengzhou, Tang Yue wanted to take a plane because it was fast. However, after checking the times and prices, she found that taking the train was also convenient. The train station was not far from her home, and if she left in the morning, she could arrive by noon. So in the end, she took the train to Zhengzhou.

After arriving in Zhengzhou, she originally planned to take a car to the hotel. After getting off the train, she saw that the weather was nice and that there were many flowers along the road, so she decided to walk for a while first. She walked for twenty minutes and also bought water at a small shop.

The next day, Tang Yue did not go anywhere far and only visited a park near the hotel. She exchanged a few words with an elderly person and took several photos. When she returned home, she felt that this trip had been a little slower but more interesting.

articles.title: 雨中的桂林也很美
articles.summary: 冯凯没有因为下雨放弃旅行，而是改变计划，在雨后看到了不一样的桂林。
articles.topic: 雨中的桂林也很美
paragraphs: 冯凯早就买好了星期六早上去桂林的飞机票。他想先看山和水，再吃一碗米粉。可是星期五晚上，朋友告诉他，星期六桂林会下大雨。
冯凯没有换票，只把计划改了一下。到了桂林，他先去一家小店吃米粉，又坐在窗边喝茶，看外面的雨。下午雨小了，他才出去坐船。
船上的人不多，山在雨后更绿，河上还有几朵白云。冯凯觉得，这次旅行和原来的计划不一样，但是一样开心。
pinyin: féng kǎi zǎo jiù mǎi hǎo le xīng qī liù zǎo shàng qù guì lín de fēi jī piào 。 tā xiǎng xiān kàn shān hé shuǐ ， zài chī yī wǎn mǐ fěn 。 kě shì xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng ， péng yǒu gào sù tā ， xīng qī liù guì lín huì xià dà yǔ 。

féng kǎi méi yǒu huàn piào ， zhǐ bǎ jì huà gǎi le yī xià 。 dào le guì lín ， tā xiān qù yī jiā xiǎo diàn chī mǐ fěn ， yòu zuò zài chuāng biān hē chá ， kàn wài miàn de yǔ 。 xià wǔ yǔ xiǎo le ， tā cái chū qù zuò chuán 。

translation: Feng Kai had already bought a plane ticket to Guilin for Saturday morning. He wanted to see the mountains and water first, and then eat a bowl of rice noodles. However, on Friday evening, his friend told him that it would rain heavily in Guilin on Saturday.

Feng Kai did not change his ticket. He only changed his plan a little. After arriving in Guilin, he first ate rice noodles at a small restaurant. Then he sat by the window, drank tea, and watched the rain outside. Only when the rain became lighter in the afternoon did he go out for a boat ride.

There were not many people on the boat. The mountains looked greener after the rain, and there were also a few white clouds above the river. Feng Kai felt that this trip was different from his original plan, but it was just as enjoyable.

articles.title: 没有去成的公园
articles.summary: 曹静去合肥看朋友，旅行计划因为天气发生变化，却意外学会了一道新菜。
articles.topic: 没有去成的公园
paragraphs: 周末，曹静坐火车去合肥看朋友小雨。下车以后，她发现天有点冷，可是外套还在家里。小雨先带她去商店买了一件衣服，没有马上去公园。
中午，两个人本来想吃米饭，可是饭店里的人太多。她们就在旁边的小店吃面条，还喝了热茶。曹静觉得面条很好吃，也不用等很长时间。
下午开始下雨，公园去不成了。小雨请曹静到家里，教她做合肥人爱吃的菜。晚上雨停了，可是曹静没有时间去公园了。因为她学会了一道新菜，所以心里还是很高兴。
pinyin: zhōu mò ， cáo jìng zuò huǒ chē qù hé féi kàn péng yǒu xiǎo yǔ 。 xià chē yǐ hòu ， tā fā xiàn tiān yǒu diǎn lěng ， kě shì wài tào hái zài jiā lǐ 。 xiǎo yǔ xiān dài tā qù shāng diàn mǎi le yī jiàn yī fú ， méi yǒu mǎ shàng qù gōng yuán 。

zhōng wǔ ， liǎng gè rén běn lái xiǎng chī mǐ fàn ， kě shì fàn diàn lǐ de rén tài duō 。 tā men jiù zài páng biān de xiǎo diàn chī miàn tiáo ， hái hē le rè chá 。 cáo jìng jué de miàn tiáo hěn hǎo chī ， yě bù yòng děng hěn zhǎng shí jiān 。

xià wǔ kāi shǐ xià yǔ ， gōng yuán qù bù chéng le 。 xiǎo yǔ qǐng cáo jìng dào jiā lǐ ， jiào tā zuò hé féi rén ài chī de cài 。 wǎn shàng yǔ tíng le ， kě shì cáo jìng méi yǒu shí jiān qù gōng yuán le 。 yīn wèi tā xué huì le yī dào xīn cài ， suǒ yǐ xīn lǐ hái shì hěn gāo xìng 。
translation: On the weekend, Cao Jing took a train to Hefei to visit her friend Xiaoyu. After getting off the train, she found that it was a little cold, but her coat was still at home. Xiaoyu first took her to a store to buy an item of clothing instead of going straight to the park.

At noon, the two of them originally wanted to eat rice, but there were too many people in the restaurant. They ate noodles at a small shop nearby and also drank hot tea. Cao Jing thought the noodles were delicious, and they did not have to wait very long.

It began to rain in the afternoon, so they could not go to the park. Xiaoyu invited Cao Jing to her home and taught her to make a dish that people in Hefei like to eat. The rain stopped in the evening, but Cao Jing no longer had time to go to the park. Because she learned how to make a new dish, she was still very happy.

articles.title: 雪天去哈尔滨
articles.summary: 蒋磊听说出发那几天有大雪，为了早点到哈尔滨看朋友，就改坐飞机。
articles.topic: 雪天去哈尔滨
paragraphs: 一月，蒋磊要去哈尔滨看朋友。他本来想坐汽车。出发前，他听说那几天有大雪，路上的车会很慢。他想早点到，就改坐飞机，也把新的到达时间告诉了朋友。
飞机晚了一个小时。朋友查过飞机新的到达时间，所以没有太早去机场。蒋磊出来时，朋友正在门口等他。天还在下雪，他们先坐车回家，没有马上出去玩。
蒋磊觉得，接人前要先查飞机的到达时间。这样就不用在机场等太久。
pinyin: yí yuè ， jiǎng lěi yào qù hā ěr bīn kàn péng yǒu 。 tā běn lái xiǎng zuò qì chē 。 chū fā qián ， tā tīng shuō nà jǐ tiān yǒu dà xuě ， lù shàng de chē huì hěn màn 。 tā xiǎng zǎo diǎn dào ， jiù gǎi zuò fēi jī ， yě bǎ xīn de dào dá shí jiān gào sù le péng yǒu 。

fēi jī wǎn le yí gè xiǎo shí 。 péng yǒu chá guò fēi jī xīn de dào dá shí jiān ， suǒ yǐ méi yǒu tài zǎo qù jī chǎng 。 jiǎng lěi chū lái shí ， péng yǒu zhèng zài mén kǒu děng tā 。 tiān hái zài xià xuě ， tā men xiān zuò chē huí jiā ， méi yǒu mǎ shàng chū qù wán 。

translation: In January, Jiang Lei was going to Harbin to visit a friend. He originally planned to travel by car. Before leaving, he heard that there would be heavy snow for several days and that the vehicles on the road would move slowly. He wanted to arrive earlier, so he decided to fly instead and told his friend the new arrival time.

The plane was one hour late. His friend had checked the plane's new arrival time, so he did not go to the airport too early. When Jiang Lei came out, his friend was waiting for him at the entrance. It was still snowing, so they went home by car first and did not go out to have fun right away.
Jiang Lei thought people should check a flight's arrival time before meeting someone. Then they would not have to wait too long at the airport.

articles.title: 三种车，一次无锡旅行
articles.summary: 邓敏比较了三种交通办法，并在无锡坐了公共汽车和地铁。
articles.topic: 三种车，一次无锡旅行
paragraphs: 去无锡以前，邓敏看了三种办法：坐火车、坐汽车或者坐飞机。飞机最快，但是票太贵；汽车便宜，可是路上时间长。最后，她买了火车票。
火车早上七点开，九点就到了。她先坐公共汽车去湖边。天气有点热，她买了一瓶水，在湖边慢慢走。她看见水上有很多小船，心里很高兴。
下午下雨了，她想坐出租车回宾馆，可是地铁站就在旁边。她第一次坐无锡地铁，二十分钟后就到了。邓敏觉得，这样又省钱，又能多看看这个城市。
pinyin: qù wú xī yǐ qián ， dèng mǐn kàn le sān zhǒng bàn fǎ ： zuò huǒ chē 、 zuò qì chē huò zhě zuò fēi jī 。 fēi jī zuì kuài ， dàn shì piào tài guì ； qì chē pián yi ， kě shì lù shàng shí jiān zhǎng 。 zuì hòu ， tā mǎi le huǒ chē piào 。

huǒ chē zǎo shàng qī diǎn kāi ， jiǔ diǎn jiù dào le 。 tā xiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù hú biān 。 tiān qì yǒu diǎn rè ， tā mǎi le yī píng shuǐ ， zài hú biān màn màn zǒu 。 tā kàn jiàn shuǐ shàng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo chuán ， xīn lǐ hěn gāo xìng 。

translation: Before going to Wuxi, Deng Min considered three choices: taking a train, a bus, or a plane. The plane was the fastest, but the ticket was too expensive; the bus was cheap, but the journey took a long time. In the end, she bought a train ticket.

The train left at seven in the morning and arrived at nine. She first took a city bus to the lakeside. The weather was a little hot, so she bought a bottle of water and walked slowly beside the lake. She saw many small boats on the water and felt very happy.

It rained in the afternoon. She wanted to take a taxi back to the hotel, but a subway station was nearby. She took the Wuxi subway for the first time and arrived twenty minutes later. Deng Min thought that traveling this way saved money and also let her see more of the city.

articles.title: 在南昌多住一晚
articles.summary: 王雪去南昌旅行时发现回家的车票日期不对，于是改变计划，多住了一晚。
articles.topic: 在南昌多住一晚
paragraphs: 星期五晚上，王雪收好衣服，也把去南昌的火车票放进包里。她计划星期六早上出发，下午去八一广场，星期日晚上回家。
到了南昌以后，她发现回家的火车票买成了星期一。她有一点着急，可是改票要多花钱。朋友小周说：“别急，你可以在我家多住一晚，星期一早上再走。”
星期日，他们在江边走了走，还吃了米粉。王雪本来只想看广场，因为车票上的小变化，她又看到了南昌的早上。回家以后，她说这次旅行比她想的更有意思。

articles.title: 把生词带在身边
articles.summary: 林月把较长的学习时间分成几个短任务，通过复习、听中文和练习造句，提高了学习效果。
articles.topic: 把生词带在身边
paragraphs: 林月在城南中学学习中文。以前，她放学后常常一次学两个小时，可是第二天还是会忘记很多生词。她也怕开口说错，所以小组活动时总是听别人说。
后来，她重新安排了每天的学习。早饭前，她先用卡片复习十个生词，把还不认识的词放在书包里。坐公共汽车上学时，她再听十五分钟中文，注意说话人的语气。
晚上写完作业，她从卡片里选三个词，写进当天的日记。第二天，她请同桌读一读，并问句子是不是自然。如果同桌指出问题，她就马上修改，还用新句子回答一个问题。
一个月后，林月没有增加学习时间，却能更快地记住词语。中文老师发现她在课堂上说得更清楚了，也更愿意参加讨论。现在，她每周日检查一次卡片，并按照自己的困难改变下周的计划。
pinyin: lín yuè zài chéng nán zhōng xué xué xí zhōng wén 。 yǐ qián ， tā fàng xué hòu cháng cháng yī cì xué liǎng gè xiǎo shí ， kě shì dì èr tiān hái shì huì wàng jì hěn duō shēng cí 。 tā yě pà kāi kǒu shuō cuò ， suǒ yǐ xiǎo zǔ huó dòng shí zǒng shì tīng bié rén shuō 。

hòu lái ， tā chóng xīn ān pái le měi tiān de xué xí 。 zǎo fàn qián ， tā xiān yòng kǎ piàn fù xí shí gè shēng cí ， bǎ hái bù rèn shí de cí fàng zài shū bāo lǐ 。 zuò gōng gòng qì chē shàng xué shí ， tā zài tīng shí wǔ fēn zhōng zhōng wén ， zhù yì shuō huà rén de yǔ qì 。

wǎn shàng xiě wán zuò yè ， tā cóng kǎ piàn lǐ xuǎn sān gè cí ， xiě jìn dàng tiān de rì jì 。 dì èr tiān ， tā qǐng tóng zhuō dú yī dú ， bìng wèn jù zi shì bú shì zì rán 。 rú guǒ tóng zhuō zhǐ chū wèn tí ， tā jiù mǎ shàng xiū gǎi ， hái yòng xīn jù zi huí dá yí gè wèn tí 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， lín yuè méi yǒu zēng jiā xué xí shí jiān ， què néng gèng kuài dì jì zhù cí yǔ 。 zhōng wén lǎo shī fā xiàn tā zài kè táng shàng shuō dé gèng qīng chǔ le ， yě gèng yuàn yì cān jiā tǎo lùn 。 xiàn zài ， tā měi zhōu rì jiǎn chá yī cì kǎ piàn ， bìng àn zhào zì jǐ de kùn nán gǎi biàn xià zhōu de jì huà 。
translation: Lin Yue studies Chinese at Chengnan Middle School. In the past, she often studied for two hours at a time after school, but she still forgot many new words the next day. She was also afraid of saying something wrong, so she always listened to others during group activities.

Later, she reorganized her daily study routine. Before breakfast, she first reviewed ten new words with cards and put the words she still did not know into her schoolbag. While taking the bus to school, she listened to Chinese for another fifteen minutes and paid attention to the speakers' tone.

After finishing her homework in the evening, she chose three words from the cards and wrote them in her diary for that day. The next day, she asked her deskmate to read it and asked whether the sentences sounded natural. If her deskmate pointed out a problem, she corrected it immediately and also used a new sentence to answer a question.

After one month, Lin Yue had not increased her study time, but she could remember words more quickly. Her Chinese teacher noticed that she spoke more clearly in class and was also more willing to join discussions. Now, she checks her cards every Sunday and changes the plan for the following week according to her own difficulties.

articles.title: 王涛的两次录音
articles.summary: 王涛通过录音、记下错误和再次比较，找到了更有效的汉语学习方法。
articles.topic: 王涛的两次录音
paragraphs: 王涛在学校学汉语。每周三，老师都会请大家读一段课文。以前，他晚上读很多遍，觉得自己已经会了，可是第二天站起来读时，还是常常把几个字读错。
后来，他想到一个新办法。早上出门前，他先用手机录下自己的声音，只读一次。坐地铁时，他戴上耳机听录音，把听起来不对的地方写在小本子上。
午饭后，王涛不马上看答案，而是再读一遍，然后比较两次录音。如果第二次读对了，他就在那个字旁边画一颗星；如果还不对，他就去问老师。
两个星期后，老师又请他读课文。这一次，他读得更清楚，也没有以前那么紧张。王涛发现，少读几遍并不等于少学习，认真检查才能找到真正的问题。
pinyin: wáng tāo zài xué xiào xué hàn yǔ 。 měi zhōu sān ， lǎo shī dū huì qǐng dà jiā dú yī duàn kè wén 。 yǐ qián ， tā wǎn shàng dú hěn duō biàn ， jué de zì jǐ yǐ jīng huì le ， kě shì dì èr tiān zhàn qǐ lái dú shí ， hái shì cháng cháng bǎ jǐ gè zì dú cuò 。

wǔ fàn hòu ， wáng tāo bù mǎ shàng kàn dá àn ， ér shì zài dú yī biàn ， rán hòu bǐ jiào liǎng cì lù yīn 。 rú guǒ dì èr cì dú duì le ， tā jiù zài nà ge zì páng biān huà yī kē xīng ； rú guǒ hái bú duì ， tā jiù qù wèn lǎo shī 。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， lǎo shī yòu qǐng tā dú kè wén 。 zhè yī cì ， tā dú dé gèng qīng chǔ ， yě méi yǒu yǐ qián nà me jǐn zhāng 。 wáng tāo fā xiàn ， shǎo dú jǐ biàn bìng bù děng yú shǎo xué xí ， rèn zhēn jiǎn chá cái néng zhǎo dào zhēn zhèng de wèn tí 。
translation: Wang Tao studies Chinese at school. Every Wednesday, the teacher asks everyone to read a passage. In the past, he read it many times at night and thought he had already learned it, but when he stood up to read the next day, he still often pronounced several characters incorrectly.

Later, he came up with a new method. Before leaving home in the morning, he used his phone to record his own voice and read the passage only once. While riding the subway, he listened to the recording with earphones and wrote down the parts that sounded incorrect in a small notebook.

After lunch, Wang Tao did not look at the answers right away. Instead, he read the passage again and then compared the two recordings. If he read a character correctly the second time, he drew a star next to it; if it was still incorrect, he asked the teacher.

Two weeks later, the teacher asked him to read a passage again. This time, he read more clearly and was not as nervous as before. Wang Tao discovered that reading fewer times does not mean studying less; only careful checking can reveal the real problems.

articles.title: 赵雪的问号卡片
articles.summary: 赵雪用一张卡片安排学习顺序，并通过记录问题找到适合自己的学习方法。
articles.topic: 赵雪的问号卡片
paragraphs: 赵雪以前一回家就打开练习本，看到哪一页就做哪一页。她每天学很久，可是第二天常常忘记昨天的语法。一次小测验以后，她发现自己不是不认真，而是学习没有顺序。
星期一，她做了一张小卡片：先复习昨天的语法，再做五道练习，最后把错题读两遍。如果有一道题不明白，她就在旁边画一个问号，第二天去问老师。为了不被手机影响，她学习时把手机放在客厅。
刚开始，赵雪觉得这样做有点慢。三天后，她发现错题越来越少，回答问题也更快了。周五的小测验中，她只有一道题做错。老师看了她的卡片，建议她周末不要增加练习，只要看看一周的问号。
星期天晚上，赵雪把所有问号分成语法和生词两类。她终于明白，改进学习不是一天做很多题，而是知道先做什么，并认真找出不懂的地方。下周，她还准备给每项学习活动写上时间。
pinyin: zhào xuě yǐ qián yī huí jiā jiù dǎ kāi liàn xí běn ， kàn dào nǎ yī yè jiù zuò nǎ yī yè 。 tā měi tiān xué hěn jiǔ ， kě shì dì èr tiān cháng cháng wàng jì zuó tiān de yǔ fǎ 。 yī cì xiǎo cè yàn yǐ hòu ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ bú shì bù rèn zhēn ， ér shì xué xí méi yǒu shùn xù 。

gāng kāi shǐ ， zhào xuě jué de zhè yàng zuò yǒu diǎn màn 。 sān tiān hòu ， tā fā xiàn cuò tí yuè lái yuè shǎo ， huí dá wèn tí yě gèng kuài le 。 zhōu wǔ de xiǎo cè yàn zhōng ， tā zhǐ yǒu yī dào tí zuò cuò 。 lǎo shī kàn le tā de kǎ piàn ， jiàn yì tā zhōu mò bú yào zēng jiā liàn xí ， zhǐ yào kàn kàn yī zhōu de wèn hào 。

xīng qī tiān wǎn shàng ， zhào xuě bǎ suǒ yǒu wèn hào fēn chéng yǔ fǎ hé shēng cí liǎng lèi 。 tā zhōng yú míng bái ， gǎi jìn xué xí bú shì yī tiān zuò hěn duō tí ， ér shì zhī dào xiān zuò shén me ， bìng rèn zhēn zhǎo chū bù dǒng de dì fāng 。 xià zhōu ， tā hái zhǔn bèi gěi měi xiàng xué xí huó dòng xiě shàng shí jiān 。
translation: Zhao Xue used to open her exercise book as soon as she got home and work on whichever page she happened to see. She studied for a long time every day, but she often forgot the grammar from the previous day. After a quiz, she realized that it was not because she did not study seriously, but because she had no clear order in her studying.

On Monday, she made a small card: first review the grammar from the previous day, then do five exercises, and finally read each incorrect question twice. If she did not understand a question, she drew a question mark beside it and asked her teacher the next day. To avoid being distracted by her phone, she put it in the living room while studying.

At first, Zhao Xue felt that studying this way was a little slow. Three days later, she noticed that she was making fewer and fewer mistakes and answering questions more quickly. She got only one question wrong on Friday's quiz. After looking at her card, the teacher suggested that she should not add more exercises over the weekend and should simply review the question marks from the week.

On Sunday evening, Zhao Xue divided all the question marks into two groups: grammar and new words. She finally understood that improving her studies did not mean doing many questions in one day. It meant knowing what to do first and carefully finding the areas she did not understand. The following week, she also planned to write a time beside each study activity.

articles.title: 陈东的句子记录法
articles.summary: 陈东把生活中不会说的话记下来，每晚练习，慢慢提高了汉语口语。
articles.topic: 陈东的句子记录法
paragraphs: 陈东学汉语半年了。以前，他每天晚上都用一个小时读课文，可是第二天常常忘记学过的词。他发现，只看书不一定有用，所以决定换一种学习方法。
白天上课或买东西时，他把不会说的话记在手机里。比如，有一次他想问水果店老板哪种苹果更甜，却不知道怎么说。回家后，他先查词典，再写下完整的句子。
晚饭后，陈东不马上看新课，而是打开白天的记录。他大声读每个句子，还用这些句子讲一件当天发生的事。读错的时候，他会再听课文里的声音，然后重新读。
一个月后，他去同一家水果店，不但问清了苹果的味道，还和老板聊了几句。老板笑着说：“你的汉语进步了！”陈东很高兴，也明白了：每天解决几个真正遇到的问题，比只记很多词更适合自己。
pinyin: chén dōng xué hàn yǔ bàn nián le 。 yǐ qián ， tā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu yòng yí gè xiǎo shí dú kè wén ， kě shì dì èr tiān cháng cháng wàng jì xué guò de cí 。 tā fā xiàn ， zhǐ kàn shū bù yí dìng yǒu yòng ， suǒ yǐ jué dìng huàn yī zhǒng xué xí fāng fǎ 。

bái tiān shàng kè huò mǎi dōng xī shí ， tā bǎ bú huì shuō de huà jì zài shǒu jī lǐ 。 bǐ rú ， yǒu yī cì tā xiǎng wèn shuǐ guǒ diàn lǎo bǎn nǎ zhǒng píng guǒ gèng tián ， què bù zhī dào zěn me shuō 。 huí jiā hòu ， tā xiān chá cí diǎn ， zài xiě xià wán zhěng de jù zi 。

wǎn fàn hòu ， chén dōng bù mǎ shàng kàn xīn kè ， ér shì dǎ kāi bái tiān de jì lù 。 tā dà shēng dú měi gè jù zi ， hái yòng zhè xiē jù zi jiǎng yī jiàn dàng tiān fā shēng de shì 。 dú cuò de shí hòu ， tā huì zài tīng kè wén lǐ de shēng yīn ， rán hòu chóng xīn dú 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， tā qù tóng yī jiā shuǐ guǒ diàn ， bù dàn wèn qīng le píng guǒ de wèi dào ， hái hé lǎo bǎn liáo le jǐ jù 。 lǎo bǎn xiào zhe shuō ：“ nǐ de hàn yǔ jìn bù le ！” chén dōng hěn gāo xìng ， yě míng bái le ： měi tiān jiě jué jǐ gè zhēn zhèng yù dào de wèn tí ， bǐ zhǐ jì hěn duō cí gèng shì hé zì jǐ 。
translation: Chen Dong has studied Chinese for half a year. In the past, he spent an hour reading the text every evening, but he often forgot the words he had learned the next day. He realized that reading alone was not always useful, so he decided to try a different study method.

During the day, when he was in class or shopping, he recorded things he did not know how to say on his phone. For example, once he wanted to ask the owner of a fruit shop which kind of apple was sweeter, but he did not know how to say it. After returning home, he first checked the dictionary and then wrote down the complete sentence.

After dinner, Chen Dong did not start a new lesson right away. Instead, he opened his notes from the day. He read every sentence aloud and also used those sentences to talk about something that had happened that day. When he read something incorrectly, he listened to the audio from the lesson again and then reread it.

A month later, he went to the same fruit shop. He not only asked clearly about the taste of the apples but also chatted with the owner for a while. The owner smiled and said, “Your Chinese has improved!” Chen Dong was very happy and also understood that solving a few problems he actually encountered each day suited him better than simply memorizing many words.

articles.title: 刘佳不只背生词了
articles.summary: 刘佳改变了只背生词的学习方法，通过造句、复习和对话记住新词，也变得更敢说中文。
articles.topic: 刘佳不只背生词了
paragraphs: 刘佳以前每天背很多生词，可是到了说话的时候，她常常想不起来。上个月，她请中文老师看了自己的学习本。老师发现，她只写词语和意思，很少写句子，也没有回头检查以前学过的内容。
从那天起，刘佳换了一个办法。每天晚上，她先用十五分钟复习本周的词表，再选出五个词，各写一个和生活有关的句子。第二天中午，她带着这些句子去找同学，两个人用新词谈天气、买东西和周末活动。
开始时，刘佳说得很慢，有时还会用错词。同学没有马上告诉她答案，而是请她再说一遍。
一个月后，她发现自己不但记得更久，而且说话时更有信心。现在她不再只看词表，也会听、写和说。她觉得，认真使用新词比一次背很多词更有帮助。
pinyin: liú jiā yǐ qián měi tiān bèi hěn duō shēng cí ， kě shì dào le shuō huà de shí hòu ， tā cháng cháng xiǎng bù qǐ lái 。 shàng gè yuè ， tā qǐng zhōng wén lǎo shī kàn le zì jǐ de xué xí běn 。 lǎo shī fā xiàn ， tā zhǐ xiě cí yǔ hé yì si ， hěn shǎo xiě jù zi ， yě méi yǒu huí tóu jiǎn chá yǐ qián xué guò de nèi róng 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ bù dàn jì de gèng jiǔ ， ér qiě shuō huà shí gèng yǒu xìn xīn 。 xiàn zài tā bù zài zhǐ kàn cí biǎo ， yě huì tīng 、 xiě hé shuō 。 tā jué de ， rèn zhēn shǐ yòng xīn cí bǐ yī cì bèi hěn duō cí gèng yǒu bāng zhù 。
translation: Liu Jia used to memorize many new words every day, but when it was time to speak, she often could not remember them. Last month, she asked her Chinese teacher to look at her study notebook. The teacher found that she only wrote down words and their meanings, rarely wrote sentences, and did not go back to check what she had learned before.

From that day on, Liu Jia tried a different method. Every evening, she first spent fifteen minutes reviewing the week's word list. Then she chose five words and wrote a sentence related to her life for each one. At noon the next day, she took these sentences to a classmate, and they used the new words to talk about the weather, shopping, and weekend activities.
At first, Liu Jia spoke slowly and sometimes used the wrong word. Her classmate did not tell her the answer immediately but asked her to say it again.

After a month, she found that she could remember words longer and felt more confident when speaking. Now she does not only read word lists; she also listens, writes, and speaks. She thinks using new words carefully is more helpful than memorizing many words at one time.

articles.title: 把复习分到一天里
articles.summary: 孙文把重要句子写在卡片上，并在不同时间检查，终于找到了更有效的学习方法。
articles.topic: 把复习分到一天里
paragraphs: 孙文以前总觉得，只要上课认真听，回家就不用再看课文。可是第二天老师提问时，他常常记不清昨天学过的内容。有一次，他把“图书馆”说成了“书店”，同学们笑了，他也有点不好意思。
那天放学后，孙文没有马上离开教室。他拿出几张小卡片，在正面写下课文里的重要句子，在背面写上意思和自己的例子。写完以后，他先把卡片放进书包，没有立刻读第二遍。
吃过晚饭，他才拿出卡片检查。能说对的放在左边，说不对的放在右边。十分钟后，他只复习右边的卡片。睡觉前，他又请姐姐随便选三张，让自己不看答案说一遍。
一个星期以后，老师又问到那篇课文。孙文不但答对了问题，还用新词讲了自己的周末计划。从那以后，他每天做五张卡片，不再一次学很久，而是在不同时间检查几次。

nà tiān fàng xué hòu ， sūn wén méi yǒu mǎ shàng lí kāi jiào shì 。 tā ná chū jǐ zhāng xiǎo kǎ piàn ， zài zhèng miàn xiě xià kè wén lǐ de zhòng yào jù zi ， zài bèi miàn xiě shàng yì si hé zì jǐ de lì zi 。 xiě wán yǐ hòu ， tā xiān bǎ kǎ piàn fàng jìn shū bāo ， méi yǒu lì kè dú dì èr biàn 。

chī guò wǎn fàn ， tā cái ná chū kǎ piàn jiǎn chá 。 néng shuō duì de fàng zài zuǒ biān ， shuō bú duì de fàng zài yòu biān 。 shí fēn zhōng hòu ， tā zhǐ fù xí yòu biān de kǎ piàn 。 shuì jiào qián ， tā yòu qǐng jiě jiě suí biàn xuǎn sān zhāng ， ràng zì jǐ bù kàn dá àn shuō yī biàn 。

yí gè xīng qī yǐ hòu ， lǎo shī yòu wèn dào nà piān kè wén 。 sūn wén bù dàn dá duì le wèn tí ， hái yòng xīn cí jiǎng le zì jǐ de zhōu mò jì huà 。 cóng nà yǐ hòu ， tā měi tiān zuò wǔ zhāng kǎ piàn ， bù zài yī cì xué hěn jiǔ ， ér shì zài bù tóng shí jiān jiǎn chá jǐ cì 。
translation: Sun Wen used to think that as long as he listened carefully in class, he would not need to read the text again at home. However, when the teacher asked questions the next day, he often could not remember what he had learned the day before. Once, he said “bookstore” instead of “library.” His classmates laughed, and he felt a little embarrassed.

After school that day, Sun Wen did not leave the classroom right away. He took out several small cards, wrote important sentences from the text on the front, and added their meanings and his own examples on the back. When he finished, he put the cards in his schoolbag without reading them a second time immediately.

After dinner, he took out the cards and checked himself. He put the ones he could say correctly on the left and the ones he could not say correctly on the right. Ten minutes later, he reviewed only the cards on the right. Before going to bed, he also asked his older sister to choose three cards at random so that he could say them again without looking at the answers.

A week later, the teacher asked about that text again. Sun Wen not only answered the question correctly, but also used the new words to talk about his weekend plans. From then on, he made five cards every day. Instead of studying for a long time all at once, he checked them several times at different times.

articles.title: 三张卡片改变了周婷的日记
articles.summary: 周婷用量词卡片复习，并通过写日记和请同桌检查，逐渐减少了错误。
articles.topic: 三张卡片改变了周婷的日记
paragraphs: 周婷最近发现，自己认识不少生词，可是写日记时常常用错“本、件、条”这些量词。星期一晚上，她没有马上做新练习，而是把老师改过的作业放在桌上，找出所有量词错误。
她给自己定了一个简单的顺序：先复习，再写作。她把“本、件、条”分别写在三张卡片上，并在每个量词下面写了两个例子。复习完，她合上课本，用这些量词写了一段当天的日记。
第二天，周婷请同桌林月帮她检查。林月没有直接告诉她答案，只在有问题的地方画了一条线。周婷自己想了一会儿，改对了两处，还发现“一个新闻”应该写成“一条新闻”。
一周后，周婷的量词错误少多了，日记也比以前更清楚。她觉得这个方法并不难，重要的是每天按顺序练习。现在，她写完日记还会读一遍，再把新的错误记在卡片背面。
pinyin: zhōu tíng zuì jìn fā xiàn ， zì jǐ rèn shí bù shǎo shēng cí ， kě shì xiě rì jì shí cháng cháng yòng cuò “ běn 、 jiàn 、 tiáo ” zhè xiē liàng cí 。 xīng qī yī wǎn shàng ， tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng zuò xīn liàn xí ， ér shì bǎ lǎo shī gǎi guò de zuò yè fàng zài zhuō shàng ， zhǎo chū suǒ yǒu liàng cí cuò wù 。

tā gěi zì jǐ dìng le yí gè jiǎn dān de shùn xù ： xiān fù xí ， zài xiě zuò 。 tā bǎ “ běn 、 jiàn 、 tiáo ” fēn bié xiě zài sān zhāng kǎ piàn shàng ， bìng zài měi gè liàng cí xià miàn xiě le liǎng gè lì zi 。 fù xí wán ， tā hé shàng kè běn ， yòng zhè xiē liàng cí xiě le yī duàn dàng tiān de rì jì 。

dì èr tiān ， zhōu tíng qǐng tóng zhuō lín yuè bāng tā jiǎn chá 。 lín yuè méi yǒu zhí jiē gào sù tā dá àn ， zhǐ zài yǒu wèn tí de dì fāng huà le yī tiáo xiàn 。 zhōu tíng zì jǐ xiǎng le yī huì er ， gǎi duì le liǎng chù ， hái fā xiàn “ yí gè xīn wén ” yīng gāi xiě chéng “ yī tiáo xīn wén ”。

yī zhōu hòu ， zhōu tíng de liàng cí cuò wù shǎo duō le ， rì jì yě bǐ yǐ qián gèng qīng chǔ 。 tā jué de zhè ge fāng fǎ bìng bù nán ， zhòng yào de shì měi tiān àn shùn xù liàn xí 。 xiàn zài ， tā xiě wán rì jì hái huì dú yī biàn ， zài bǎ xīn de cuò wù jì zài kǎ piàn bèi miàn 。
translation: Zhou Ting recently noticed that she knew quite a few new words, but she often used classifiers such as ben, jian, and tiao incorrectly when writing her diary. On Monday evening, instead of starting a new exercise right away, she put the homework corrected by her teacher on the desk and found all of her classifier mistakes.

She established a simple routine for herself: review first, then write. She wrote ben, jian, and tiao on three separate cards, with two examples beneath each classifier. After reviewing, she closed her textbook and used these classifiers to write a diary entry about that day.

The next day, Zhou Ting asked her deskmate Lin Yue to check her diary. Lin Yue did not tell her the answers directly; she only marked the places that had problems with a line. Zhou Ting thought for a while, corrected two mistakes, and also realized that yi ge xinwen, using ge, should be written as yi tiao xinwen, using tiao.

A week later, Zhou Ting made far fewer classifier mistakes, and her diary was clearer than before. She felt that the method was not difficult; the important thing was to practice in order every day. Now, after finishing a diary entry, she also reads it once and then records new mistakes on the backs of the cards.

articles.title: 三种颜色的学习记录
articles.summary: 吴亮用不同颜色整理每天的错误，并通过每周复习逐渐提高了中文水平。
articles.topic: 三种颜色的学习记录
paragraphs: 吴亮学中文时，常常认识课本里的词，可是一说话就用错。以前，他只把错的答案改好，很快又忘了。后来，他准备了一个小本子，上课、聊天或做作业时发现问题，就马上记下来。
每天晚上九点，他会打开白天的记录。他不用很长时间，只把错误分成三类：蓝色是生词，绿色是句子，红色是读音。每个错误下面，他都写一个正确的例子，还会大声读两遍。
星期五，他不学习新内容，而是看这一周的记录。他先不看正确答案，再自己说一次。如果还是说错，就在旁边画一个小星星，下周继续练习；如果说对了，就写一个“好”字。
一个月后，本子里的小星星越来越少。吴亮在中文课上回答问题时，也比以前更快了。他发现，改进学习不一定要每天多做很多题，重要的是知道自己为什么错，并用简单的方法再练一次。
pinyin: wú liàng xué zhōng wén shí ， cháng cháng rèn shí kè běn lǐ de cí ， kě shì yī shuō huà jiù yòng cuò 。 yǐ qián ， tā zhǐ bǎ cuò de dá àn gǎi hǎo ， hěn kuài yòu wàng le 。 hòu lái ， tā zhǔn bèi le yí gè xiǎo běn zi ， shàng kè 、 liáo tiān huò zuò zuò yè shí fā xiàn wèn tí ， jiù mǎ shàng jì xià lái 。

měi tiān wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn ， tā huì dǎ kāi bái tiān de jì lù 。 tā bù yòng hěn zhǎng shí jiān ， zhǐ bǎ cuò wù fēn chéng sān lèi ： lán sè shì shēng cí ， lǜ sè shì jù zi ， hóng sè shì dú yīn 。 měi gè cuò wù xià miàn ， tā dōu xiě yí gè zhèng què de lì zi ， hái huì dà shēng dú liǎng biàn 。

xīng qī wǔ ， tā bù xué xí xīn nèi róng ， ér shì kàn zhè yī zhōu de jì lù 。 tā xiān bù kàn zhèng què dá àn ， zài zì jǐ shuō yī cì 。 rú guǒ hái shì shuō cuò ， jiù zài páng biān huà yí gè xiǎo xīng xīng ， xià zhōu jì xù liàn xí ； rú guǒ shuō duì le ， jiù xiě yí gè “ hǎo ” zì 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， běn zi lǐ de xiǎo xīng xīng yuè lái yuè shǎo 。 wú liàng zài zhōng wén kè shàng huí dá wèn tí shí ， yě bǐ yǐ qián gèng kuài le 。 tā fā xiàn ， gǎi jìn xué xí bù yí dìng yào měi tiān duō zuò hěn duō tí ， zhòng yào de shì zhī dào zì jǐ wèi shén me cuò ， bìng yòng jiǎn dān de fāng fǎ zài liàn yī cì 。
translation: When Wu Liang studied Chinese, he often recognized words in the textbook but used them incorrectly as soon as he started speaking. In the past, he simply corrected his wrong answers and soon forgot them again. Later, he prepared a small notebook and immediately wrote down any problems he noticed in class, while chatting, or while doing homework.

At nine o'clock every evening, he opens the notes he made during the day. He does not spend a long time on them. He simply divides the mistakes into three groups: blue for new words, green for sentences, and red for pronunciation. Under each mistake, he writes a correct example and reads it aloud twice.

On Fridays, he does not study new material. Instead, he reviews the notes from that week. First, he tries saying each item again without looking at the correct answer. If he still gets it wrong, he draws a small star beside it and continues practicing it the next week. If he gets it right, he writes the word “good.”

After one month, there were fewer and fewer stars in the notebook. Wu Liang also became faster at answering questions in Chinese class. He realized that improving the way one studies does not necessarily mean doing many more exercises every day. What matters is understanding why a mistake happened and practicing it again with a simple method.

articles.title: 黄静的三色卡片
articles.summary: 黄静改变了原来的阅读方法，用三种颜色的卡片复习生词、整理短文内容，并请同学帮助修改句子。
articles.topic: 黄静的三色卡片
paragraphs: 黄静以前一打开中文书，就从第一页读到最后一页。遇到不认识的词，她马上查手机，常常读了半小时还没看完一小段。上周的考试结束以后，她发现自己记住的词不多，也说不清短文在说什么。
她没有让自己每天学得更久，而是准备了三种颜色的卡片。每天晚上，她先用白卡复习当天的生词，再把总是记错的词写在黄卡上。读完一篇短文后，她不用看书，在蓝卡上写下谁、在哪儿、做了什么。第二天早上，她只看黄卡和蓝卡。
两个星期后，黄静做题时快了一些，也能用自己的话介绍短文。她还发现蓝卡上的句子有时不完整，所以每周六请同学帮她改一次。
现在，她不会因为一个生词停很久，而会先读完一句，再想它的意思。这个办法让她学得更轻松，也更相信自己能学好。
pinyin: huáng jìng yǐ qián yī dǎ kāi zhōng wén shū ， jiù cóng dì yī yè dú dào zuì hòu yī yè 。 yù dào bù rèn shí de cí ， tā mǎ shàng chá shǒu jī ， cháng cháng dú le bàn xiǎo shí hái méi kàn wán yī xiǎo duàn 。 shàng zhōu de kǎo shì jié shù yǐ hòu ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ jì zhù de cí bù duō ， yě shuō bù qīng duǎn wén zài shuō shén me 。

tā méi yǒu ràng zì jǐ měi tiān xué dé gèng jiǔ ， ér shì zhǔn bèi le sān zhǒng yán sè de kǎ piàn 。 měi tiān wǎn shàng ， tā xiān yòng bái kǎ fù xí dàng tiān de shēng cí ， zài bǎ zǒng shì jì cuò de cí xiě zài huáng kǎ shàng 。 dú wán yī piān duǎn wén hòu ， tā bù yòng kàn shū ， zài lán kǎ shàng xiě xià shuí 、 zài nǎ ér 、 zuò le shén me 。 dì èr tiān zǎo shàng ， tā zhǐ kàn huáng kǎ hé lán kǎ 。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， huáng jìng zuò tí shí kuài le yī xiē ， yě néng yòng zì jǐ de huà jiè shào duǎn wén 。 tā hái fā xiàn lán kǎ shàng de jù zi yǒu shí bù wán zhěng ， suǒ yǐ měi zhōu liù qǐng tóng xué bāng tā gǎi yī cì 。
xiàn zài ， tā bú huì yīn wèi yí gè shēng cí tíng hěn jiǔ ， ér huì xiān dú wán yī jù ， zài xiǎng tā de yì si 。 zhè ge bàn fǎ ràng tā xué dé gèng qīng sōng ， yě gèng xiāng xìn zì jǐ néng xué hǎo 。
translation: In the past, whenever Huang Jing opened a Chinese book, she read from the first page to the last. When she met a word she did not know, she immediately looked it up on her phone. She often read for half an hour without finishing even a short section. After last week's exam, she realized that she had not remembered many words and could not clearly explain what the passage was about.

She did not make herself study longer each day. Instead, she prepared cards in three colors. Every evening, she first used the white cards to review the new words from that day, and then wrote the words she often got wrong on the yellow cards. After reading a passage, without looking at the book, she wrote on a blue card who was involved, where they were, and what they did. The next morning, she looked only at the yellow and blue cards.

Two weeks later, Huang Jing became a little faster at answering questions and could also describe a passage in her own words. She noticed that the sentences on the blue cards were sometimes incomplete, so every Saturday she asked a classmate to help correct them.

Now, she does not stop for a long time because of one new word. Instead, she finishes the sentence first and then thinks about the word's meaning. This method makes learning easier for her and makes her more confident that she can learn well.

articles.title: 星星越来越少了
articles.summary: 郑浩用小本子记下写错和漏写的字，第二天再次检查，并用星星找出需要继续练习的词。
articles.topic: 星星越来越少了
paragraphs: 郑浩以前每天晚上学半个小时汉字。他看着书读，也会认真写一遍。可是过了两三天，老师再问同样的字，他常常想不起来。有一次听写，他漏写了“城市”的“市”，才发现只学一次不够。
从那天起，他准备了一个小本子。每次写错或漏写，他不马上看答案，而是先想一想，再把正确的字写在本子上。第二天上课前，他会用五分钟检查：先盖住右边的答案，只看左边的词，然后重新写一遍。如果又错了，他就在词旁边画一个小星星。
一个星期后，本子上有星星的词越来越少。郑浩也不再害怕听写，因为他知道自己哪些字还没学好。
现在，他每周五还会请同桌从本子里选十个词考他。这个办法没有增加很多学习时间，却让他记得更清楚。郑浩明白了，发现错误以后再回来练习，比一直学新字更适合自己。
pinyin: zhèng hào yǐ qián měi tiān wǎn shàng xué bàn gè xiǎo shí hàn zì 。 tā kàn zhe shū dú ， yě huì rèn zhēn xiě yī biàn 。 kě shì guò le liǎng sān tiān ， lǎo shī zài wèn tóng yàng de zì ， tā cháng cháng xiǎng bù qǐ lái 。 yǒu yī cì tīng xiě ， tā lòu xiě le “ chéng shì ” de “ shì ”， cái fā xiàn zhǐ xué yī cì bù gòu 。

cóng nà tiān qǐ ， tā zhǔn bèi le yí gè xiǎo běn zi 。 měi cì xiě cuò huò lòu xiě ， tā bù mǎ shàng kàn dá àn ， ér shì xiān xiǎng yī xiǎng ， zài bǎ zhèng què de zì xiě zài běn zi shàng 。 dì èr tiān shàng kè qián ， tā huì yòng wǔ fēn zhōng jiǎn chá ： xiān gài zhù yòu biān de dá àn ， zhǐ kàn zuǒ biān de cí ， rán hòu chóng xīn xiě yī biàn 。 rú guǒ yòu cuò le ， tā jiù zài cí páng biān huà yí gè xiǎo xīng xīng 。
yí gè xīng qī hòu ， běn zi shàng yǒu xīng xīng de cí yuè lái yuè shǎo 。 zhèng hào yě bù zài hài pà tīng xiě ， yīn wèi tā zhī dào zì jǐ nǎ xiē zì hái méi xué hǎo 。

xiàn zài ， tā měi zhōu wǔ hái huì qǐng tóng zhuō cóng běn zi lǐ xuǎn shí gè cí kǎo tā 。 zhè ge bàn fǎ méi yǒu zēng jiā hěn duō xué xí shí jiān ， què ràng tā jì de gèng qīng chǔ 。 zhèng hào míng bái le ， fā xiàn cuò wù yǐ hòu zài huí lái liàn xí ， bǐ yì zhí xué xīn zì gèng shì hé zì jǐ 。
translation: Zheng Hao used to study Chinese characters for half an hour every evening. He read while looking at his book and carefully wrote each character once. However, when the teacher asked about the same characters two or three days later, he often could not remember them. During one dictation, he left out the second character of the word meaning “city,” and realized that studying something only once was not enough.

From that day on, he kept a small notebook. Whenever he wrote something incorrectly or left out a character, he did not look at the answer right away. Instead, he thought about it first and then wrote the correct character in the notebook. Before class the next day, he spent five minutes checking his work: he covered the answers on the right, looked only at the words on the left, and then wrote them again. If he made another mistake, he drew a small star beside the word.
A week later, there were fewer and fewer starred words in the notebook. Zheng Hao was no longer afraid of dictation because he knew which characters he had not yet learned well.

Now, every Friday, he also asks his deskmate to choose ten words from the notebook and test him. This method did not add much study time, but it helped him remember more clearly. Zheng Hao understood that returning to practice after finding mistakes suited him better than always learning new characters.

articles.title: 何倩把复习放在前面
articles.summary: 何倩调整每天的学习顺序，通过复习对话、跟读和自己讲述，提高了听说能力。
articles.topic: 何倩把复习放在前面
paragraphs: 何倩以前每天一回家就做新练习，可是上课学过的内容常常很快忘记。一次，她在课堂上听懂了老师的问题，却不知道怎么回答。老师请她不要急着多做题，先找出每天最需要复习的内容。
从第二天开始，何倩改变了顺序。晚饭后，她先看一遍上节课的对话，把不明白的词写在本子上，再听录音跟读十分钟。读完以后，她合上书，用自己的话说一说对话的意思。如果说不出来，她就回去再看一次。
两个星期后，老师又请大家两个人一组练习。何倩虽然还说得不快，但是这次没有一直看书，也能听懂同学的新问题。
她发现，少做几道新题并没有让学习变慢，认真复习反而让她记得更清楚。现在，她每周日还会检查本子，决定下周要多练什么。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， lǎo shī yòu qǐng dà jiā liǎng gè rén yī zǔ liàn xí 。 hé qiàn suī rán hái shuō dé bù kuài ， dàn shì zhè cì méi yǒu yì zhí kàn shū ， yě néng tīng dǒng tóng xué de xīn wèn tí 。

tā fā xiàn ， shǎo zuò jǐ dào xīn tí bìng méi yǒu ràng xué xí biàn màn ， rèn zhēn fù xí fǎn ér ràng tā jì de gèng qīng chǔ 。 xiàn zài ， tā měi zhōu rì hái huì jiǎn chá běn zi ， jué dìng xià zhōu yào duō liàn shén me 。
translation: In the past, He Qian started doing new exercises as soon as she got home every day, but she often quickly forgot what she had learned in class. Once, she understood the teacher's question in class but did not know how to answer it. The teacher asked her not to rush into doing more exercises and to first identify what she most needed to review each day.

Starting the next day, He Qian changed the order of her study activities. After dinner, she first read the dialogue from the previous lesson, wrote the words she did not understand in her notebook, and then listened to the recording and repeated it for ten minutes. After reading, she closed the book and explained the meaning of the dialogue in her own words. If she could not explain it, she went back and read it again.

Two weeks later, the teacher again asked everyone to practice in pairs. Although He Qian still did not speak quickly, this time she did not keep looking at the book and could also understand her classmate's new questions.

She discovered that doing a few fewer new exercises did not slow down her learning; careful review actually helped her remember things more clearly. Now she also checks her notebook every Sunday and decides what she needs to practice more the following week.
