articles.title: 马超的星期五学习法
articles.summary: 马超通过记录错误、分析原因和再次检查，逐渐找到了更有效的汉语学习方法。
articles.topic: 马超的星期五学习法
paragraphs: 马超学汉语时，常常分不清意思相近的词。为了找到自己的问题，他每天把用错的词和句子记在手机里。星期五晚上，他会打开白天的记录，但不急着背答案，而是先读一遍，想想自己为什么会错。
以前，他只是把错题重做一遍，下周遇到相同的用法，还是可能选错。后来，他把问题分成三类：没有看懂词义、忘了句子的顺序、说话时太着急。找出原因以后，他会查词典，也会请教老师，再用那个词写一个和自己生活有关的新句子。
有一次，他总把“才”和“就”用反。老师解释后，他写下“我八点才到学校”和“我七点就到了学校”，还把这两个句子说给同学听。
两周后，他又检查这条记录，发现自己已经能正确使用了。现在，他的记录越来越短，上课回答问题也更有信心。
pinyin: mǎ chāo xué hàn yǔ shí ， cháng cháng fēn bù qīng yì si xiāng jìn de cí 。 wèi le zhǎo dào zì jǐ de wèn tí ， tā měi tiān bǎ yòng cuò de cí hé jù zi jì zài shǒu jī lǐ 。 xīng qī wǔ wǎn shàng ， tā huì dǎ kāi bái tiān de jì lù ， dàn bù jí zhe bèi dá àn ， ér shì xiān dú yī biàn ， xiǎng xiǎng zì jǐ wèi shén me huì cuò 。

yǐ qián ， tā zhǐ shì bǎ cuò tí zhòng zuò yī biàn ， xià zhōu yù dào xiāng tóng de yòng fǎ ， hái shì kě néng xuǎn cuò 。 hòu lái ， tā bǎ wèn tí fēn chéng sān lèi ： méi yǒu kàn dǒng cí yì 、 wàng le jù zi de shùn xù 、 shuō huà shí tài zháo jí 。 zhǎo chū yuán yīn yǐ hòu ， tā huì chá cí diǎn ， yě huì qǐng jiào lǎo shī ， zài yòng nà ge cí xiě yí gè hé zì jǐ shēng huó yǒu guān de xīn jù zi 。

yǒu yī cì ， tā zǒng bǎ “ cái ” hé “ jiù ” yòng fǎn 。 lǎo shī jiě shì hòu ， tā xiě xià “ wǒ bā diǎn cái dào xué xiào ” hé “ wǒ qī diǎn jiù dào le xué xiào ”， hái bǎ zhè liǎng gè jù zi shuō gěi tóng xué tīng 。
liǎng zhōu hòu ， tā yòu jiǎn chá zhè tiáo jì lù ， fā xiàn zì jǐ yǐ jīng néng zhèng què shǐ yòng le 。 xiàn zài ， tā de jì lù yuè lái yuè duǎn ， shàng kè huí dá wèn tí yě gèng yǒu xìn xīn 。
translation: When Ma Chao studied Chinese, he often had trouble telling apart words with similar meanings. To identify his problems, he recorded the words and sentences he used incorrectly on his phone every day. On Friday evenings, he would open the records from earlier that day, but instead of immediately memorizing the answers, he first read them and thought about why he had made each mistake.

In the past, he simply redid the questions he had answered incorrectly, but he might still choose the wrong answer when he encountered the same usage the following week. Later, he divided his problems into three types: not understanding a word's meaning, forgetting the order of a sentence, and speaking too hurriedly. After identifying the cause, he would consult a dictionary and ask his teacher for help, and then use the word to write a new sentence related to his own life.

Once, he kept mixing up “cai” and “jiu.” After his teacher explained them, he wrote, “I did not arrive at school until eight o'clock” and “I arrived at school as early as seven o'clock,” and he also said both sentences to a classmate.

Two weeks later, he checked that record again and found that he could already use them correctly. Now, his notes are getting shorter and shorter, and he is also more confident when answering questions in class.

articles.title: 高琳的新学习表
articles.summary: 高琳发现只写生词不能提高口语，于是重新安排复习、错题检查和口语练习，学习效果慢慢变好。
articles.topic: 高琳的新学习表
paragraphs: 开学以后，高琳发现自己认识不少汉字，可是上课回答问题时，她常常想不起合适的词。以前，她每天把生词写三遍，却很少开口，所以学过的词不能马上用出来。
她给自己做了一张简单的学习表。早饭后，她先复习昨天的课文，并用三个生词各写一句话。下午做完作业，她不马上看新的内容，而是检查错题，想一想为什么做错。
每周二和周四，高琳会早到学校二十分钟。她请老师和她练习口语，话题有买东西、问路和周末计划。说错的时候，老师不急着告诉她答案，只请她再说一次。她也把不懂的问题记在小本子上。
一个月后，高琳还是会说错，但她回答问题比以前快了，也更愿意参加课堂活动。她明白，学习不是做得越多越好，重要的是知道自己的问题，再用合适的方法练习。

yí gè yuè hòu ， gāo lín hái shì huì shuō cuò ， dàn tā huí dá wèn tí bǐ yǐ qián kuài le ， yě gèng yuàn yì cān jiā kè táng huó dòng 。 tā míng bái ， xué xí bú shì zuò dé yuè duō yuè hǎo ， zhòng yào de shì zhī dào zì jǐ de wèn tí ， zài yòng hé shì de fāng fǎ liàn xí 。
translation: After the new term began, Gao Lin found that she knew quite a few Chinese characters, but she often could not think of the right words when answering questions in class. In the past, she wrote each new word three times every day but rarely spoke, so she could not use the words she had learned right away.

She made a simple study schedule for herself. After breakfast, she first reviewed the previous day's text and wrote one sentence with each of three new words. After finishing her homework in the afternoon, she did not immediately study new material. Instead, she checked her mistakes and thought about why she had made them.

Every Tuesday and Thursday, Gao Lin arrived at school twenty minutes early. She asked her teacher to practice speaking with her, using topics such as shopping, asking for directions, and weekend plans. When she made a mistake, the teacher did not rush to give her the answer and simply asked her to say it again. She also wrote questions she did not understand in a small notebook.

A month later, Gao Lin still made mistakes, but she answered questions faster than before and was more willing to take part in classroom activities. She understood that studying is not about doing as much as possible. What matters is recognizing her own problems and then practicing in a suitable way.

articles.summary: 谢宇改变只听一次录音的习惯，把没听清的数字记下来，第二天重新听并检查，后来听数字更准确了。
articles.topic: 谢宇把问题留到第二天
paragraphs: 谢宇每天晚上用手机学习汉语。他常常把一段录音听完，就马上开始下一课。可是第二天上课时，老师问起录音里的时间和价格，他总是想不起来。有一次，他把“八点半”听成了“八点”，差点儿坐错车。
他决定改变学习方法。每次遇到没听清的数字，他先停下录音，把自己听到的内容和问题写在本子上，但不立刻看答案。
第二天中午，他再听一遍，然后检查答案，并用那个数字说一个新句子。这样做只要十分钟。
两个星期后，老师又放了一段关于买票的录音。谢宇不但听清了出发时间，还记住了票的价格。他发现，隔一天再检查比同一天多听几次更有用。现在，他学完新课以后都会留下几个问题，第二天再回答。
pinyin: xiè yǔ měi tiān wǎn shàng yòng shǒu jī xué xí hàn yǔ 。 tā cháng cháng bǎ yī duàn lù yīn tīng wán ， jiù mǎ shàng kāi shǐ xià yī kè 。 kě shì dì èr tiān shàng kè shí ， lǎo shī wèn qǐ lù yīn lǐ de shí jiān hé jià gé ， tā zǒng shì xiǎng bù qǐ lái 。 yǒu yī cì ， tā bǎ “ bā diǎn bàn ” tīng chéng le “ bā diǎn ”， chà diǎn ér zuò cuò chē 。
tā jué dìng gǎi biàn xué xí fāng fǎ 。 měi cì yù dào méi tīng qīng de shù zì ， tā xiān tíng xià lù yīn ， bǎ zì jǐ tīng dào de nèi róng hé wèn tí xiě zài běn zi shàng ， dàn bù lì kè kàn dá àn 。
dì èr tiān zhōng wǔ ， tā zài tīng yī biàn ， rán hòu jiǎn chá dá àn ， bìng yòng nà ge shù zì shuō yí gè xīn jù zi 。 zhè yàng zuò zhǐ yào shí fēn zhōng 。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， lǎo shī yòu fàng le yī duàn guān yú mǎi piào de lù yīn 。 xiè yǔ bù dàn tīng qīng le chū fā shí jiān ， hái jì zhù le piào de jià gé 。 tā fā xiàn ， gé yī tiān zài jiǎn chá bǐ tóng yī tiān duō tīng jǐ cì gèng yǒu yòng 。 xiàn zài ， tā xué wán xīn kè yǐ hòu dū huì liú xià jǐ gè wèn tí ， dì èr tiān zài huí dá 。
translation: Xie Yu studies Chinese on his phone every evening. He often finishes listening to one recording and immediately starts the next lesson. However, when his teacher asks about the times and prices in the recording the next day, he can never remember them. Once, he heard “eight thirty” as “eight o’clock” and almost took the wrong bus.

He decided to change the way he studied. Whenever he encounters a number he has not heard clearly, he first pauses the recording and writes down what he heard and his question in a notebook, but he does not look at the answer right away.
At noon the next day, he listens again, checks the answer, and uses that number in a new sentence. This only takes ten minutes.

Two weeks later, the teacher played another recording about buying tickets. Xie Yu not only heard the departure time clearly, but also remembered the ticket price. He found that checking again after a day was more useful than listening several times on the same day. Now, after finishing a new lesson, he always leaves himself a few questions and answers them the next day.

articles.title: 唐宁把故事读快了
articles.summary: 唐宁通过查看学习记录，改变复习顺序，并找到了更适合自己的学习方法。
articles.topic: 唐宁把故事读快了
paragraphs: 唐宁最近发现，自己每天学很久，第二天却常常忘记。他没有马上增加学习时间，而是打开笔记本，认真看了一个星期的学习记录。
他发现，自己以前一坐下就读长故事，遇到不懂的成语才去查。这样常常读到一半就累了，也记不清成语的意思。于是，他把学习顺序换了一下：先复习五个常用成语，再读一个短故事。
复习时，他先看成语，再合上本子说出意思，还用每个成语造一句话。读故事时，他用笔找出刚复习过的成语。如果没有找到，他也不着急，只在故事旁边写下新的用法。
两个星期后，唐宁读故事更快了，也能记住更多内容。老师请他介绍方法时，他说：“适合自己的顺序，比一开始学很多更重要。”他决定以后每周看一次记录，再调整计划。
pinyin: táng níng zuì jìn fā xiàn ， zì jǐ měi tiān xué hěn jiǔ ， dì èr tiān què cháng cháng wàng jì 。 tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng zēng jiā xué xí shí jiān ， ér shì dǎ kāi bǐ jì běn ， rèn zhēn kàn le yí gè xīng qī de xué xí jì lù 。

tā fā xiàn ， zì jǐ yǐ qián yī zuò xià jiù dú zhǎng gù shì ， yù dào bù dǒng de chéng yǔ cái qù chá 。 zhè yàng cháng cháng dú dào yí bàn jiù lèi le ， yě jì bù qīng chéng yǔ de yì si 。 yú shì ， tā bǎ xué xí shùn xù huàn le yī xià ： xiān fù xí wǔ gè cháng yòng chéng yǔ ， zài dú yí gè duǎn gù shì 。

fù xí shí ， tā xiān kàn chéng yǔ ， zài hé shàng běn zi shuō chū yì si ， hái yòng měi gè chéng yǔ zào yī jù huà 。 dú gù shì shí ， tā yòng bǐ zhǎo chū gāng fù xí guò de chéng yǔ 。 rú guǒ méi yǒu zhǎo dào ， tā yě bù zháo jí ， zhǐ zài gù shì páng biān xiě xià xīn de yòng fǎ 。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， táng níng dú gù shì gèng kuài le ， yě néng jì zhù gèng duō nèi róng 。 lǎo shī qǐng tā jiè shào fāng fǎ shí ， tā shuō ：“ shì hé zì jǐ de shùn xù ， bǐ yī kāi shǐ xué hěn duō gèng zhòng yào 。” tā jué dìng yǐ hòu měi zhōu kàn yī cì jì lù ， zài tiáo zhěng jì huà 。
translation: Tang Ning recently noticed that although he studied for a long time every day, he often forgot what he had learned the next day. Instead of immediately increasing his study time, he opened his notebook and carefully reviewed a week of study records.

He discovered that he used to begin by reading a long story and only looked up an unfamiliar idiom when he met one. As a result, he often became tired halfway through and could not clearly remember the meanings of the idioms. Therefore, he changed the order of his studies: first reviewing five common idioms and then reading a short story.

While reviewing, he first looked at each idiom, then closed his notebook and explained its meaning. He also made a sentence with every idiom. While reading the story, he used a pen to find the idioms he had just reviewed. If he did not find them, he did not worry and simply wrote down new usages beside the story.

Two weeks later, Tang Ning could read stories faster and remember more of their content. When his teacher asked him to introduce his method, he said, “An order that suits you is more important than studying a lot at the beginning.” He decided to review his records once a week and then adjust his plan.

articles.title: 冯佳的星星记录法
articles.summary: 冯佳用星星标出容易写错的汉字，每天有计划地复习，写字的错误慢慢减少了。
articles.topic: 冯佳的星星记录法
paragraphs: 冯佳学汉字的时候，常常记得读音，却写不好字。老师发现她总在同样的笔画上出错，就请她每天把错字记在一个小本子里，并在字旁画一颗星。
睡觉以前，冯佳会打开白天的记录。她不急着把每个字写十遍，而是先看有星的地方，再慢慢写两遍。写完以后，她把本子合上，用手指在桌上写一次，看看自己是不是真的记住了。
第二天早上，她利用坐公共汽车的时间回想这些字。到了学校，她请同桌从本子里选三个字，自己不看记录写出来。如果还有错误，她就在那颗星旁边写上日期，晚上继续练习。
两个星期后，本子上的新星越来越少，冯佳写作业也快了。她明白，学习不是做得越多越好，先找到问题，再选择合适的方法，进步会更明显。
pinyin: féng jiā xué hàn zì de shí hòu ， cháng cháng jì de dú yīn ， què xiě bù hǎo zì 。 lǎo shī fā xiàn tā zǒng zài tóng yàng de bǐ huà shàng chū cuò ， jiù qǐng tā měi tiān bǎ cuò zì jì zài yí gè xiǎo běn zi lǐ ， bìng zài zì páng huà yī kē xīng 。

shuì jiào yǐ qián ， féng jiā huì dǎ kāi bái tiān de jì lù 。 tā bù jí zhe bǎ měi gè zì xiě shí biàn ， ér shì xiān kàn yǒu xīng de dì fāng ， zài màn màn xiě liǎng biàn 。 xiě wán yǐ hòu ， tā bǎ běn zi hé shàng ， yòng shǒu zhǐ zài zhuō shàng xiě yī cì ， kàn kàn zì jǐ shì bú shì zhēn de jì zhù le 。

dì èr tiān zǎo shàng ， tā lì yòng zuò gōng gòng qì chē de shí jiān huí xiǎng zhè xiē zì 。 dào le xué xiào ， tā qǐng tóng zhuō cóng běn zi lǐ xuǎn sān gè zì ， zì jǐ bù kàn jì lù xiě chū lái 。 rú guǒ hái yǒu cuò wù ， tā jiù zài nà kē xīng páng biān xiě shàng rì qī ， wǎn shàng jì xù liàn xí 。

liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， běn zi shàng de xīn xīng yuè lái yuè shǎo ， féng jiā xiě zuò yè yě kuài le 。 tā míng bái ， xué xí bú shì zuò dé yuè duō yuè hǎo ， xiān zhǎo dào wèn tí ， zài xuǎn zé hé shì de fāng fǎ ， jìn bù huì gèng míng xiǎn 。
translation: When Feng Jia studied Chinese characters, she often remembered their pronunciation but could not write them well. Her teacher noticed that she kept making mistakes on the same strokes, so the teacher asked her to record the incorrect characters in a small notebook every day and draw a star beside each one.

Before going to sleep, Feng Jia opened the notes she had made during the day. Instead of rushing to write every character ten times, she first looked at the starred parts and then slowly wrote each character twice. After writing, she closed the notebook and traced each character once on the table with her finger to see whether she had truly remembered it.

The next morning, she used her time on the bus to recall those characters. When she arrived at school, she asked her deskmate to choose three characters from the notebook, and she wrote them without looking at her notes. If she still made a mistake, she wrote the date beside that star and continued practicing in the evening.

Two weeks later, fewer and fewer new stars appeared in the notebook, and Feng Jia also completed her homework faster. She understood that studying is not simply better when one does more; progress becomes clearer when one first identifies the problem and then chooses a suitable method.

articles.title: 曹明的两遍录音学习法
articles.summary: 曹明发现只花时间背生词没有解决听力问题，于是通过听两遍课堂录音、查找答案和再次练习，慢慢提高了听课和回答问题的能力。
articles.topic: 曹明的两遍录音学习法
paragraphs: 曹明以前学汉语时，总想一次记住所有生词。晚上，他常常看书看到很晚，第二天上课却没有精神。一次听写后，他发现自己会写的词不少，可是听到老师说话时，还是不能马上明白。他决定换一种学习方法。
现在，他每天回家先休息十分钟，再听当天的课堂录音。第一遍，他不看课本，只听老师和同学说了什么；第二遍，他一边听，一边在本子上写下没听懂的地方。然后，他打开课本找答案，并完成录音后面的三个问题。
周五，曹明把这一周的问题重新做了一次，还请同桌读几句话给他听。两个星期后，他发现自己听课更轻松了，回答问题也快了。
虽然他每天只用半个小时这样学习，但是学习不再像以前那么累。老师说，先发现问题，再认真练习，比只花很多时间更有用。
pinyin: cáo míng yǐ qián xué hàn yǔ shí ， zǒng xiǎng yī cì jì zhù suǒ yǒu shēng cí 。 wǎn shàng ， tā cháng cháng kàn shū kàn dào hěn wǎn ， dì èr tiān shàng kè què méi yǒu jīng shén 。 yī cì tīng xiě hòu ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ huì xiě de cí bù shǎo ， kě shì tīng dào lǎo shī shuō huà shí ， hái shì bù néng mǎ shàng míng bái 。 tā jué dìng huàn yī zhǒng xué xí fāng fǎ 。

xiàn zài ， tā měi tiān huí jiā xiān xiū xī shí fēn zhōng ， zài tīng dàng tiān de kè táng lù yīn 。 dì yī biàn ， tā bù kàn kè běn ， zhǐ tīng lǎo shī hé tóng xué shuō le shén me ； dì èr biàn ， tā yī biān tīng ， yī biān zài běn zi shàng xiě xià méi tīng dǒng de dì fāng 。 rán hòu ， tā dǎ kāi kè běn zhǎo dá àn ， bìng wán chéng lù yīn hòu miàn de sān gè wèn tí 。

zhōu wǔ ， cáo míng bǎ zhè yī zhōu de wèn tí chóng xīn zuò le yī cì ， hái qǐng tóng zhuō dú jǐ jù huà gěi tā tīng 。 liǎng gè xīng qī hòu ， tā fā xiàn zì jǐ tīng kè gèng qīng sōng le ， huí dá wèn tí yě kuài le 。

suī rán tā měi tiān zhǐ yòng bàn gè xiǎo shí zhè yàng xué xí ， dàn shì xué xí bù zài xiàng yǐ qián nà me lèi 。 lǎo shī shuō ， xiān fā xiàn wèn tí ， zài rèn zhēn liàn xí ， bǐ zhǐ huā hěn duō shí jiān gèng yǒu yòng 。
translation: When Cao Ming studied Chinese in the past, he always wanted to memorize all the new words at once. In the evening, he often studied until very late, but he had no energy in class the next day. After a dictation exercise, he realized that although he could write quite a few words, he still could not understand immediately when he heard the teacher speak. He decided to try a different way of studying.

Now, when he gets home each day, he rests for ten minutes before listening to that day's classroom recording. The first time, he does not look at the textbook and only listens to what the teacher and students said. The second time, he listens while writing down the parts he did not understand in his notebook. Then he opens the textbook to find the answers and completes the three questions after the recording.

On Friday, Cao Ming did the week's questions again and also asked his deskmate to read a few sentences to him. Two weeks later, he found it easier to follow the class and could answer questions more quickly.

Although he spent only half an hour a day studying this way, learning no longer felt as tiring as before. His teacher said that finding problems first and then practicing carefully was more useful than simply spending a lot of time.

articles.title: 晚上八点的问号
articles.summary: 蒋雪记录阅读时停顿较久的地方，每晚八点重新检查，慢慢找到了更有效的学习方法。
articles.topic: 晚上八点的问号
paragraphs: 蒋雪每天放学后都会去学校图书馆学习。以前，她把课文读一遍就觉得自己学会了，可是第二天回答问题时，常常想不起重要的内容。她发现，读得慢的地方不一定最难，停下来很久的地方才需要再看。
从星期一开始，她准备了一张小纸，放在书旁边。每次读到必须想很久的地方，她不马上找答案，只写下页数和一个问号。晚上八点，她回到家，按照纸上的记号重读那些句子，再检查自己能不能说清楚。
第一天，纸上有五个问号，其中两个地方她还是不懂。她请老师用简单的话讲了一次，然后一边读，一边把意思说给弟弟听。
到星期五，她只记下一个问号，回答问题也快多了。蒋雪明白了：学习不只是读完，还要知道自己在哪里停住。
pinyin: jiǎng xuě měi tiān fàng xué hòu dū huì qù xué xiào tú shū guǎn xué xí 。 yǐ qián ， tā bǎ kè wén dú yī biàn jiù jué de zì jǐ xué huì le ， kě shì dì èr tiān huí dá wèn tí shí ， cháng cháng xiǎng bù qǐ zhòng yào de nèi róng 。 tā fā xiàn ， dú dé màn de dì fāng bù yí dìng zuì nán ， tíng xià lái hěn jiǔ de dì fāng cái xū yào zài kàn 。

cóng xīng qī yī kāi shǐ ， tā zhǔn bèi le yī zhāng xiǎo zhǐ ， fàng zài shū páng biān 。 měi cì dú dào bì xū xiǎng hěn jiǔ de dì fāng ， tā bù mǎ shàng zhǎo dá àn ， zhǐ xiě xià yè shù hé yí gè wèn hào 。 wǎn shàng bā diǎn ， tā huí dào jiā ， àn zhào zhǐ shàng de jì hào chóng dú nà xiē jù zi ， zài jiǎn chá zì jǐ néng bù néng shuō qīng chǔ 。

dì yī tiān ， zhǐ shàng yǒu wǔ gè wèn hào ， qí zhōng liǎng gè dì fāng tā hái shì bù dǒng 。 tā qǐng lǎo shī yòng jiǎn dān de huà jiǎng le yī cì ， rán hòu yī biān dú ， yī biān bǎ yì si shuō gěi dì di tīng 。
dào xīng qī wǔ ， tā zhǐ jì xià yí gè wèn hào ， huí dá wèn tí yě kuài duō le 。 jiǎng xuě míng bái le ： xué xí bù zhǐ shì dú wán ， hái yào zhī dào zì jǐ zài nǎ lǐ tíng zhù 。
translation: Jiang Xue studies in the school library every day after school. In the past, she thought she had learned a text after reading it once, but when answering questions the next day, she often could not remember the important content. She discovered that the places she read slowly were not always the hardest; the places where she paused for a long time were the ones she needed to review.

Starting on Monday, she prepared a small piece of paper and placed it beside her book. Whenever she reached a part that made her think for a long time, she did not look for the answer immediately. She only wrote down the page number and a question mark. At eight in the evening, she returned home, reread those sentences according to the marks on the paper, and then checked whether she could explain them clearly.

On the first day, there were five question marks on the paper, and she still did not understand two of the places. She asked her teacher to explain them once in simple words, and then she read while explaining the meaning to her younger brother.

By Friday, she wrote down only one question mark and answered questions much faster. Jiang Xue understood that studying is not only about finishing the reading but also about knowing where she gets stuck.

articles.title: 邓安把地图变成练习本
articles.summary: 邓安改变复习顺序，把旅游词语放进地图练习中，终于能够清楚地介绍路线。
articles.topic: 邓安把地图变成练习本
paragraphs: 邓安每次上旅游课都记很多新词，可是回家以后，他常常只看词语表，不知道怎么使用。上周的小测验里，他又写错了“向左转”和“经过”。老师看了他的本子，说问题不是记得慢，而是复习没有顺序。
当天晚上，邓安找出一张城市地图，重新安排学习时间。他先复习十个旅游词语，然后在地图上找车站、宾馆和公园。每找到一个地方，他就从家开始说一遍路线，还把说不清楚的地方写在纸上。
一周后，表弟来家里玩，邓安请他在地图上选一个地方。表弟选了河边的公园，邓安马上介绍了从家到那里的路线。
虽然他们没有真的出门，表弟还是按照邓安说的路线，在地图上顺利走完了从家到公园的路。邓安发现，把词语用起来比只看词语表更有意思。
pinyin: dèng ān měi cì shàng lǚ yóu kè dōu jì hěn duō xīn cí ， kě shì huí jiā yǐ hòu ， tā cháng cháng zhǐ kàn cí yǔ biǎo ， bù zhī dào zěn me shǐ yòng 。 shàng zhōu de xiǎo cè yàn lǐ ， tā yòu xiě cuò le “ xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn ” hé “ jīng guò ”。 lǎo shī kàn le tā de běn zi ， shuō wèn tí bú shì jì de màn ， ér shì fù xí méi yǒu shùn xù 。

dàng tiān wǎn shàng ， dèng ān zhǎo chū yī zhāng chéng shì dì tú ， chóng xīn ān pái xué xí shí jiān 。 tā xiān fù xí shí gè lǚ yóu cí yǔ ， rán hòu zài dì tú shàng zhǎo chē zhàn 、 bīn guǎn hé gōng yuán 。 měi zhǎo dào yí gè dì fāng ， tā jiù cóng jiā kāi shǐ shuō yī biàn lù xiàn ， hái bǎ shuō bù qīng chǔ de dì fāng xiě zài zhǐ shàng 。
yī zhōu hòu ， biǎo dì lái jiā lǐ wán ， dèng ān qǐng tā zài dì tú shàng xuǎn yí gè dì fāng 。 biǎo dì xuǎn le hé biān de gōng yuán ， dèng ān mǎ shàng jiè shào le cóng jiā dào nà lǐ de lù xiàn 。

suī rán tā men méi yǒu zhēn de chū mén ， biǎo dì hái shì àn zhào dèng ān shuō de lù xiàn ， zài dì tú shàng shùn lì zǒu wán le cóng jiā dào gōng yuán de lù 。 dèng ān fā xiàn ， bǎ cí yǔ yòng qǐ lái bǐ zhǐ kàn cí yǔ biǎo gèng yǒu yì si 。
translation: Deng An wrote down many new words in every travel class, but after returning home, he often only looked at the word list and did not know how to use them. In last week's quiz, he once again wrote “turn left” and “pass by” incorrectly. After looking at his notebook, the teacher said that the problem was not that he memorized slowly, but that his review had no clear order.

That evening, Deng An found a city map and rearranged his study time. He first reviewed ten travel words and then located the station, hotel, and park on the map. Whenever he found a place, he described the route from his home and wrote down the parts he could not explain clearly.

A week later, his younger cousin came to visit, and Deng An asked him to choose a place on the map. His cousin chose the park by the river, and Deng An immediately explained the route from his home to the park.

Although they did not actually go out, his cousin was still able to follow Deng An's directions and successfully trace the route from his home to the park on the map. Deng An discovered that using words was more interesting than merely looking at a word list.

articles.title: 宋雨的午休学习本
articles.summary: 宋雨把工作中不熟悉的说法记在本子里，利用午休复习和练习，渐渐提高了表达能力。
articles.topic: 宋雨的午休学习本
paragraphs: 宋雨在一家书店工作。她每天要回答客人的问题，也要写工作记录。刚开始，她常把“退货”“预订”和“到货时间”说错。客人虽然能听懂，她自己却觉得不够清楚。于是，她准备了一个小本子，把白天不熟悉的说法记下来。
午休时，宋雨不再一直看手机，而是打开本子复习。她先读一遍当天的记录，再用每个词写一句话。遇到不会用的词，她就请同事举一个例子。晚上回家后，她还把这些句子读给妹妹听，请妹妹指出听不明白的地方。
一个月后，一位客人来问预订的书什么时候到。宋雨很快说明了日期、取书办法和退货要求，客人满意地点了点头。
店长也发现，她写的记录更简单、更准确了。宋雨明白，学习不一定要花很多时间，只要每天发现问题、练习并请别人帮助，就能慢慢进步。
pinyin: sòng yǔ zài yī jiā shū diàn gōng zuò 。 tā měi tiān yào huí dá kè rén de wèn tí ， yě yào xiě gōng zuò jì lù 。 gāng kāi shǐ ， tā cháng bǎ “ tuì huò ”“ yù dìng ” hé “ dào huò shí jiān ” shuō cuò 。 kè rén suī rán néng tīng dǒng ， tā zì jǐ què jué de bù gòu qīng chǔ 。 yú shì ， tā zhǔn bèi le yí gè xiǎo běn zi ， bǎ bái tiān bù shú xī de shuō fǎ jì xià lái 。

wǔ xiū shí ， sòng yǔ bù zài yì zhí kàn shǒu jī ， ér shì dǎ kāi běn zi fù xí 。 tā xiān dú yī biàn dàng tiān de jì lù ， zài yòng měi gè cí xiě yī jù huà 。 yù dào bú huì yòng de cí ， tā jiù qǐng tóng shì jǔ yí gè lì zi 。 wǎn shàng huí jiā hòu ， tā hái bǎ zhè xiē jù zi dú gěi mèi mèi tīng ， qǐng mèi mèi zhǐ chū tīng bù míng bái de dì fāng 。
yí gè yuè hòu ， yī wèi kè rén lái wèn yù dìng de shū shén me shí hòu dào 。 sòng yǔ hěn kuài shuō míng le rì qī 、 qǔ shū bàn fǎ hé tuì huò yāo qiú ， kè rén mǎn yì dì diǎn le diǎn tóu 。

diàn zhǎng yě fā xiàn ， tā xiě de jì lù gèng jiǎn dān 、 gèng zhǔn què le 。 sòng yǔ míng bái ， xué xí bù yí dìng yào huā hěn duō shí jiān ， zhǐ yào měi tiān fā xiàn wèn tí 、 liàn xí bìng qǐng bié rén bāng zhù ， jiù néng màn màn jìn bù 。
translation: Song Yu works at a bookstore. Every day, she answers customers' questions and writes work notes. At first, she often used the terms “return,” “reservation,” and “arrival time” incorrectly. Although the customers could understand her, she felt that her explanations were not clear enough. Therefore, she prepared a small notebook and wrote down unfamiliar expressions she encountered during the day.

During her lunch break, Song Yu no longer spends all her time looking at her phone. Instead, she opens her notebook to review. She first reads that day's notes once and then writes a sentence with each word. When she does not know how to use a word, she asks a coworker to give her an example. After returning home in the evening, she also reads the sentences to her younger sister and asks her to point out anything she cannot understand.

One month later, a customer came to ask when a reserved book would arrive. Song Yu quickly explained the date, how to collect the book, and the return requirements. The customer nodded with satisfaction.

The store manager also noticed that her notes had become simpler and more accurate. Song Yu understood that studying does not always require a lot of time. As long as she identifies problems, practices, and asks others for help every day, she can gradually improve.

articles.title: 图书馆深夜开放以后
articles.summary: 市图书馆将延长晚间开放时间，并通过调整服务、保障安全和了解读者需求，让夜间学习更加方便。
articles.topic: 图书馆深夜开放以后
paragraphs: 市图书馆收到不少读者的建议，希望晚上能有更长的学习时间。经过讨论，图书馆决定从下周一开始，把闭馆时间从晚上九点改到十一点。工作人员表示，这项新安排先实行一个月，再根据实际情况决定是否继续。
延长开放时间并不代表所有服务都会一直提供。晚上九点以后，借书和还书仍可正常办理，但儿童阅览室会按原来的时间关闭。需要工作人员帮助查找资料的读者，最好在九点以前到服务台咨询。自习区和电子阅览区则会开放到十一点。
为了保证夜间安全，图书馆增加了两名值班人员，并重新检查了出口、灯光和紧急设备。读者离开时必须从东门出去，因为其他出口将在九点半关闭。图书馆还提醒大家，夜间公共汽车较少，回家较远的读者应该提前安排交通。
大学生林悦听说这个消息后很高兴。她白天要上课，晚上还在一家面包店工作，以前常常刚到图书馆就遇上闭馆。新安排开始后，她下班后还能安静地复习一个多小时。她说：“只要时间安排得合适，我就能按计划准备考试。”
新安排开始后，服务台会准备一本意见册，读者可以写下自己的感受和建议。图书馆也会观察各区域的使用情况，但不会只看人数来判断效果。工作人员认为，是否方便、安全，以及读者是否真正需要，都是决定下一步安排的重要条件。
pinyin: shì tú shū guǎn shōu dào bù shǎo dú zhě de jiàn yì ， xī wàng wǎn shàng néng yǒu gèng zhǎng de xué xí shí jiān 。 jīng guò tǎo lùn ， tú shū guǎn jué dìng cóng xià zhōu yī kāi shǐ ， bǎ bì guǎn shí jiān cóng wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn gǎi dào shí yì diǎn 。 gōng zuò rén yuán biǎo shì ， zhè xiàng xīn ān pái xiān shí xíng yí gè yuè ， zài gēn jù shí jì qíng kuàng jué dìng shì fǒu jì xù 。

yán cháng kāi fàng shí jiān bìng bù dài biǎo suǒ yǒu fú wù dū huì yì zhí tí gōng 。 wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu ， jiè shū hé huán shū réng kě zhèng cháng bàn lǐ ， dàn ér tóng yuè lǎn shì huì àn yuán lái de shí jiān guān bì 。 xū yào gōng zuò rén yuán bāng zhù chá zhǎo zī liào de dú zhě ， zuì hǎo zài jiǔ diǎn yǐ qián dào fú wù tái zī xún 。 zì xí qū hé diàn zi yuè lǎn qū zé huì kāi fàng dào shí yì diǎn 。

wèi le bǎo zhèng yè jiān ān quán ， tú shū guǎn zēng jiā le liǎng míng zhí bān rén yuán ， bìng zhòng xīn jiǎn chá le chū kǒu 、 dēng guāng hé jǐn jí shè bèi 。 dú zhě lí kāi shí bì xū cóng dōng mén chū qù ， yīn wèi qí tā chū kǒu jiāng zài jiǔ diǎn bàn guān bì 。 tú shū guǎn hái tí xǐng dà jiā ， yè jiān gōng gòng qì chē jiào shǎo ， huí jiā jiào yuǎn de dú zhě yīng gāi tí qián ān pái jiāo tōng 。

dà xué shēng lín yuè tīng shuō zhè ge xiāo xī hòu hěn gāo xìng 。 tā bái tiān yào shàng kè ， wǎn shàng hái zài yī jiā miàn bāo diàn gōng zuò ， yǐ qián cháng cháng gāng dào tú shū guǎn jiù yù shàng bì guǎn 。 xīn ān pái kāi shǐ hòu ， tā xià bān hòu hái néng ān jìng dì fù xí yí gè duō xiǎo shí 。 tā shuō ：“ zhǐ yào shí jiān ān pái dé hé shì ， wǒ jiù néng àn jì huà zhǔn bèi kǎo shì 。”

xīn ān pái kāi shǐ hòu ， fú wù tái huì zhǔn bèi yī běn yì jiàn cè ， dú zhě kě yǐ xiě xià zì jǐ de gǎn shòu hé jiàn yì 。 tú shū guǎn yě huì guān chá gè qū yù de shǐ yòng qíng kuàng ， dàn bú huì zhǐ kàn rén shù lái pàn duàn xiào guǒ 。 gōng zuò rén yuán rèn wéi ， shì fǒu fāng biàn 、 ān quán ， yǐ jí dú zhě shì fǒu zhēn zhèng xū yào ， dōu shì jué dìng xià yī bù ān pái de zhòng yào tiáo jiàn 。
translation: The city library received suggestions from many readers who wanted longer study hours in the evening. After discussion, the library decided that starting next Monday, closing time would change from 9 p.m. to 11 p.m. Staff members said the new arrangement would first be implemented for one month, after which they would decide whether to continue it based on the actual situation.

Longer opening hours do not mean that every service will remain available the entire time. After 9 p.m., borrowing and returning books will continue as usual, but the children's reading room will close at its original time. Readers who need staff assistance in finding materials should preferably consult the service desk before 9 p.m. The study area and electronic reading area, however, will remain open until 11 p.m.

To ensure safety at night, the library added two staff members on duty and reinspected the exits, lighting, and emergency equipment. Readers must leave through the east gate because the other exits will close at 9:30 p.m. The library also reminded everyone that there are fewer public buses at night, so readers who live far away should arrange transportation in advance.

University student Lin Yue was delighted when she heard the news. She attends classes during the day and also works at a bakery in the evening, so in the past she often arrived at the library just as it was closing. Once the new arrangement begins, she will still be able to review her lessons quietly for more than an hour after work. She said, “As long as I arrange my time properly, I can prepare for the exam according to plan.”

After the new arrangement begins, the service desk will provide a comment book in which readers can write their thoughts and suggestions. The library will also observe how each area is used, but it will not judge the results solely by the number of visitors. Staff members believe that convenience, safety, and whether readers truly need the service are all important conditions for deciding the next step.

articles.title: 晚两小时关门以后
articles.summary: 社区游泳馆延长晚间服务时间，分时安排家庭与成年人使用泳池，并在收集居民意见后调整清洁时间，让上班族也能方便地锻炼。
articles.topic: 晚两小时关门以后
paragraphs: 周一早上，王琳经过小区门口时，看见社区游泳馆贴出了一张新通知。游泳馆原来每天下午六点结束服务，从下周开始，周一到周五将推迟到晚上八点关门。王琳看到后很高兴，因为她平时六点半才下班，以前只有周末才能去游泳。
为了了解居民的需要，游泳馆请大家在意见表上选择合适的时间。有人希望增加成人课程，也有家长担心晚上孩子太多，泳池会比较拥挤。工作人员根据这些意见作了安排：七点以前主要接待家庭，七点以后开放更多泳道给成年人。
新的服务时间开始后，王琳在周三晚上第一次去了游泳馆。她发现入口处增加了一名工作人员，泳池旁也一直有人注意安全。虽然来游泳的人比下午多，但是大家按照不同的泳道练习，并没有互相影响。她游了四十分钟，还参加了教练介绍的呼吸练习。
两周后，游泳馆再次收集意见。多数居民认为晚间服务很方便，不过有人提出更衣室晚上不够干净。负责人马上调整了清洁时间，并提醒大家离开前带走自己的物品。延长时间不但让王琳有了固定的锻炼机会，还帮助游泳馆发现并解决了新的问题。
pinyin: zhōu yī zǎo shàng ， wáng lín jīng guò xiǎo qū mén kǒu shí ， kàn jiàn shè qū yóu yǒng guǎn tiē chū le yī zhāng xīn tōng zhī 。 yóu yǒng guǎn yuán lái měi tiān xià wǔ liù diǎn jié shù fú wù ， cóng xià zhōu kāi shǐ ， zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ jiāng tuī chí dào wǎn shàng bā diǎn guān mén 。 wáng lín kàn dào hòu hěn gāo xìng ， yīn wèi tā píng shí liù diǎn bàn cái xià bān ， yǐ qián zhǐ yǒu zhōu mò cái néng qù yóu yǒng 。

wèi le liǎo jiě jū mín de xū yào ， yóu yǒng guǎn qǐng dà jiā zài yì jiàn biǎo shàng xuǎn zé hé shì de shí jiān 。 yǒu rén xī wàng zēng jiā chéng rén kè chéng ， yě yǒu jiā zhǎng dān xīn wǎn shàng hái zi tài duō ， yǒng chí huì bǐ jiào yōng jǐ 。 gōng zuò rén yuán gēn jù zhè xiē yì jiàn zuò le ān pái ： qī diǎn yǐ qián zhǔ yào jiē dài jiā tíng ， qī diǎn yǐ hòu kāi fàng gèng duō yǒng dào gěi chéng nián rén 。

xīn de fú wù shí jiān kāi shǐ hòu ， wáng lín zài zhōu sān wǎn shàng dì yī cì qù le yóu yǒng guǎn 。 tā fā xiàn rù kǒu chù zēng jiā le yī míng gōng zuò rén yuán ， yǒng chí páng yě yì zhí yǒu rén zhù yì ān quán 。 suī rán lái yóu yǒng de rén bǐ xià wǔ duō ， dàn shì dà jiā àn zhào bù tóng de yǒng dào liàn xí ， bìng méi yǒu hù xiāng yǐng xiǎng 。 tā yóu le sì shí fēn zhōng ， hái cān jiā le jiào liàn jiè shào de hū xī liàn xí 。

liǎng zhōu hòu ， yóu yǒng guǎn zài cì shōu jí yì jiàn 。 duō shù jū mín rèn wéi wǎn jiān fú wù hěn fāng biàn ， bù guò yǒu rén tí chū gēng yī shì wǎn shàng bù gòu gān jìng 。 fù zé rén mǎ shàng tiáo zhěng le qīng jié shí jiān ， bìng tí xǐng dà jiā lí kāi qián dài zǒu zì jǐ de wù pǐn 。 yán cháng shí jiān bù dàn ràng wáng lín yǒu le gù dìng de duàn liàn jī huì ， hái bāng zhù yóu yǒng guǎn fā xiàn bìng jiě jué le xīn de wèn tí 。
translation: On Monday morning, Wang Lin saw a new notice posted by the community swimming pool as she passed the entrance to her residential complex. The pool used to close at six every afternoon. Starting the following week, it would remain open until eight in the evening from Monday to Friday. Wang Lin was delighted because she normally did not finish work until six thirty and had previously been able to swim only on weekends.

To understand what residents needed, the pool asked everyone to choose suitable times on a feedback form. Some people hoped for more adult classes, while some parents worried that too many children in the evening would make the pool crowded. Based on these opinions, the staff made an arrangement: before seven, the pool would mainly serve families, and after seven, more lanes would be available to adults.

After the new service hours began, Wang Lin went to the pool on a Wednesday evening for the first time. She noticed that an additional staff member had been placed at the entrance and that someone was always watching over safety beside the pool. Although there were more swimmers than in the afternoon, everyone practiced in separate lanes and did not disturb one another. She swam for forty minutes and also took part in a breathing exercise introduced by the coach.

Two weeks later, the pool collected feedback again. Most residents thought the evening service was convenient, but someone pointed out that the changing room was not clean enough at night. The manager immediately adjusted the cleaning schedule and reminded everyone to take their belongings when leaving. The extended hours not only gave Wang Lin a regular opportunity to exercise but also helped the pool discover and solve new problems.

articles.title: 提前半小时的晚饭
articles.summary: 学校食堂根据不同学生的上课和训练时间，把晚餐分成两个服务时段，并通过收集意见继续改进服务。
articles.topic: 提前半小时的晚饭
paragraphs: 周一中午，明湖中学食堂门口贴出了一张新通知：从本周起，二楼晚餐窗口下午四点半开始服务，比过去早半小时。最近学校增加了几门下午的兴趣课，有些学生五点半才下课，而另一部分学生五点要参加训练。原来的时间让两边都觉得不方便，食堂因此决定试行新的安排。
新时间开始前，食堂先请各班生活委员了解大家的需要。负责老师发现，参加篮球训练的学生希望早点吃，兴趣课学生却担心下课后没有热菜。食堂没有简单地把时间提前，而是把晚餐分成两个服务时段：四点半到五点供应一部分饭菜，五点半以后再准备一批。
第一天，八年级学生林悦在训练前来到食堂。她本来担心选择太少，却发现主食、蔬菜和鸡蛋都有。吃完后，她把“汤有点儿凉”写在意见本上。值班师傅看到后，马上给保温设备加了热水。六点左右，兴趣课结束的学生进来时，第二批饭菜也刚做好，没有出现大家担心的排长队。
试行一周后，老师又收集了意见。多数学生觉得安排更灵活，但也有人建议提前公布每天两批饭菜的种类。食堂接受了这个建议，并在学校网站上增加了菜单。新的服务时间没有让所有人同时吃饭，却让不同安排的学生都能吃上热饭，也减少了等待。
pinyin: zhōu yī zhōng wǔ ， míng hú zhōng xué shí táng mén kǒu tiē chū le yī zhāng xīn tōng zhī ： cóng běn zhōu qǐ ， èr lóu wǎn cān chuāng kǒu xià wǔ sì diǎn bàn kāi shǐ fú wù ， bǐ guò qù zǎo bàn xiǎo shí 。 zuì jìn xué xiào zēng jiā le jǐ mén xià wǔ de xìng qù kè ， yǒu xiē xué shēng wǔ diǎn bàn cái xià kè ， ér lìng yī bù fèn xué shēng wǔ diǎn yào cān jiā xùn liàn 。 yuán lái de shí jiān ràng liǎng biān dōu jué de bù fāng biàn ， shí táng yīn cǐ jué dìng shì xíng xīn de ān pái 。

xīn shí jiān kāi shǐ qián ， shí táng xiān qǐng gè bān shēng huó wěi yuán liǎo jiě dà jiā de xū yào 。 fù zé lǎo shī fā xiàn ， cān jiā lán qiú xùn liàn de xué shēng xī wàng zǎo diǎn chī ， xìng qù kè xué shēng què dān xīn xià kè hòu méi yǒu rè cài 。 shí táng méi yǒu jiǎn dān dì bǎ shí jiān tí qián ， ér shì bǎ wǎn cān fēn chéng liǎng gè fú wù shí duàn ： sì diǎn bàn dào wǔ diǎn gōng yìng yī bù fèn fàn cài ， wǔ diǎn bàn yǐ hòu zài zhǔn bèi yī pī 。

dì yī tiān ， bā nián jí xué shēng lín yuè zài xùn liàn qián lái dào shí táng 。 tā běn lái dān xīn xuǎn zé tài shǎo ， què fā xiàn zhǔ shí 、 shū cài hé jī dàn dōu yǒu 。 chī wán hòu ， tā bǎ “ tāng yǒu diǎn ér liáng ” xiě zài yì jiàn běn shàng 。 zhí bān shī fù kàn dào hòu ， mǎ shàng gěi bǎo wēn shè bèi jiā le rè shuǐ 。 liù diǎn zuǒ yòu ， xìng qù kè jié shù de xué shēng jìn lái shí ， dì èr pī fàn cài yě gāng zuò hǎo ， méi yǒu chū xiàn dà jiā dān xīn de pái zhǎng duì 。

shì xíng yī zhōu hòu ， lǎo shī yòu shōu jí le yì jiàn 。 duō shù xué shēng jué de ān pái gèng líng huó ， dàn yě yǒu rén jiàn yì tí qián gōng bù měi tiān liǎng pī fàn cài de zhǒng lèi 。 shí táng jiē shòu le zhè ge jiàn yì ， bìng zài xué xiào wǎng zhàn shàng zēng jiā le cài dān 。 xīn de fú wù shí jiān méi yǒu ràng suǒ yǒu rén tóng shí chī fàn ， què ràng bù tóng ān pái de xué shēng dōu néng chī shàng rè fàn ， yě jiǎn shǎo le děng dài 。
translation: At noon on Monday, a new notice was posted at the entrance to the Minghu Middle School cafeteria: starting this week, the dinner counter on the second floor would open at 4:30 p.m., half an hour earlier than before. The school had recently added several afternoon interest classes. Some students did not finish class until 5:30, while others had training at five. The old schedule was inconvenient for both groups, so the cafeteria decided to test a new arrangement.

Before the new schedule began, the cafeteria asked the student life representatives from each class to learn about everyone's needs. The teacher in charge found that students attending basketball practice wanted to eat earlier, while students in interest classes worried that no hot dishes would be left after class. Instead of simply moving dinner earlier, the cafeteria divided it into two service periods: some food would be served from 4:30 to 5:00, and another batch would be prepared after 5:30.

On the first day, eighth-grade student Lin Yue came to the cafeteria before practice. She had worried that there would be too few choices, but she found staple foods, vegetables, and eggs available. After eating, she wrote, “The soup is a little cold,” in the suggestion book. When the staff member on duty saw it, he immediately added hot water to the warming equipment. At around six, when the students from the interest classes arrived, the second batch of food had just been prepared, and the long line everyone had feared did not appear.

After a one-week trial, the teachers collected feedback again. Most students thought the arrangement was more flexible, but some suggested announcing the dishes in both batches in advance each day. The cafeteria accepted this suggestion and added a menu to the school website. The new service hours did not make everyone eat at the same time, but they allowed students with different schedules to have a hot meal and also reduced waiting.

articles.title: 博物馆把周五的灯开得更晚
articles.summary: 一家历史博物馆根据参观者的建议试行周五晚间开放，并通过调整服务解决了工作人员和观众遇到的问题。
articles.topic: 博物馆把周五的灯开得更晚
paragraphs: 海城历史博物馆过去每天下午五点关门。住在附近的林雪很喜欢看历史展览，可她六点才下班，周末又常常要照顾孩子，所以半年里只去过一次。她发现，和自己有同样困难的人并不少，于是写信建议博物馆每周安排一个晚上继续开放。
馆长没有马上改变开放时间，而是先请工作人员在门口听取参观者的意见。有人希望下班以后来看展览，也有人担心晚上交通不方便。经过讨论，博物馆决定把周五作为晚间开放日，关门时间从五点改到八点，并提前在网站上公布安排。
这项新服务先试行一个月。为了不给工作人员增加太大压力，博物馆重新安排了上班时间，还在晚间增加了免费的讲解活动。只要参观者提前报名，就可以跟着讲解员了解展品背后的故事。博物馆也记录每个周五晚间的参观人数和大家的意见，准备在一个月后决定是否继续这项服务。
第一个周五，林雪下班后直接来到博物馆。虽然外面下着雨，但是晚间展厅里并不冷清。她参加完讲解，又安静地看了几件以前错过的展品。离开时，她还向工作人员建议在门口增加一块更清楚的交通指示牌。
试行结束后，博物馆决定继续提供周五晚间服务，同时接受了交通指示牌的建议。林雪现在不必急着赶时间，工作人员也能按照新的时间表休息。博物馆发现，延长服务不只是把门关得晚一些，更重要的是认真了解不同参观者的需要。
pinyin: hǎi chéng lì shǐ bó wù guǎn guò qù měi tiān xià wǔ wǔ diǎn guān mén 。 zhù zài fù jìn de lín xuě hěn xǐ huān kàn lì shǐ zhǎn lǎn ， kě tā liù diǎn cái xià bān ， zhōu mò yòu cháng cháng yào zhào gù hái zi ， suǒ yǐ bàn nián lǐ zhǐ qù guò yī cì 。 tā fā xiàn ， hé zì jǐ yǒu tóng yàng kùn nán de rén bìng bù shǎo ， yú shì xiě xìn jiàn yì bó wù guǎn měi zhōu ān pái yí gè wǎn shàng jì xù kāi fàng 。

guǎn zhǎng méi yǒu mǎ shàng gǎi biàn kāi fàng shí jiān ， ér shì xiān qǐng gōng zuò rén yuán zài mén kǒu tīng qǔ cān guān zhě de yì jiàn 。 yǒu rén xī wàng xià bān yǐ hòu lái kàn zhǎn lǎn ， yě yǒu rén dān xīn wǎn shàng jiāo tōng bù fāng biàn 。 jīng guò tǎo lùn ， bó wù guǎn jué dìng bǎ zhōu wǔ zuò wéi wǎn jiān kāi fàng rì ， guān mén shí jiān cóng wǔ diǎn gǎi dào bā diǎn ， bìng tí qián zài wǎng zhàn shàng gōng bù ān pái 。

zhè xiàng xīn fú wù xiān shì xíng yí gè yuè 。 wèi le bù gěi gōng zuò rén yuán zēng jiā tài dà yā lì ， bó wù guǎn chóng xīn ān pái le shàng bān shí jiān ， hái zài wǎn jiān zēng jiā le miǎn fèi de jiǎng jiě huó dòng 。 zhǐ yào cān guān zhě tí qián bào míng ， jiù kě yǐ gēn zhe jiǎng jiě yuán liǎo jiě zhǎn pǐn bèi hòu de gù shì 。 bó wù guǎn yě jì lù měi gè zhōu wǔ wǎn jiān de cān guān rén shù hé dà jiā de yì jiàn ， zhǔn bèi zài yí gè yuè hòu jué dìng shì fǒu jì xù zhè xiàng fú wù 。

dì yí gè zhōu wǔ ， lín xuě xià bān hòu zhí jiē lái dào bó wù guǎn 。 suī rán wài miàn xià zhe yǔ ， dàn shì wǎn jiān zhǎn tīng lǐ bìng bù lěng qīng 。 tā cān jiā wán jiǎng jiě ， yòu ān jìng dì kàn le jǐ jiàn yǐ qián cuò guò de zhǎn pǐn 。 lí kāi shí ， tā hái xiàng gōng zuò rén yuán jiàn yì zài mén kǒu zēng jiā yī kuài gèng qīng chǔ de jiāo tōng zhǐ shì pái 。

shì xíng jié shù hòu ， bó wù guǎn jué dìng jì xù tí gōng zhōu wǔ wǎn jiān fú wù ， tóng shí jiē shòu le jiāo tōng zhǐ shì pái de jiàn yì 。 lín xuě xiàn zài bù bì jí zhe gǎn shí jiān ， gōng zuò rén yuán yě néng àn zhào xīn de shí jiān biǎo xiū xī 。 bó wù guǎn fā xiàn ， yán cháng fú wù bù zhǐ shì bǎ mén guān dé wǎn yī xiē ， gèng zhòng yào de shì rèn zhēn liǎo jiě bù tóng cān guān zhě de xū yào 。
translation: The Haicheng History Museum used to close at five o'clock every afternoon. Lin Xue, who lived nearby, enjoyed historical exhibitions, but she did not finish work until six and often had to care for her child on weekends, so she had visited only once in six months. She discovered that many people faced the same difficulty, so she wrote a letter suggesting that the museum stay open one evening each week.

The director did not change the opening hours immediately. Instead, he first asked the staff to listen to visitors' opinions at the entrance. Some people hoped to see exhibitions after work, while others worried that transportation would be inconvenient at night. After a discussion, the museum chose Friday as its late-opening day, changed the closing time from five to eight, and announced the arrangement on its website in advance.

The new service was first tested for one month. To avoid putting too much pressure on the staff, the museum rearranged their working hours and added free guided activities in the evening. As long as visitors registered in advance, they could follow a guide and learn the stories behind the exhibits. The museum also recorded the number of visitors and their opinions every Friday evening, and planned to decide after one month whether to continue the service.

On the first Friday, Lin Xue went straight to the museum after work. Although it was raining outside, the exhibition halls were not quiet or empty that evening. After attending the guided activity, she calmly viewed several exhibits she had missed before. As she left, she also suggested that the staff add a clearer transportation sign near the entrance.

After the trial ended, the museum decided to continue offering Friday evening service and also accepted the suggestion about the transportation sign. Lin Xue no longer had to rush, and the staff could rest according to the new schedule. The museum realized that extending its service was not merely about closing later; more importantly, it meant carefully understanding the needs of different visitors.

articles.title: 咨询台延长服务前的一次晚间练习
articles.summary: 海州市地铁中心站计划把咨询台的开放时间延长到晚上十点，并通过一次晚间练习检查新安排能否帮助夜间乘客。
articles.topic: 咨询台延长服务后的第一个夜晚
paragraphs: 海州市地铁中心站每天晚上都有不少乘客换车。过去，咨询台晚上八点就关门，可是附近商场的工作人员、上晚课的学生和刚到本地的游客，常常在八点以后来问路。他们找不到服务人员时，只能看站内地图或请保安帮忙，有时会因此走错出口。
从下周一开始，中心站东大厅的咨询台将把开放时间延长到晚上十点。八点以后，两名工作人员轮流值班，不但回答换车和出口问题，还会帮助乘客寻找丢失的物品、使用自动售票机。其他服务时间不变，乘客也不用为咨询服务另外付费。
为了检查新安排是否方便，站方在上周三进行了一次晚间练习。九点十分，一位带孩子的母亲来到咨询台，说孩子的蓝色书包可能落在二号线车上。工作人员先问清车厢位置和下车时间，再联系终点站同事。二十分钟后，对方找到了书包，并把它送回中心站。
等待时，工作人员发现母子俩不熟悉附近道路，便画了一张简单的步行图，提醒他们从南出口离开。母亲拿到书包后说，过去遇到这种情况，她可能要第二天再来处理；现在当晚就能解决，心里轻松多了。
站方表示，延长服务首先只在中心站实行。工作人员会记录夜间最常见的问题，并根据第一个月记录的问题和观察结果调整值班人数。如果乘客需要帮助，可以直接到东大厅，也可以按咨询台旁边牌子上的电话联系工作人员。
pinyin: hǎi zhōu shì dì tiě zhōng xīn zhàn měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu yǒu bù shǎo chéng kè huàn chē 。 guò qù ， zī xún tái wǎn shàng bā diǎn jiù guān mén ， kě shì fù jìn shāng chǎng de gōng zuò rén yuán 、 shàng wǎn kè de xué shēng hé gāng dào běn dì de yóu kè ， cháng cháng zài bā diǎn yǐ hòu lái wèn lù 。 tā men zhǎo bú dào fú wù rén yuán shí ， zhǐ néng kàn zhàn nèi dì tú huò qǐng bǎo ān bāng máng ， yǒu shí huì yīn cǐ zǒu cuò chū kǒu 。

cóng xià zhōu yī kāi shǐ ， zhōng xīn zhàn dōng dà tīng de zī xún tái jiāng bǎ kāi fàng shí jiān yán cháng dào wǎn shàng shí diǎn 。 bā diǎn yǐ hòu ， liǎng míng gōng zuò rén yuán lún liú zhí bān ， bù dàn huí dá huàn chē hé chū kǒu wèn tí ， hái huì bāng zhù chéng kè xún zhǎo diū shī de wù pǐn 、 shǐ yòng zì dòng shòu piào jī 。 qí tā fú wù shí jiān bù biàn ， chéng kè yě bù yòng wèi zī xún fú wù lìng wài fù fèi 。

wèi le jiǎn chá xīn ān pái shì fǒu fāng biàn ， zhàn fāng zài shàng zhōu sān jìn xíng le yī cì wǎn jiān liàn xí 。 jiǔ diǎn shí fēn ， yī wèi dài hái zi de mǔ qīn lái dào zī xún tái ， shuō hái zi de lán sè shū bāo kě néng luò zài èr hào xiàn chē shàng 。 gōng zuò rén yuán xiān wèn qīng chē xiāng wèi zhì hé xià chē shí jiān ， zài lián xì zhōng diǎn zhàn tóng shì 。 èr shí fēn zhōng hòu ， duì fāng zhǎo dào le shū bāo ， bìng bǎ tā sòng huí zhōng xīn zhàn 。

děng dài shí ， gōng zuò rén yuán fā xiàn mǔ zi liǎ bù shú xī fù jìn dào lù ， biàn huà le yī zhāng jiǎn dān de bù xíng tú ， tí xǐng tā men cóng nán chū kǒu lí kāi 。 mǔ qīn ná dào shū bāo hòu shuō ， guò qù yù dào zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng ， tā kě néng yào dì èr tiān zài lái chǔ lǐ ； xiàn zài dàng wǎn jiù néng jiě jué ， xīn lǐ qīng sōng duō le 。

zhàn fāng biǎo shì ， yán cháng fú wù shǒu xiān zhǐ zài zhōng xīn zhàn shí xíng 。 gōng zuò rén yuán huì jì lù yè jiān zuì cháng jiàn de wèn tí ， bìng gēn jù dì yí gè yuè jì lù de wèn tí hé guān chá jié guǒ tiáo zhěng zhí bān rén shù 。 rú guǒ chéng kè xū yào bāng zhù ， kě yǐ zhí jiē dào dōng dà tīng ， yě kě yǐ àn zī xún tái páng biān pái zi shàng de diàn huà lián xì gōng zuò rén yuán 。
translation: Many passengers transfer at Haizhou Central Metro Station every evening. In the past, the information desk closed at eight, but employees from nearby shopping centers, students attending evening classes, and tourists who had just arrived in the city often came to ask for directions after eight. When they could not find service staff, they could only check the station map or ask a security guard for help, and they sometimes took the wrong exit as a result.

Starting next Monday, the information desk in the east hall of Central Station will extend its opening hours until ten in the evening. After eight, two staff members will take turns working. They will not only answer questions about transfers and exits but also help passengers find lost belongings and use the ticket machines. The hours of other services will remain unchanged, and passengers will not need to pay extra for assistance.

To see whether the new arrangement would be convenient, the station conducted an evening practice session last Wednesday. At ten past nine, a mother with her child came to the information desk and said that the child's blue schoolbag might have been left on a Line 2 train. A staff member first confirmed the carriage location and the time they got off, and then contacted a colleague at the terminal station. Twenty minutes later, the colleague found the schoolbag and sent it back to Central Station.

While they were waiting, the staff member noticed that the mother and child were unfamiliar with the nearby roads, so the staff member drew a simple walking map and reminded them to leave through the south exit. After receiving the schoolbag, the mother said that in the past she might have had to return the next day to deal with such a situation. Now it could be resolved that same evening, which made her feel much more relieved.

The station stated that the extended service would initially be introduced only at Central Station. Staff will record the most common nighttime questions and adjust the number of people on duty based on the questions recorded and the observations made during the first month. Passengers who need help can go directly to the east hall or contact the staff using the phone number on the sign beside the information desk.

articles.title: 诊所开到晚上以后
articles.summary: 社区诊所延长工作时间，居民看病更加方便；一次现场误会也让诊所发现，服务内容需要写得更清楚。
articles.topic: 诊所开到晚上以后
paragraphs: 周一早上，李阿姨送孙子上学后，发现社区诊所门口贴了一张新通知。从下周起，诊所周一到周五的服务时间将从下午五点延长到晚上九点，周末安排不变。晚上可以看普通病、换药和了解健康问题，但是不能做需要特别设备的检查。
李阿姨在超市工作，每天下午六点才下班。过去，她身体不舒服时，只能请假去诊所，或者坐车去较远的医院。她丈夫的腿受伤后，每隔几天就要换药，也常常因为时间不合适而着急。因此，这个消息让他们轻松了不少。
为了保证晚上的服务，诊所重新安排了工作人员。除了医生和护士以外，药房也会有人值班。居民可以提前打电话预约，也可以到现场排队。不过，工作人员提醒大家，病情严重时不能等待，应该马上去大医院。
新安排开始后的第一个晚上，李阿姨陪丈夫去换药。候诊时，一位父亲带女儿来做检查，却不知道那项检查晚上不能进行。工作人员耐心说明情况，并帮他预约了第二天上午的时间。诊所发现原来的通知不够清楚，当晚就在门口增加了详细的服务项目。
晚上八点前，李阿姨和丈夫已经回到家。她认为，延长时间不但方便了上班的人，而且减少了家人之间的麻烦。同时，她也建议诊所把预约电话写得更大一些，让老人经过门口时也能看清楚。
pinyin: zhōu yī zǎo shàng ， lǐ ā yí sòng sūn zi shàng xué hòu ， fā xiàn shè qū zhěn suǒ mén kǒu tiē le yī zhāng xīn tōng zhī 。 cóng xià zhōu qǐ ， zhěn suǒ zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ de fú wù shí jiān jiāng cóng xià wǔ wǔ diǎn yán cháng dào wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn ， zhōu mò ān pái bù biàn 。 wǎn shàng kě yǐ kàn pǔ tōng bìng 、 huàn yào hú le jiě jiàn kāng wèn tí ， dàn shì bù néng zuò xū yào tè bié shè bèi de jiǎn chá 。

lǐ ā yí zài chāo shì gōng zuò ， měi tiān xià wǔ liù diǎn cái xià bān 。 guò qù ， tā shēn tǐ bù shū fú shí ， zhǐ néng qǐng jià qù zhěn suǒ ， huò zhě zuò chē qù jiào yuǎn de yī yuàn 。 tā zhàng fū de tuǐ shòu shāng hòu ， měi gé jǐ tiān jiù yào huàn yào ， yě cháng cháng yīn wèi shí jiān bù hé shì ér zháo jí 。 yīn cǐ ， zhè ge xiāo xī ràng tā men qīng sōng le bù shǎo 。

wèi le bǎo zhèng wǎn shàng de fú wù ， zhěn suǒ chóng xīn ān pái le gōng zuò rén yuán 。 chú le yī shēng hé hù shì yǐ wài ， yào fáng yě huì yǒu rén zhí bān 。 jū mín kě yǐ tí qián dǎ diàn huà yù yuē ， yě kě yǐ dào xiàn chǎng pái duì 。 bù guò ， gōng zuò rén yuán tí xǐng dà jiā ， bìng qíng yán zhòng shí bù néng děng dài ， yīng gāi mǎ shàng qù dà yī yuàn 。

xīn ān pái kāi shǐ hòu de dì yí gè wǎn shàng ， lǐ ā yí péi zhàng fū qù huàn yào 。 hòu zhěn shí ， yī wèi fù qīn dài nǚ ér lái zuò jiǎn chá ， què bù zhī dào nà xiàng jiǎn chá wǎn shàng bù néng jìn xíng 。 gōng zuò rén yuán nài xīn shuō míng qíng kuàng ， bìng bāng tā yù yuē le dì èr tiān shàng wǔ de shí jiān 。 zhěn suǒ fā xiàn yuán lái de tōng zhī bù gòu qīng chǔ ， dàng wǎn jiù zài mén kǒu zēng jiā le xiáng xì de fú wù xiàng mù 。

wǎn shàng bā diǎn qián ， lǐ ā yí hé zhàng fū yǐ jīng huí dào jiā 。 tā rèn wéi ， yán cháng shí jiān bù dàn fāng biàn le shàng bān de rén ， ér qiě jiǎn shǎo le jiā rén zhī jiān de má fán 。 tóng shí ， tā yě jiàn yì zhěn suǒ bǎ yù yuē diàn huà xiě dé gèng dà yī xiē ， ràng lǎo rén jīng guò mén kǒu shí yě néng kàn qīng chǔ 。
translation: On Monday morning, after taking her grandson to school, Aunt Li noticed a new announcement posted at the entrance of the community clinic. Starting the following week, the clinic would extend its weekday service hours from five in the afternoon to nine in the evening, while its weekend schedule would remain unchanged. In the evening, patients could receive treatment for common illnesses, have dressings changed, and ask about health issues, but examinations requiring special equipment would not be available.

Aunt Li worked at a supermarket and did not finish work until six every afternoon. In the past, when she felt unwell, she had to take time off to visit the clinic or travel to a more distant hospital. After her husband injured his leg, he needed to have his dressing changed every few days and often became anxious because the available times were inconvenient. Therefore, the news brought them considerable relief.

To ensure that evening services could be provided, the clinic rearranged its staff schedules. In addition to doctors and nurses, someone would also be on duty at the pharmacy. Residents could make an appointment by phone in advance or wait in line at the clinic. However, the staff reminded everyone that people with serious conditions should not wait and should go to a major hospital immediately.

On the first evening under the new arrangement, Aunt Li accompanied her husband to have his dressing changed. While they were waiting, a father brought his daughter in for an examination, unaware that it could not be performed at night. A staff member patiently explained the situation and helped him book an appointment for the following morning. The clinic realized that its original announcement was not clear enough and added a detailed list of available services at the entrance that same evening.

Before eight in the evening, Aunt Li and her husband were already home. She believed that the extended hours not only made things more convenient for working people but also reduced difficulties for their families. She also suggested that the clinic print its appointment phone number in larger characters so that older people could read it clearly when passing the entrance.

articles.title: 自习室延时服务的两周试行
articles.summary: 海川大学图书馆根据学生的期末复习需要，试行延长自习室开放时间，并通过预约、分区和志愿服务解决管理问题。
articles.topic: 自习室延时服务的两周试行
paragraphs: 临近期末，海川大学图书馆每天晚上都坐满了学生。过去，自习室九点半关门，不少准备考试的学生只好回宿舍继续学习。宿舍里有人休息，也有人打电话，很难保持安静。学生会收集意见后，向图书馆提出延长开放时间，并增加一些方便复习的服务。
图书馆没有立刻改变所有安排，而是选择三楼的两个房间试行两周。试行期间，自习室关门时间延长到晚上十一点。学生只要提前在网上预约，就可以刷学生卡进入。为了让不同需要的学生互不影响，一个房间必须保持安静，另一个房间允许学生小声讨论。
新安排开始后的第三天，负责管理的老师发现，有些学生预约后没有来，真正需要座位的人却进不去。于是，图书馆增加了一条规定：预约者如果晚到二十分钟，座位就会自动让给别人。学生志愿者还会在关门前提醒大家整理物品，并检查桌椅附近是否留下垃圾。
两周以后，图书馆查看了预约记录，也听取了学生和工作人员的意见。空座位比开始时少了，讨论声对安静区的影响也不明显。工作人员虽然下班更晚，但是轮流值班以后，每个人的压力都没有增加太多。这些只是校内试行期间观察到的初步结果，不能代表其他学校的情况。
图书馆决定在考试结束前继续这项服务，同时根据每天的预约人数开放房间。如果使用人数下降，就只开放一个房间。这样的安排既减少了资源浪费，也让学生有了更安静、更方便的复习环境。
pinyin: lín jìn qī mò ， hǎi chuān dà xué tú shū guǎn měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu zuò mǎn le xué shēng 。 guò qù ， zì xí shì jiǔ diǎn bàn guān mén ， bù shǎo zhǔn bèi kǎo shì de xué shēng zhǐ hǎo huí sù shè jì xù xué xí 。 sù shè lǐ yǒu rén xiū xī ， yě yǒu rén dǎ diàn huà ， hěn nán bǎo chí ān jìng 。 xué shēng huì shōu jí yì jiàn hòu ， xiàng tú shū guǎn tí chū yán cháng kāi fàng shí jiān ， bìng zēng jiā yī xiē fāng biàn fù xí de fú wù 。

tú shū guǎn méi yǒu lì kè gǎi biàn suǒ yǒu ān pái ， ér shì xuǎn zé sān lóu de liǎng gè fáng jiān shì xíng liǎng zhōu 。 shì xíng qī jiān ， zì xí shì guān mén shí jiān yán cháng dào wǎn shàng shí yì diǎn 。 xué shēng zhǐ yào tí qián zài wǎng shàng yù yuē ， jiù kě yǐ shuā xué shēng kǎ jìn rù 。 wèi le ràng bù tóng xū yào de xué shēng hù bù yǐng xiǎng ， yí gè fáng jiān bì xū bǎo chí ān jìng ， lìng yí gè fáng jiān yǔn xǔ xué shēng xiǎo shēng tǎo lùn 。

xīn ān pái kāi shǐ hòu de dì sān tiān ， fù zé guǎn lǐ de lǎo shī fā xiàn ， yǒu xiē xué shēng yù yuē hòu méi yǒu lái ， zhēn zhèng xū yào zuò wèi de rén què jìn bù qù 。 yú shì ， tú shū guǎn zēng jiā le yī tiáo guī dìng ： yù yuē zhě rú guǒ wǎn dào èr shí fēn zhōng ， zuò wèi jiù huì zì dòng ràng gěi bié rén 。 xué shēng zhì yuàn zhě hái huì zài guān mén qián tí xǐng dà jiā zhěng lǐ wù pǐn ， bìng jiǎn chá zhuō yǐ fù jìn shì fǒu liú xià lā jī 。

liǎng zhōu yǐ hòu ， tú shū guǎn chá kàn le yù yuē jì lù ， yě tīng qǔ le xué shēng hé gōng zuò rén yuán de yì jiàn 。 kōng zuò wèi bǐ kāi shǐ shí shǎo le ， tǎo lùn shēng duì ān jìng qū de yǐng xiǎng yě bù míng xiǎn 。 gōng zuò rén yuán suī rán xià bān gèng wǎn ， dàn shì lún liú zhí bān yǐ hòu ， měi gè rén de yā lì dōu méi yǒu zēng jiā tài duō 。 zhè xiē zhǐ shì xiào nèi shì xíng qī jiān guān chá dào de chū bù jié guǒ ， bù néng dài biǎo qí tā xué xiào de qíng kuàng 。

tú shū guǎn jué dìng zài kǎo shì jié shù qián jì xù zhè xiàng fú wù ， tóng shí gēn jù měi tiān de yù yuē rén shù kāi fàng fáng jiān 。 rú guǒ shǐ yòng rén shù xià jiàng ， jiù zhǐ kāi fàng yí gè fáng jiān 。 zhè yàng de ān pái jì jiǎn shǎo le zī yuán làng fèi ， yě ràng xué shēng yǒu le gèng ān jìng 、 gèng fāng biàn de fù xí huán jìng 。
translation: As final exams approached, the library at Haichuan University was filled with students every evening. In the past, the study rooms closed at 9:30 p.m., so many students preparing for exams had to return to their dormitories to continue studying. Some people were resting there, while others were making phone calls, which made it difficult to maintain a quiet environment. After collecting opinions, the student union suggested that the library extend its opening hours and add services that would make exam preparation more convenient.

The library did not change all of its arrangements immediately. Instead, it selected two rooms on the third floor for a two-week trial. During the trial, the study rooms remained open until 11 p.m. Students could enter by scanning their student cards as long as they made an online reservation in advance. To prevent students with different needs from disturbing one another, one room had to remain quiet, while quiet discussions were allowed in the other room.

On the third day after the new arrangement began, the teacher responsible for management discovered that some students had made reservations but did not come, while people who actually needed seats could not get in. The library therefore added a rule: if a reservation holder arrived twenty minutes late, the seat would automatically be given to someone else. Student volunteers also reminded everyone to organize their belongings before closing time and checked whether any rubbish had been left near the desks and chairs.

After two weeks, the library reviewed the reservation records and listened to the opinions of students and staff members. There were fewer empty seats than at the beginning, and noise from discussions did not have an obvious effect on the quiet area. Although staff members finished work later, the pressure on each person did not increase too much after they began taking turns on duty. These were only preliminary findings observed during the trial period at this university and cannot be assumed to apply to other schools.

The library decided to continue the service until the end of the examination period and to open rooms according to the number of daily reservations. If the number of users decreased, only one room would be opened. This arrangement not only reduced the waste of resources but also provided students with a quieter and more convenient environment for exam preparation.

articles.title: 书店把灯多留三个小时
articles.summary: 一名护士建议城北书店延长晚间服务时间。书店了解读者和员工的需要后试行两周，最后决定保留每周两个夜间服务日。
articles.topic: 书店把灯多留三个小时
paragraphs: 周三傍晚，林雨下班后赶到城北书店。书店原来晚上六点关门，工作人员正在收拾。林雨是一名护士，白天常常没有固定的休息时间，很难在六点前到店。她在意见本上写道，希望书店每周有几天晚些关门，让下班较晚的人也能借书、还书。第二天，店长看到了这条建议。
店长没有马上改变营业时间，而是先查看最近的借书记录，又和读者及工作人员谈了谈。了解情况后，书店决定先试行两周：周二和周四晚上营业到九点，其他日期保持原来的安排，同时重新安排员工的工作时间。
为了减少读者等待，书店增加了夜间还书箱，并开放预约取书服务。只要读者提前在网上预约，就能在夜间柜台快速取书。考虑到孩子需要早点休息，儿童阅读区仍在七点半关闭，但一楼的普通阅读区继续开放。
第一次夜间开放时，林雨终于借到了想读的小说。几位附近公司的职员也来到店里，有人安静地看书，有人参加八点开始的故事交流会。不过，工作人员发现九点以后公共汽车较少，于是在门口贴出末班车时间，提醒读者提前安排回家的路线。
两周后，书店保留了每周两个夜间服务日，也允许工作人员选择适合自己的班次。这个安排并不是简单地延长时间，而是在读者需要、员工休息和交通条件之间找到平衡。林雨再次来到书店时，在意见本上写下了感谢。
pinyin: zhōu sān bàng wǎn ， lín yǔ xià bān hòu gǎn dào chéng běi shū diàn 。 shū diàn yuán lái wǎn shàng liù diǎn guān mén ， gōng zuò rén yuán zhèng zài shōu shí 。 lín yǔ shì yī míng hù shì ， bái tiān cháng cháng méi yǒu gù dìng de xiū xī shí jiān ， hěn nán zài liù diǎn qián dào diàn 。 tā zài yì jiàn běn shàng xiě dào ， xī wàng shū diàn měi zhōu yǒu jǐ tiān wǎn xiē guān mén ， ràng xià bān jiào wǎn de rén yě néng jiè shū 、 huán shū 。 dì èr tiān ， diàn zhǎng kàn dào le zhè tiáo jiàn yì 。

diàn zhǎng méi yǒu mǎ shàng gǎi biàn yíng yè shí jiān ， ér shì xiān chá kàn zuì jìn de jiè shū jì lù ， yòu hé dú zhě jí gōng zuò rén yuán tán le tán 。 liǎo jiě qíng kuàng hòu ， shū diàn jué dìng xiān shì xíng liǎng zhōu ： zhōu èr hé zhōu sì wǎn shàng yíng yè dào jiǔ diǎn ， qí tā rì qī bǎo chí yuán lái de ān pái ， tóng shí chóng xīn ān pái yuán gōng de gōng zuò shí jiān 。

wèi le jiǎn shǎo dú zhě děng dài ， shū diàn zēng jiā le yè jiān huán shū xiāng ， bìng kāi fàng yù yuē qǔ shū fú wù 。 zhǐ yào dú zhě tí qián zài wǎng shàng yù yuē ， jiù néng zài yè jiān guì tái kuài sù qǔ shū 。 kǎo lǜ dào hái zi xū yào zǎo diǎn xiū xī ， ér tóng yuè dú qū réng zài qī diǎn bàn guān bì ， dàn yī lóu de pǔ tōng yuè dú qū jì xù kāi fàng 。

dì yī cì yè jiān kāi fàng shí ， lín yǔ zhōng yú jiè dào le xiǎng dú de xiǎo shuō 。 jǐ wèi fù jìn gōng sī de zhí yuán yě lái dào diàn lǐ ， yǒu rén ān jìng dì kàn shū ， yǒu rén cān jiā bā diǎn kāi shǐ de gù shì jiāo liú huì 。 bù guò ， gōng zuò rén yuán fā xiàn jiǔ diǎn yǐ hòu gōng gòng qì chē jiào shǎo ， yú shì zài mén kǒu tiē chū mò bān chē shí jiān ， tí xǐng dú zhě tí qián ān pái huí jiā de lù xiàn 。

liǎng zhōu hòu ， shū diàn bǎo liú le měi zhōu liǎng gè yè jiān fú wù rì ， yě yǔn xǔ gōng zuò rén yuán xuǎn zé shì hé zì jǐ de bān cì 。 zhè ge ān pái bìng bú shì jiǎn dān dì yán cháng shí jiān ， ér shì zài dú zhě xū yào 、 yuán gōng xiū xī hé jiāo tōng tiáo jiàn zhī jiān zhǎo dào píng héng 。 lín yǔ zài cì lái dào shū diàn shí ， zài yì jiàn běn shàng xiě xià le gǎn xiè 。
translation: On Wednesday evening, Lin Yu hurried to Chengbei Bookstore after work. The bookstore originally closed at six in the evening, and the staff were tidying up. Lin Yu was a nurse and often had no fixed break during the day, so it was difficult for her to arrive before six. She wrote in the suggestion book that she hoped the bookstore could close later on several days each week, allowing people who finished work late to borrow and return books. The next day, the manager saw her suggestion.

The manager did not change the business hours immediately. Instead, the manager first reviewed recent borrowing records and spoke with readers and staff members. After learning about the situation, the bookstore decided to conduct a two-week trial: it would remain open until nine on Tuesday and Thursday evenings, keep its original schedule on other days, and rearrange the employees' working hours.

To reduce readers' waiting time, the bookstore added a nighttime book-return box and introduced a reserved-book pickup service. As long as readers made an online reservation in advance, they could quickly collect their books from the nighttime counter. Considering that children needed to rest early, the children's reading area still closed at seven thirty, but the general reading area on the first floor remained open.

On the first night of extended opening, Lin Yu finally borrowed the novel she wanted to read. Several employees from nearby companies also came to the bookstore. Some read quietly, while others joined a story discussion that began at eight. However, the staff noticed that there were fewer buses after nine, so they posted the last-bus times by the entrance and reminded readers to plan their routes home in advance.

After two weeks, the bookstore kept two evening service days each week and also allowed staff members to choose shifts that suited them. This arrangement did not simply extend the opening hours; instead, it found a balance among readers' needs, employees' rest, and transportation conditions. When Lin Yu returned to the bookstore, she wrote a note of thanks in the suggestion book.

articles.title: 城南体育中心延长晚间服务时间
articles.summary: 城南体育中心根据使用者的意见延长工作日晚间开放时间，并通过调整人员、课程报名和服务地点来改善运动体验。
articles.topic: 城南体育中心延长晚间服务时间
paragraphs: 城南体育中心过去每天下午七点关门。附近不少上班族虽然办了月卡，却常常因为下班较晚，赶不上游泳课或羽毛球活动。中心收到大家的意见后，决定从下周一开始，把周一到周五的开放时间延长到晚上十点，周末仍按原来的时间开放。
为了让新安排顺利进行，中心重新安排了工作人员的上班时间，并在晚上增加了一名教练。游泳池和球场可以使用到九点半，最后半小时用来打扫和检查。参加集体课程的人需要提前一天在手机上报名；如果临时不能来，应及时取消，把位置留给别人。
星期二晚上，住在附近的林静第一次下班后去运动。她八点才到，本来担心没有空球场，没想到前台很快帮她找到了一块场地。运动结束后，她还在休息区喝了水，九点四十分离开。她说，以前只能周末来，现在平日也能安排运动，生活轻松了不少。
从新安排实行第一周的情况来看，晚上八点以后来运动的人明显增加，但出口附近也出现过排队现象。中心因此把归还球拍和储物柜钥匙的地方分开，并提醒大家不要等到关门前才离开。负责人表示，延长时间不只是晚关门，还要让服务和安全跟得上，中心会继续根据使用情况调整安排。
pinyin: chéng nán tǐ yù zhōng xīn guò qù měi tiān xià wǔ qī diǎn guān mén 。 fù jìn bù shǎo shàng bān zú suī rán bàn le yuè kǎ ， què cháng cháng yīn wèi xià bān jiào wǎn ， gǎn bù shàng yóu yǒng kè huò yǔ máo qiú huó dòng 。 zhōng xīn shōu dào dà jiā de yì jiàn hòu ， jué dìng cóng xià zhōu yī kāi shǐ ， bǎ zhōu yī dào zhōu wǔ de kāi fàng shí jiān yán cháng dào wǎn shàng shí diǎn ， zhōu mò réng àn yuán lái de shí jiān kāi fàng 。

wèi le ràng xīn ān pái shùn lì jìn xíng ， zhōng xīn zhòng xīn ān pái le gōng zuò rén yuán de shàng bān shí jiān ， bìng zài wǎn shàng zēng jiā le yī míng jiào liàn 。 yóu yǒng chí hé qiú chǎng kě yǐ shǐ yòng dào jiǔ diǎn bàn ， zuì hòu bàn xiǎo shí yòng lái dǎ sǎo hé jiǎn chá 。 cān jiā jí tǐ kè chéng de rén xū yào tí qián yī tiān zài shǒu jī shàng bào míng ； rú guǒ lín shí bù néng lái ， yīng jí shí qǔ xiāo ， bǎ wèi zhì liú gěi bié rén 。

xīng qī èr wǎn shàng ， zhù zài fù jìn de lín jìng dì yī cì xià bān hòu qù yùn dòng 。 tā bā diǎn cái dào ， běn lái dān xīn méi yǒu kòng qiú chǎng ， méi xiǎng dào qián tái hěn kuài bāng tā zhǎo dào le yī kuài chǎng dì 。 yùn dòng jié shù hòu ， tā hái zài xiū xī qū hē le shuǐ ， jiǔ diǎn sì shí fēn lí kāi 。 tā shuō ， yǐ qián zhǐ néng zhōu mò lái ， xiàn zài píng rì yě néng ān pái yùn dòng ， shēng huó qīng sōng le bù shǎo 。

cóng xīn ān pái shí xíng dì yī zhōu de qíng kuàng lái kàn ， wǎn shàng bā diǎn yǐ hòu lái yùn dòng de rén míng xiǎn zēng jiā ， dàn chū kǒu fù jìn yě chū xiàn guò pái duì xiàn xiàng 。 zhōng xīn yīn cǐ bǎ guī huán qiú pāi hé chǔ wù guì yào shi de dì fāng fēn kāi ， bìng tí xǐng dà jiā bú yào děng dào guān mén qián cái lí kāi 。 fù zé rén biǎo shì ， yán cháng shí jiān bù zhǐ shì wǎn guān mén ， hái yào ràng fú wù hé ān quán gēn dé shàng ， zhōng xīn huì jì xù gēn jù shǐ yòng qíng kuàng tiáo zhěng ān pái 。
translation: The Chengnan Sports Center used to close at seven o'clock every afternoon. Although many office workers living nearby had purchased monthly passes, they often missed swimming classes or badminton activities because they finished work late. After receiving their comments, the center decided to extend its opening hours from Monday to Friday until ten in the evening starting next Monday, while keeping its weekend hours unchanged.

To make the new arrangement work smoothly, the center reorganized the staff schedules and added another coach in the evening. The swimming pool and courts can be used until nine thirty, and the final half hour is reserved for cleaning and inspections. People attending group classes need to register on their phones one day in advance. If they suddenly cannot attend, they should cancel promptly and leave the place for someone else.

On Tuesday evening, Lin Jing, who lives nearby, went there to exercise after work for the first time. She did not arrive until eight and was worried that no courts would be available, but the front desk quickly helped her find one. After exercising, she drank some water in the rest area and left at nine forty. She said that she used to be able to visit only on weekends, but now she could exercise on weekdays as well, making her life much easier.

Judging from the first week after the new arrangement was introduced, noticeably more people came to exercise after eight in the evening, but lines also formed near the exit. The center therefore separated the places for returning rackets and locker keys, and reminded everyone not to wait until closing time to leave. The manager said that extending the hours was not simply a matter of closing later; the quality of service and safety also had to keep up. The center will continue adjusting its arrangements according to how the facilities are used.

articles.title: 下班后也能办手续
articles.summary: 政务服务厅延长工作日服务时间，周琳提前确认材料后，终于在下班后办完了营业执照地址变更手续。
articles.topic: 下班后也能办手续
paragraphs: 在这个教学案例中，海州市政务服务厅在门口贴出通知：从下周一开始，工作日的服务时间将从下午五点延长到晚上七点。住在附近的周琳下班时看到了通知。她在一家药店工作，通常六点才下班，过去为了办理营业执照的地址变更，已经请过两次假，却都因为材料不全没能办完。
她没有马上去排队，而是先给服务厅打电话。工作人员告诉她，晚间可以办理常见业务，但有些需要多个部门一起检查的事项仍要白天办理。周琳说明自己的情况后，对方列出了身份证、租房合同和新的店面证明，还提醒她提前在网上取号，并在六点半以前到达。
星期三晚上六点十分，周琳带着整理好的材料来到服务厅。她按号码到了三号窗口，工作人员检查后发现，合同里少了一页房东签字的证明。周琳有些着急，幸好手机里保存着电子文件。大厅提供打印服务，她很快补上了这一页。六点四十五分，手续终于办完，她不用再为这件事请假了。
离开前，周琳向工作人员表示感谢。工作人员说，延长时间是为了给上班族更多选择，但并不是所有业务都能在晚上办理，大家最好先电话确认，也不要在快关门时才来。服务厅还准备把晚间最常见的问题写成清楚的说明，放在取号机旁边。新的安排不能解决每个人的困难，却让服务时间更接近市民的生活。
pinyin: zài zhè ge jiào xué àn lì zhōng ， hǎi zhōu shì zhèng wù fú wù tīng zài mén kǒu tiē chū tōng zhī ： cóng xià zhōu yī kāi shǐ ， gōng zuò rì de fú wù shí jiān jiāng cóng xià wǔ wǔ diǎn yán cháng dào wǎn shàng qī diǎn 。 zhù zài fù jìn de zhōu lín xià bān shí kàn dào le tōng zhī 。 tā zài yī jiā yào diàn gōng zuò ， tōng cháng liù diǎn cái xià bān ， guò qù wèi le bàn lǐ yíng yè zhí zhào de dì zhǐ biàn gēng ， yǐ jīng qǐng guò liǎng cì jiǎ ， què dōu yīn wèi cái liào bù quán méi néng bàn wán 。

tā méi yǒu mǎ shàng qù pái duì ， ér shì xiān gěi fú wù tīng dǎ diàn huà 。 gōng zuò rén yuán gào sù tā ， wǎn jiān kě yǐ bàn lǐ cháng jiàn yè wù ， dàn yǒu xiē xū yào duō gè bù mén yì qǐ jiǎn chá de shì xiàng réng yào bái tiān bàn lǐ 。 zhōu lín shuō míng zì jǐ de qíng kuàng hòu ， duì fāng liè chū le shēn fèn zhèng 、 zū fáng hé tóng hé xīn de diàn miàn zhèng míng ， hái tí xǐng tā tí qián zài wǎng shàng qǔ hào ， bìng zài liù diǎn bàn yǐ qián dào dá 。

xīng qī sān wǎn shàng liù diǎn shí fēn ， zhōu lín dài zhe zhěng lǐ hǎo de cái liào lái dào fú wù tīng 。 tā àn hào mǎ dào le sān hào chuāng kǒu ， gōng zuò rén yuán jiǎn chá hòu fā xiàn ， hé tóng lǐ shǎo le yī yè fáng dōng qiān zì de zhèng míng 。 zhōu lín yǒu xiē zháo jí ， xìng hǎo shǒu jī lǐ bǎo cún zhe diàn zi wén jiàn 。 dà tīng tí gōng dǎ yìn fú wù ， tā hěn kuài bǔ shàng le zhè yī yè 。 liù diǎn sì shí wǔ fēn ， shǒu xù zhōng yú bàn wán ， tā bù yòng zài wèi zhè jiàn shì qǐng jià le 。

lí kāi qián ， zhōu lín xiàng gōng zuò rén yuán biǎo shì gǎn xiè 。 gōng zuò rén yuán shuō ， yán cháng shí jiān shì wèi le gěi shàng bān zú gèng duō xuǎn zé ， dàn bìng bú shì suǒ yǒu yè wù dōu néng zài wǎn shàng bàn lǐ ， dà jiā zuì hǎo xiān diàn huà què rèn ， yě bú yào zài kuài guān mén shí cái lái 。 fú wù tīng hái zhǔn bèi bǎ wǎn jiān zuì cháng jiàn de wèn tí xiě chéng qīng chǔ de shuō míng ， fàng zài qǔ hào jī páng biān 。 xīn de ān pái bù néng jiě jué měi gè rén de kùn nán ， què ràng fú wù shí jiān gèng jiē jìn shì mín de shēng huó 。
translation: In this teaching case, the Haizhou Government Service Hall posted a notice at its entrance: starting next Monday, its weekday service hours would be extended from five in the afternoon to seven in the evening. Zhou Lin, who lived nearby, saw the notice after work. She worked at a pharmacy and usually did not finish until six. In the past, she had taken leave twice to change the address on the business license, but she had been unable to complete the process because her documents were incomplete.

Instead of immediately going there to wait in line, she first called the service hall. A staff member told her that common services were available in the evening, but matters requiring checks by several departments still had to be handled during the day. After Zhou Lin explained her situation, the staff member listed her identity card, rental contract, and proof of the new business location, and also reminded her to get a queue number online in advance and arrive before six thirty.

At ten past six on Wednesday evening, Zhou Lin arrived at the service hall with her documents in order. When her number was called, she went to Window Three. During the review, the staff member found that the contract was missing a page containing the landlord's signature. Zhou Lin became worried, but fortunately she had saved an electronic copy on her phone. Printing was available in the hall, so she quickly added the missing page. At six forty-five, the process was finally complete, and she no longer needed to take leave for the matter.

Before leaving, Zhou Lin thanked the staff member. The staff member said that the extended hours were intended to give working people more choices, but not every service was available in the evening. People were advised to call first for confirmation and not to arrive just before closing. The service hall also planned to write clear explanations of the most common evening questions and place them beside the queue-number machine. The new arrangement could not solve everyone's difficulties, but it made service hours better suited to residents' daily lives.

articles.title: 把画室的灯多开三个小时
articles.summary: 区文化馆根据居民的实际困难延长部分晚间服务时间，并通过预约、值班和意见记录改善艺术课程安排。
articles.topic: 把画室的灯多开三个小时
paragraphs: 周二下午，林雨又收到公司临时开会的通知。会议结束时，已经快六点了，而区文化馆的画画课正好在六点开始。她赶到文化馆时，教室已经关门。过去两个月，她因为加班错过了好几次课。回家前，她在意见本上写下建议，希望文化馆能在部分工作日延长开放时间。
文化馆没有马上改变时间，而是先了解其他居民的需要。工作人员在一周内询问了参加画画、书法和音乐课的学员，也请老师说明晚上上课可能遇到的问题。有人担心回家太晚，有人希望增加周末课程。最后，文化馆决定从下周起，每周二和周四开放到晚上九点。
新的安排不只是把关门时间推迟。为了保证安全，文化馆增加了晚班工作人员，并要求参加夜间课程的学员提前预约。只要预约人数达到开课要求，老师就会按时上课。如果人数不够，工作人员会在当天下午通知学员，还可以帮助他们选择其他日期。大厅里也准备了热水和简单的休息区。
第一个周四，林雨终于完整地上完了一节画画课。下课后，她没有立刻离开，而是把自己的感受写在新的意见卡上。她认为预约方法很方便，但希望文化馆把课程变化更早发到手机上。负责人表示，文化馆会记录晚间服务中出现的问题，再根据居民和老师的意见继续调整。
pinyin: zhōu èr xià wǔ ， lín yǔ yòu shōu dào gōng sī lín shí kāi huì de tōng zhī 。 huì yì jié shù shí ， yǐ jīng kuài liù diǎn le ， ér qū wén huà guǎn de huà huà kè zhèng hǎo zài liù diǎn kāi shǐ 。 tā gǎn dào wén huà guǎn shí ， jiào shì yǐ jīng guān mén 。 guò qù liǎng gè yuè ， tā yīn wèi jiā bān cuò guò le hǎo jǐ cì kè 。 huí jiā qián ， tā zài yì jiàn běn shàng xiě xià jiàn yì ， xī wàng wén huà guǎn néng zài bù fèn gōng zuò rì yán cháng kāi fàng shí jiān 。

wén huà guǎn méi yǒu mǎ shàng gǎi biàn shí jiān ， ér shì xiān liǎo jiě qí tā jū mín de xū yào 。 gōng zuò rén yuán zài yī zhōu nèi xún wèn le cān jiā huà huà 、 shū fǎ hé yīn yuè kè de xué yuán ， yě qǐng lǎo shī shuō míng wǎn shàng shàng kè kě néng yù dào de wèn tí 。 yǒu rén dān xīn huí jiā tài wǎn ， yǒu rén xī wàng zēng jiā zhōu mò kè chéng 。 zuì hòu ， wén huà guǎn jué dìng cóng xià zhōu qǐ ， měi zhōu èr hé zhōu sì kāi fàng dào wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn 。

xīn de ān pái bù zhǐ shì bǎ guān mén shí jiān tuī chí 。 wèi le bǎo zhèng ān quán ， wén huà guǎn zēng jiā le wǎn bān gōng zuò rén yuán ， bìng yāo qiú cān jiā yè jiān kè chéng de xué yuán tí qián yù yuē 。 zhǐ yào yù yuē rén shù dá dào kāi kè yāo qiú ， lǎo shī jiù huì àn shí shàng kè 。 rú guǒ rén shù bù gòu ， gōng zuò rén yuán huì zài dàng tiān xià wǔ tōng zhī xué yuán ， hái kě yǐ bāng zhù tā men xuǎn zé qí tā rì qī 。 dà tīng lǐ yě zhǔn bèi le rè shuǐ hé jiǎn dān de xiū xī qū 。

dì yí gè zhōu sì ， lín yǔ zhōng yú wán zhěng dì shàng wán le yī jié huà huà kè 。 xià kè hòu ， tā méi yǒu lì kè lí kāi ， ér shì bǎ zì jǐ de gǎn shòu xiě zài xīn de yì jiàn kǎ shàng 。 tā rèn wéi yù yuē fāng fǎ hěn fāng biàn ， dàn xī wàng wén huà guǎn bǎ kè chéng biàn huà gèng zǎo fā dào shǒu jī shàng 。 fù zé rén biǎo shì ， wén huà guǎn huì jì lù wǎn jiān fú wù zhōng chū xiàn de wèn tí ， zài gēn jù jū mín hé lǎo shī de yì jiàn jì xù tiáo zhěng 。
translation: On Tuesday afternoon, Lin Yu once again received notice of an unexpected meeting at her company. By the time the meeting ended, it was almost six o'clock, exactly when the painting class at the district cultural center began. When she arrived, the classroom had already closed. Over the past two months, she had missed several classes because of overtime work. Before going home, she wrote a suggestion in the comment book, hoping that the center could extend its opening hours on some weekdays.

The cultural center did not change its schedule immediately. Instead, it first tried to understand the needs of other residents. During the following week, staff members asked students in painting, calligraphy, and music classes for their views, and they also asked teachers to explain possible problems with evening lessons. Some people worried about returning home too late, while others hoped for more weekend classes. In the end, the center decided that starting the next week, it would stay open until nine in the evening every Tuesday and Thursday.

The new arrangement involved more than simply closing later. To ensure safety, the cultural center added evening staff and required students in night classes to make reservations in advance. As long as the number of reservations meets the requirement for opening a class, the teacher will begin on time. If there are not enough students, staff members will notify them that afternoon and can also help them choose another date. Hot water and a simple rest area were also provided in the lobby.

On the first Thursday, Lin Yu finally completed an entire painting class. After class, she did not leave immediately but wrote about her experience on a new comment card. She thought the reservation process was convenient, but hoped the cultural center would send course changes to mobile phones earlier. The person in charge said that the center would record problems arising from the evening service and continue making adjustments based on feedback from residents and teachers.

articles.title: 青河站把关门时间推迟了
articles.summary: 一位旅客建议火车站在客流较多的晚上延长服务时间，车站经过记录和试行后，决定继续采用新的安排。
articles.topic: 青河站把关门时间推迟了
paragraphs: 周五晚上，林然坐火车去外地参加朋友的婚礼。她下班后赶到青河站时，离开车还有四十分钟，却发现服务中心已经关门。她想借轮椅给腿脚不方便的母亲使用，只好去问检票员。
旅行结束后，林然在车站的意见本上写下建议：周五和周日晚上旅客较多，服务中心可以晚关一小时。她还提出，不必每天增加时间，可以先选择客流较多的晚上，这样工作人员也不会太累。
车站负责人没有马上改变安排，而是先查看近一个月的值班记录，并请工作人员连续两周记下晚间来问路、借物品和改签的旅客人数。两周后，负责人说，这些记录还不够多，所以车站决定先试行一段时间，再看实际效果。
随后，服务中心开始试行新时间：周五、周日延长到晚上九点，其他日期仍按原来的时间关门。为了让旅客容易找到帮助，车站在入口和候车室贴了通知，还在关门后留下一个服务电话。
第一个周日，林然再次经过青河站，看见一位老人顺利借到轮椅。工作人员告诉她，延长服务后，晚上排队的人虽然增加了，但多数问题都能很快解决。试行结束时，车站决定继续这个安排，并根据节假日的客流调整时间。
pinyin: zhōu wǔ wǎn shàng ， lín rán zuò huǒ chē qù wài dì cān jiā péng yǒu de hūn lǐ 。 tā xià bān hòu gǎn dào qīng hé zhàn shí ， lí kāi chē hái yǒu sì shí fēn zhōng ， què fā xiàn fú wù zhōng xīn yǐ jīng guān mén 。 tā xiǎng jiè lún yǐ gěi tuǐ jiǎo bù fāng biàn de mǔ qīn shǐ yòng ， zhǐ hǎo qù wèn jiǎn piào yuán 。

dì yí gè zhōu rì ， lín rán zài cì jīng guò qīng hé zhàn ， kàn jiàn yī wèi lǎo rén shùn lì jiè dào lún yǐ 。 gōng zuò rén yuán gào sù tā ， yán cháng fú wù hòu ， wǎn shàng pái duì de rén suī rán zēng jiā le ， dàn duō shù wèn tí dōu néng hěn kuài jiě jué 。 shì xíng jié shù shí ， chē zhàn jué dìng jì xù zhè ge ān pái ， bìng gēn jù jié jià rì de kè liú tiáo zhěng shí jiān 。
translation: On Friday evening, Lin Ran took a train to another city to attend a friend's wedding. When she hurried to Qinghe Station after work, there were still forty minutes before departure, but she found that the service center had already closed. She wanted to borrow a wheelchair for her mother, who had difficulty walking, so she had to ask a ticket inspector for help.

After the trip, Lin Ran wrote a suggestion in the station's comment book: there were more passengers on Friday and Sunday evenings, so the service center could close one hour later. She also suggested that the hours did not need to be extended every day. The station could first choose evenings with heavier passenger traffic so that the staff would not become too tired.

The station manager did not change the schedule immediately. Instead, the manager first reviewed the duty records from the previous month and asked the staff to record for two consecutive weeks how many passengers came in the evening to ask for directions, borrow items, or change tickets. Two weeks later, the manager said that these records were still not enough, so the station decided to try the new schedule for a while and then evaluate the actual results.

After that, the service center began testing a new schedule: on Fridays and Sundays, it stayed open until nine in the evening, while on other days it still closed at the original time. To make it easier for passengers to find help, the station posted notices at the entrance and in the waiting room, and it also provided a service phone number for use after closing.

On the first Sunday, Lin Ran passed through Qinghe Station again and saw an elderly person successfully borrow a wheelchair. A staff member told her that although more people waited in line at night after the service hours were extended, most problems could be solved quickly. At the end of the trial, the station decided to continue the arrangement and adjust the hours according to passenger traffic during holidays.
