articles.title: 先听完一节课，再决定是否换班
articles.summary: 一家培训机构试行新的换班规则，通过试听、沟通和记录解决学员频繁换班带来的问题。
articles.topic: 先听完一节课，再决定是否换班
paragraphs: 在一份课堂管理教学案例中，一家成人语言培训机构遇到了一个难题：不少学员报名后，发现课程速度、上课时间或教师风格不适合自己，于是马上提出换班。前台为了让学员满意，通常会立刻办理，但频繁换班不但打乱了教学计划，还使一些班级突然过满，另一些班级却空出了许多座位。
机构负责人没有直接取消换班服务，而是邀请教师、课程顾问和学员代表共同讨论。他们决定试行一条新规则：学员提出申请后，先到目标班级完整试听一节课，再与原班教师和课程顾问各谈一次。工作人员必须说明两个班的学习进度和作业要求，不能只根据空位决定是否接受申请。
新规则开始时，有些学员觉得手续太麻烦。一位姓周的学员因为工作时间改变，急着从周末班转到晚班。他原以为谈话只是浪费时间，试听后却发现晚班已经学完了三章，课堂练习也需要更快完成。如果立刻转入，他很可能跟不上。因此，他接受了顾问的建议，暂时留在原班，并通过线上录音补上因加班错过的内容。
调查人员在这个教学案例中连续观察了四周。他们没有只计算换班人数，而是记录申请原因、试听感受以及教师的意见。阶段观察显示，真正因时间冲突而需要换班的学员仍能顺利办理；只是因为一次作业太难或一次课堂表现不理想就想换班的人，则更愿意先解决具体问题。教师也开始主动说明课程安排，减少了学员因误解产生的不满。
试行结束后，机构保留了这条规则，同时作出两项调整。第一，情况紧急的学员可以当天完成试听和谈话；第二，如果目标班级的进度差别很小，就不必提交额外的学习计划。负责人认为，规则的目的不是阻止学员改变选择，而是让决定建立在充分了解之上。对培训机构来说，真正有效的管理既要维持正常秩序，也要给个人困难留下合理的处理空间。
pinyin: zài yī fèn kè táng guǎn lǐ jiào xué àn lì zhōng ， yī jiā chéng rén yǔ yán péi xùn jī gòu yù dào le yí gè nán tí ： bù shǎo xué yuán bào míng hòu ， fā xiàn kè chéng sù dù 、 shàng kè shí jiān huò jiào shī fēng gé bú shì hé zì jǐ ， yú shì mǎ shàng tí chū huàn bān 。 qián tái wèi le ràng xué yuán mǎn yì ， tōng cháng huì lì kè bàn lǐ ， dàn pín fán huàn bān bù dàn dǎ luàn le jiào xué jì huà ， hái shǐ yī xiē bān jí tū rán guò mǎn ， lìng yī xiē bān jí què kòng chū le xǔ duō zuò wèi 。

jī gòu fù zé rén méi yǒu zhí jiē qǔ xiāo huàn bān fú wù ， ér shì yāo qǐng jiào shī 、 kè chéng gù wèn hé xué yuán dài biǎo gòng tóng tǎo lùn 。 tā men jué dìng shì xíng yī tiáo xīn guī zé ： xué yuán tí chū shēn qǐng hòu ， xiān dào mù biāo bān jí wán zhěng shì tīng yī jié kè ， zài yǔ yuán bān jiào shī hé kè chéng gù wèn gè tán yī cì 。 gōng zuò rén yuán bì xū shuō míng liǎng gè bān de xué xí jìn dù hé zuò yè yāo qiú ， bù néng zhǐ gēn jù kòng wèi jué dìng shì fǒu jiē shòu shēn qǐng 。

xīn guī zé kāi shǐ shí ， yǒu xiē xué yuán jué de shǒu xù tài má fán 。 yī wèi xìng zhōu de xué yuán yīn wèi gōng zuò shí jiān gǎi biàn ， jí zhe cóng zhōu mò bān zhuǎn dào wǎn bān 。 tā yuán yǐ wéi tán huà zhǐ shì làng fèi shí jiān ， shì tīng hòu què fā xiàn wǎn bān yǐ jīng xué wán le sān zhāng ， kè táng liàn xí yě xū yào gèng kuài wán chéng 。 rú guǒ lì kè zhuǎn rù ， tā hěn kě néng gēn bù shàng 。 yīn cǐ ， tā jiē shòu le gù wèn de jiàn yì ， zàn shí liú zài yuán bān ， bìng tōng guò xiàn shàng lù yīn bǔ shàng yīn jiā bān cuò guò de nèi róng 。

diào chá rén yuán zài zhè ge jiào xué àn lì zhōng lián xù guān chá le sì zhōu 。 tā men méi yǒu zhǐ jì suàn huàn bān rén shù ， ér shì jì lù shēn qǐng yuán yīn 、 shì tīng gǎn shòu yǐ jí jiào shī de yì jiàn 。 jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， zhēn zhèng yīn shí jiān chōng tū ér xū yào huàn bān de xué yuán réng néng shùn lì bàn lǐ ； zhǐ shì yīn wèi yī cì zuò yè tài nán huò yī cì kè táng biǎo xiàn bù lǐ xiǎng jiù xiǎng huàn bān de rén ， zé gèng yuàn yì xiān jiě jué jù tǐ wèn tí 。 jiào shī yě kāi shǐ zhǔ dòng shuō míng kè chéng ān pái ， jiǎn shǎo le xué yuán yīn wù jiě chǎn shēng de bù mǎn 。

shì xíng jié shù hòu ， jī gòu bǎo liú le zhè tiáo guī zé ， tóng shí zuò chū liǎng xiàng tiáo zhěng 。 dì yī ， qíng kuàng jǐn jí de xué yuán kě yǐ dàng tiān wán chéng shì tīng hé tán huà ； dì èr ， rú guǒ mù biāo bān jí de jìn dù chā bié hěn xiǎo ， jiù bù bì tí jiāo é wài de xué xí jì huà 。 fù zé rén rèn wéi ， guī zé de mù dì bú shì zǔ zhǐ xué yuán gǎi biàn xuǎn zé ， ér shì ràng jué dìng jiàn lì zài chōng fèn liǎo jiě zhī shàng 。 duì péi xùn jī gòu lái shuō ， zhēn zhèng yǒu xiào de guǎn lǐ jì yào wéi chí zhèng cháng zhì xù ， yě yào gěi gè rén kùn nán liú xià hé lǐ de chǔ lǐ kōng jiān 。
translation: In a classroom-management teaching case, an adult language training institution faced a problem: after enrolling, many learners found that the course pace, class time, or teaching style did not suit them, so they immediately requested a class transfer. To satisfy the learners, the reception staff usually processed such requests at once. However, frequent transfers not only disrupted teaching plans but also caused some classes to become suddenly overcrowded while many seats were left empty in others.

Instead of simply canceling the transfer service, the head of the institution invited teachers, course advisers, and learner representatives to discuss the issue together. They decided to test a new rule: after submitting a request, a learner would first attend one complete trial lesson in the intended class and then speak separately with the original teacher and a course adviser. Staff had to explain the learning progress and homework requirements of both classes rather than making a decision based only on available seats.

When the new rule was introduced, some learners thought the procedure was too troublesome. A learner named Zhou urgently wanted to move from a weekend class to an evening class because his work schedule had changed. He initially believed that the conversations would only waste time, but after the trial lesson, he discovered that the evening class had already completed three chapters and required faster completion of classroom exercises. If he transferred immediately, he would probably be unable to keep up. He therefore accepted the adviser's suggestion, remained in his original class for the time being, and used online recordings to catch up on content he had missed because of overtime work.

The investigators observed the teaching case for four consecutive weeks. Instead of counting only the number of transfers, they recorded the reasons for applications, reactions to trial lessons, and teachers' opinions. The interim observations showed that learners who truly needed to transfer because of schedule conflicts could still complete the process smoothly. Those who wanted to transfer merely because one assignment was too difficult or one class performance was disappointing became more willing to solve the specific problem first. Teachers also began to explain course arrangements proactively, reducing dissatisfaction caused by misunderstandings.

After the trial ended, the institution kept the rule while making two adjustments. First, learners with urgent circumstances could complete the trial lesson and conversations on the same day. Second, if there was little difference in progress between the two classes, no additional study plan was required. The person in charge believed that the purpose of the rule was not to prevent learners from changing their choice, but to ensure that decisions were based on sufficient understanding. For a training institution, truly effective management must both maintain normal order and leave reasonable room for handling individual difficulties.

articles.title: 末班车的“招手停”试行
articles.summary: 一家公共交通公司先在三座车站试行夜间招手停车规则，并根据乘客和司机的意见调整执行方法，最终决定逐步扩大试行范围。
articles.topic: 末班车的“招手停”试行
paragraphs: 本文是一个公共交通管理的教学案例。海州市公共交通公司收到不少夜班乘客的意见：晚上十点以后，有些车站虽然还有人在等车，末班车司机却可能因为光线不足而没有看见。乘客一旦错过，就只能花更多的钱打车回家。
公司没有立刻修改所有线路的规定，而是先选择机场路、中心医院和工业园三个车站进行为期两周的试行。这些地方夜间乘客较多，等车的人既有刚下班的工人，也有带着行李的旅客，因此比较容易发现新规则是否有效。
按照试行规则，晚上十点以后，乘客看见公交车接近时，可以在安全区域举手示意。司机确认周围没有危险后，应当减速进站。公司还在站牌旁增加了灯光，并通过车内广播提醒乘客：招手只表示希望上车，不能为了追车突然跑到马路中间。
第一周，一些司机反映，他们要同时观察道路、站牌和乘客的动作，精神压力比以前大。有位司机还把正在整理头发的乘客误认为是在招手，结果临时停车，耽误了几分钟。公司没有批评这位司机，而是请司机和乘客代表一起讨论，决定把示意动作改为连续举手三秒。
第二周的阶段观察显示，错过末班车的情况减少了，但新的问题也出现了。下雨时，乘客拿着雨伞，很难做出清楚的动作；站内人数较多时，司机也不容易判断是谁要上车。工作人员于是给三个车站安装按钮，乘客按下后，站牌顶部会亮起蓝灯。
试行结束后，公司没有宣布新规则已经完全成功，而是保存司机记录、乘客建议和现场照片，作为下一步调整的材料。负责人认为，蓝灯既能提醒司机，也能避免乘客靠近机动车道。公司决定再选择两条夜间线路继续试行，等安全问题得到解决后，再考虑逐步扩大范围。
pinyin: běn wén shì yí gè gōng gòng jiāo tōng guǎn lǐ de jiào xué àn lì 。 hǎi zhōu shì gōng gòng jiāo tōng gōng sī shōu dào bù shǎo yè bān chéng kè de yì jiàn ： wǎn shàng shí diǎn yǐ hòu ， yǒu xiē chē zhàn suī rán hái yǒu rén zài děng chē ， mò bān chē sī jī què kě néng yīn wèi guāng xiàn bù zú ér méi yǒu kàn jiàn 。 chéng kè yí dàn cuò guò ， jiù zhǐ néng huā gèng duō de qián dǎ chē huí jiā 。

gōng sī méi yǒu lì kè xiū gǎi suǒ yǒu xiàn lù de guī dìng ， ér shì xiān xuǎn zé jī chǎng lù 、 zhōng xīn yī yuàn hé gōng yè yuán sān gè chē zhàn jìn xíng wéi qī liǎng zhōu de shì xíng 。 zhè xiē dì fāng yè jiān chéng kè jiào duō ， děng chē de rén jì yǒu gāng xià bān de gōng rén ， yě yǒu dài zhe xíng lǐ de lǚ kè ， yīn cǐ bǐ jiào róng yì fā xiàn xīn guī zé shì fǒu yǒu xiào 。

dì yī zhōu ， yī xiē sī jī fǎn yìng ， tā men yào tóng shí guān chá dào lù 、 zhàn pái hé chéng kè de dòng zuò ， jīng shén yā lì bǐ yǐ qián dà 。 yǒu wèi sī jī hái bǎ zhèng zài zhěng lǐ tóu fà de chéng kè wù rèn wèi shì zài zhāo shǒu ， jié guǒ lín shí tíng chē ， dān wù le jǐ fēn zhōng 。 gōng sī méi yǒu pī píng zhè wèi sī jī ， ér shì qǐng sī jī hé chéng kè dài biǎo yì qǐ tǎo lùn ， jué dìng bǎ shì yì dòng zuò gǎi wéi lián xù jǔ shǒu sān miǎo 。

dì èr zhōu de jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， cuò guò mò bān chē de qíng kuàng jiǎn shǎo le ， dàn xīn de wèn tí yě chū xiàn le 。 xià yǔ shí ， chéng kè ná zhe yǔ sǎn ， hěn nán zuò chū qīng chǔ de dòng zuò ； zhàn nèi rén shù jiào duō shí ， sī jī yě bù róng yì pàn duàn shì shuí yào shàng chē 。 gōng zuò rén yuán yú shì gěi sān gè chē zhàn ān zhuāng àn niǔ ， chéng kè àn xià hòu ， zhàn pái dǐng bù huì liàng qǐ lán dēng 。

shì xíng jié shù hòu ， gōng sī méi yǒu xuān bù xīn guī zé yǐ jīng wán quán chéng gōng ， ér shì bǎo cún sī jī jì lù 、 chéng kè jiàn yì hé xiàn chǎng zhào piān ， zuò wéi xià yī bù diào zhěng de cái liào 。 fù zé rén rèn wéi ， lán dēng jì néng tí xǐng sī jī ， yě néng bì miǎn chéng kè kào jìn jī dòng chē dào 。 gōng sī jué dìng zài xuǎn zé liǎng tiáo yè jiān xiàn lù jì xù shì xíng ， děng ān quán wèn tí dé dào jiě jué hòu ， zài kǎo lǜ zhú bù kuò dà fàn wéi 。
translation: This is a teaching case about public transportation management. Haizhou Public Transportation Company received many comments from passengers who worked night shifts: after ten in the evening, drivers of the last bus might fail to notice people waiting at some stops because of poor lighting. Once passengers missed the bus, they had no choice but to spend more money on a taxi home.

The company did not immediately change the rules for every route. Instead, it selected three stops—Airport Road, Central Hospital, and the Industrial Park—for a two-week trial. These places had more passengers at night, including both workers finishing their shifts and travelers carrying luggage, so they made it easier to discover whether the new rule was effective.

Under the trial rule, after ten in the evening, passengers could raise a hand as a signal when they saw a bus approaching. After confirming that there was no danger nearby, the driver was expected to slow down and enter the stop. The company also added lighting beside the stop signs and used onboard announcements to remind passengers that raising a hand only showed a wish to board and that they must not suddenly run into the road to chase a bus.

During the first week, some drivers reported that they had to watch the road, the stop signs, and passengers' movements at the same time, which created more mental pressure than before. One driver even mistook a passenger who was arranging their hair for someone signaling the bus. As a result, the driver made an unscheduled stop, causing a delay of several minutes. The company did not criticize the driver. Instead, it invited drivers and passenger representatives to discuss the matter together, and they decided that the signal should be changed to keeping one hand raised for three seconds.

The observations from the second week showed that fewer people missed the last bus, but new problems also appeared. When it rained, passengers holding umbrellas found it difficult to make a clear gesture. When many people were inside the stop, drivers also had difficulty deciding who wanted to board. The staff therefore installed a button at each of the three stops. After a passenger pressed it, a blue light at the top of the stop sign would turn on.

After the trial ended, the company did not announce that the new rule had been completely successful. Instead, it kept driver records, passenger suggestions, and photographs from the stops as materials for the next round of adjustments. The manager believed that the blue light could both alert drivers and prevent passengers from approaching traffic lanes. The company decided to continue the trial on two more night routes and consider gradually expanding its scope only after the safety issues had been resolved.

articles.title: 深夜预约引发的实验室新规则
articles.summary: 一所大学的材料实验室通过共享仪器时段、公开预约记录和设置紧急名额，解决了设备使用不公平的问题，也促进了研究人员之间的合作。
articles.topic: 深夜预约引发的实验室新规则
paragraphs: 在一份关于实验室管理的教学案例中，南川大学材料实验室有一台精密分析仪。它能帮助研究人员观察材料内部的变化，因此几乎每个项目都需要使用。过去，各研究小组分别管理自己的时间，有人提前几周占满时段，也有人临时取消却不通知别人。仪器虽然每天都很忙，真正被使用的时间却没有想象中那么长。
博士生林晓负责整理预约记录。她发现，一些年轻研究人员为了等到空闲时段，只能半夜来做实验，而熟悉管理员的人往往更容易获得方便的时间。大家对此都有意见，但又担心得罪同事，很少公开讨论。林晓认为，与其继续依靠私人联系安排时间，不如建立一套所有人都能看见的规则。
实验室于是试行共享预约制度。每周一上午，系统同时开放下一周的时段，每个项目最初只能预约两次。如果有人取消，系统会立刻通知正在等待的人。此外，使用者必须在实验结束后填写简短记录，说明仪器是否正常、样品是否造成污染。负责人还保留了两个紧急名额，供即将超过保存期限的样品使用。
新制度实行后的第三周，一名教师因为会议改变了实验计划，却忘记取消预约。林晓按照规定释放了他的时段，并安排给另一组学生。那名教师起初很不满意，认为自己的项目更重要。管理员没有马上批评他，而是请他查看公开记录；记录显示，他已经连续两次没有按时使用仪器。面对清楚的信息，他接受了处理结果。
这次冲突也暴露出规则不够灵活：有些实验受到温度和样品状态影响，无法提前一周确定时间。实验室听取意见后，增加了当天申请区，并规定连续失约者暂时降低预约顺序。为了避免误会，任何调整都由系统留下原因，管理员不能只靠个人判断改变安排。
根据这份教学案例中的阶段观察，夜间实验减少了，临时空出的时段也更快被利用。更重要的是，不同小组开始主动交换操作经验，有人还把容易出现的错误写进共享记录。新规则并没有让仪器变多，却使有限的资源得到更公平的使用。林晓总结说，制度真正有效，不只因为它限制了个人，更因为每个人都能理解并检查它。
pinyin: zài yī fèn guān yú shí yàn shì guǎn lǐ de jiào xué àn lì zhōng ， nán chuān dà xué cái liào shí yàn shì yǒu yī tái jīng mì fēn xī yí 。 tā néng bāng zhù yán jiū rén yuán guān chá cái liào nèi bù de biàn huà ， yīn cǐ jī hū měi gè xiàng mù dōu xū yào shǐ yòng 。 guò qù ， gè yán jiū xiǎo zǔ fèn bié guǎn lǐ zì jǐ de shí jiān ， yǒu rén tí qián jǐ zhōu zhàn mǎn shí duàn ， yě yǒu rén lín shí qǔ xiāo què bù tōng zhī bié rén 。 yí qì suī rán měi tiān dōu hěn máng ， zhēn zhèng bèi shǐ yòng de shí jiān què méi yǒu xiǎng xiàng zhōng nà me zhǎng 。

bó shì shēng lín xiǎo fù zé zhěng lǐ yù yuē jì lù 。 tā fā xiàn ， yī xiē nián qīng yán jiū rén yuán wèi le děng dào kòng xián shí duàn ， zhǐ néng bàn yè lái zuò shí yàn ， ér shú xī guǎn lǐ yuán de rén wǎng wǎng gèng róng yì huò dé fāng biàn de shí jiān 。 dà jiā duì cǐ dōu yǒu yì jiàn ， dàn yòu dān xīn dé zuì tóng shì ， hěn shǎo gōng kāi tǎo lùn 。 lín xiǎo rèn wéi ， yǔ qí jì xù yī kào sī rén lián xì ān pái shí jiān ， bù rú jiàn lì yī tào suǒ yǒu rén dōu néng kàn jiàn de guī zé 。

shí yàn shì yú shì shì xíng gòng xiǎng yù yuē zhì dù 。 měi zhōu yī shàng wǔ ， xì tǒng tóng shí kāi fàng xià yī zhōu de shí duàn ， měi gè xiàng mù zuì chū zhǐ néng yù yuē liǎng cì 。 rú guǒ yǒu rén qǔ xiāo ， xì tǒng huì lì kè tōng zhī zhèng zài děng dài de rén 。 cǐ wài ， shǐ yòng zhě bì xū zài shí yàn jié shù hòu tián xiě jiǎn duǎn jì lù ， shuō míng yí qì shì fǒu zhèng cháng 、 yàng pǐn shì fǒu zào chéng wū rǎn 。 fù zé rén hái bǎo liú le liǎng gè jǐn jí míng é ， gōng jí jiāng chāo guò bǎo cún qī xiàn de yàng pǐn shǐ yòng 。

xīn zhì dù shí xíng hòu de dì sān zhōu ， yī míng jiào shī yīn wèi huì yì gǎi biàn le shí yàn jì huà ， què wàng jì qǔ xiāo yù yuē 。 lín xiǎo àn zhào guī dìng shì fàng le tā de shí duàn ， bìng ān pái gěi lìng yī zǔ xué shēng 。 nà míng jiào shī qǐ chū hěn bù mǎn yì ， rèn wéi zì jǐ de xiàng mù gèng zhòng yào 。 guǎn lǐ yuán méi yǒu mǎ shàng pī píng tā ， ér shì qǐng tā chá kàn gōng kāi jì lù ； jì lù xiǎn shì ， tā yǐ jīng lián xù liǎng cì méi yǒu àn shí shǐ yòng yí qì 。 miàn duì qīng chǔ de xìn xī ， tā jiē shòu le chǔ lǐ jié guǒ 。

zhè cì chōng tū yě bào lù chū guī zé bù gòu líng huó ： yǒu xiē shí yàn shòu dào wēn dù hé yàng pǐn zhuàng tài yǐng xiǎng ， wú fǎ tí qián yī zhōu què dìng shí jiān 。 shí yàn shì tīng qǔ yì jiàn hòu ， zēng jiā liǎo dàng tiān shēn qǐng qū ， bìng guī dìng lián xù shī yuē zhě zàn shí jiàng dī yù yuē shùn xù 。 wèi le bì miǎn wù huì ， rèn hé tiáo zhěng dōu yóu xì tǒng liú xià yuán yīn ， guǎn lǐ yuán bù néng zhǐ kào gè rén pàn duàn gǎi biàn ān pái 。

gēn jù zhè fèn jiào xué àn lì zhōng de jiē duàn guān chá ， yè jiān shí yàn jiǎn shǎo le ， lín shí kōng chū de shí duàn yě gèng kuài bèi lì yòng 。 gèng zhòng yào de shì ， bù tóng xiǎo zǔ kāi shǐ zhǔ dòng jiāo huàn cāo zuò jīng yàn ， yǒu rén hái bǎ róng yì chū xiàn de cuò wù xiě jìn gòng xiǎng jì lù 。 xīn guī zé bìng méi yǒu ràng yí qì biàn duō ， què shǐ yǒu xiàn de zī yuán dé dào gèng gōng píng de shǐ yòng 。 lín xiǎo zǒng jié shuō ， zhì dù zhēn zhèng yǒu xiào ， bù zhǐ yīn wèi tā xiàn zhì le gè rén ， gèng yīn wèi měi gè rén dōu néng lǐ jiě bìng jiǎn chá tā 。
translation: In a teaching case about laboratory management, the materials laboratory at Nanchuan University had a precision analyzer. It could help researchers observe changes inside materials, so nearly every project needed to use it. In the past, each research group managed its own time. Some people occupied all the slots several weeks in advance, while others canceled at the last minute without notifying anyone. Although the instrument appeared busy every day, the amount of time it was actually used was not as long as people imagined.

Doctoral student Lin Xiao was responsible for organizing the reservation records. She found that some junior researchers could obtain an available slot only by coming in late at night to conduct experiments, whereas people familiar with the administrator often obtained more convenient times. Everyone had complaints about this, but few discussed it openly because they were afraid of offending their colleagues. Lin Xiao believed that rather than continuing to arrange time through personal connections, it would be better to establish a set of rules visible to everyone.

The laboratory therefore began testing a shared reservation system. Every Monday morning, the system opened the slots for the following week at the same time, and each project could initially make only two reservations. If someone canceled, the system immediately notified those who were waiting. In addition, users had to complete a brief record after the experiment, explaining whether the instrument was operating normally and whether the sample had caused contamination. The person in charge also kept two emergency slots for samples whose permitted storage period was about to expire.

In the third week after the new system was introduced, a teacher changed his experimental plan because of a meeting but forgot to cancel his reservation. Following the rules, Lin Xiao released his slot and assigned it to another group of students. At first, the teacher was very dissatisfied and believed that his project was more important. The administrator did not criticize him immediately but asked him to check the public records, which showed that he had already failed to use the instrument on time twice in a row. Faced with clear information, he accepted the decision.

This conflict also revealed that the rules were not flexible enough: some experiments were affected by temperature and sample conditions, making it impossible to determine their timing a week in advance. After listening to suggestions, the laboratory added a same-day application section and stipulated that people who repeatedly missed reservations would temporarily receive lower booking priority. To avoid misunderstandings, the system recorded the reason for every adjustment, and administrators could not change arrangements based only on personal judgment.

According to the interim observations in this teaching case, nighttime experiments decreased, and slots that became available at short notice were used more quickly. More importantly, different groups began to exchange operating experience voluntarily, and some people even added common mistakes to the shared records. The new rules did not increase the number of instruments, but they allowed limited resources to be used more fairly. Lin Xiao concluded that the system was truly effective not only because it restricted individuals, but also because everyone could understand and examine it.

articles.title: 截稿时间不变，记者可以自己选班
articles.summary: 一家新闻编辑部试行弹性排班，让记者结合个人习惯和采访需要选择早班或晚班，并通过交接记录和线上会议减少合作问题。这是一则用于语言学习的管理案例。
articles.topic: 截稿时间不变，记者可以自己选班
paragraphs: 在这则教学案例中，一家新闻编辑部遇到了一个难题：有些记者习惯早起，希望上午集中采访；有些记者晚上思路更清楚，却常常因为固定的上班时间感到疲劳。三个月前，主编宣布试行新的排班规则。记者可以选择早班或晚班，每两周还能调整一次，但是每天的新闻截稿时间不变。
新规则刚开始时，不少人表示欢迎。负责城市新闻的林夏选择早班，她早上七点半到办公室，下午四点前结束工作。这样一来，她更容易联系学校、医院等白天办公的单位。负责文化新闻的周明则选择晚班，因为演出和采访大多安排在晚上。过去他看完演出后还得第二天清早写稿，现在可以当天整理笔记，文章的细节也更完整。
不过，一周以后，问题渐渐出现了。早班记者下班时，晚班记者可能才刚到，重要消息有时没有及时交接。一次，林夏采访到一条临时取消活动的消息，却只写在自己的笔记里。周明不知道情况，仍然按照原计划准备报道，浪费了两个小时。主编没有立刻取消新规则，而是请大家讨论怎样改进合作方式。
编辑部最后增加了两个要求：每位记者下班前必须填写一份简短的交接记录；下午四点，全体人员要参加十五分钟的线上会议。会议只讨论当天最需要注意的变化，不能变成长时间的工作汇报。为了避免记者只选择自己喜欢的时间，主编还规定，遇到大型活动时，排班必须服从采访任务。
试行满三个月后，编辑部没有简单地判断新规则成功或失败。内部的阶段观察显示，记者请假的情况减少了，交接错误也在新要求实行后明显下降，但线上会议偶尔仍会超时。主编认为，这项办法之所以能够继续，是因为它既给了个人选择，也保留了共同责任。下一阶段，编辑部将继续记录问题，再决定是否正式采用。
pinyin: zài zhè zé jiào xué àn lì zhōng ， yī jiā xīn wén biān jí bù yù dào le yí gè nán tí ： yǒu xiē jì zhě xí guàn zǎo qǐ ， xī wàng shàng wǔ jí zhōng cǎi fǎng ； yǒu xiē jì zhě wǎn shàng sī lù gèng qīng chǔ ， què cháng cháng yīn wèi gù dìng de shàng bān shí jiān gǎn dào pí láo 。 sān gè yuè qián ， zhǔ biān xuān bù shì xíng xīn de pái bān guī zé 。 jì zhě kě yǐ xuǎn zé zǎo bān huò wǎn bān ， měi liǎng zhōu hái néng tiáo zhěng yī cì ， dàn shì měi tiān de xīn wén jié gǎo shí jiān bù biàn 。

xīn guī zé gāng kāi shǐ shí ， bù shǎo rén biǎo shì huān yíng 。 fù zé chéng shì xīn wén de lín xià xuǎn zé zǎo bān ， tā zǎo shàng qī diǎn bàn dào bàn gōng shì ， xià wǔ sì diǎn qián jié shù gōng zuò 。 zhè yàng yī lái ， tā gèng róng yì lián xì xué xiào 、 yī yuàn děng bái tiān bàn gōng de dān wèi 。 fù zé wén huà xīn wén de zhōu míng zé xuǎn zé wǎn bān ， yīn wèi yǎn chū hé cǎi fǎng dà duō ān pái zài wǎn shàng 。 guò qù tā kàn wán yǎn chū hòu hái dé dì èr tiān qīng zǎo xiě gǎo ， xiàn zài kě yǐ dàng tiān zhěng lǐ bǐ jì ， wén zhāng de xì jié yě gèng wán zhěng 。

bù guò ， yī zhōu yǐ hòu ， wèn tí jiàn jiàn chū xiàn le 。 zǎo bān jì zhě xià bān shí ， wǎn bān jì zhě kě néng cái gāng dào ， zhòng yào xiāo xī yǒu shí méi yǒu jí shí jiāo jiē 。 yī cì ， lín xià cǎi fǎng dào yī tiáo lín shí qǔ xiāo huó dòng de xiāo xī ， què zhǐ xiě zài zì jǐ de bǐ jì lǐ 。 zhōu míng bù zhī dào qíng kuàng ， réng rán àn zhào yuán jì huà zhǔn bèi bào dào ， làng fèi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí 。 zhǔ biān méi yǒu lì kè qǔ xiāo xīn guī zé ， ér shì qǐng dà jiā tǎo lùn zěn yàng gǎi jìn hé zuò fāng shì 。

biān jí bù zuì hòu zēng jiā le liǎng gè yāo qiú ： měi wèi jì zhě xià bān qián bì xū tián xiě yī fèn jiǎn duǎn de jiāo jiē jì lù ； xià wǔ sì diǎn ， quán tǐ rén yuán yào cān jiā shí wǔ fēn zhōng de xiàn shàng huì yì 。 huì yì zhǐ tǎo lùn dàng tiān zuì xū yào zhù yì de biàn huà ， bù néng biàn chéng zhǎng shí jiān de gōng zuò huì bào 。 wèi le bì miǎn jì zhě zhǐ xuǎn zé zì jǐ xǐ huān de shí jiān ， zhǔ biān hái guī dìng ， yù dào dà xíng huó dòng shí ， pái bān bì xū fú cóng cǎi fǎng rèn wù 。

shì xíng mǎn sān gè yuè hòu ， biān jí bù méi yǒu jiǎn dān dì pàn duàn xīn guī zé chéng gōng huò shī bài 。 nèi bù de jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， jì zhě qǐng jià de qíng kuàng jiǎn shǎo le ， jiāo jiē cuò wù yě zài xīn yāo qiú shí xíng hòu míng xiǎn xià jiàng ， dàn xiàn shàng huì yì ǒu ěr réng huì chāo shí 。 zhǔ biān rèn wéi ， zhè xiàng bàn fǎ zhī suǒ yǐ néng gòu jì xù ， shì yīn wèi tā jì gěi le gè rén xuǎn zé ， yě bǎo liú le gòng tóng zé rèn 。 xià yī jiē duàn ， biān jí bù jiàng jì xù jì lù wèn tí ， zài jué dìng shì fǒu zhèng shì cǎi yòng 。
translation: In this learning case, a newsroom faced a difficult problem: some reporters were used to getting up early and wanted to focus on interviews in the morning, while others thought more clearly at night but often felt tired because of fixed working hours. Three months earlier, the editor-in-chief announced a trial of a new scheduling rule. Reporters could choose an early or late shift and could change their choice every two weeks, but the daily news deadline would remain unchanged.

When the new rule first began, many people welcomed it. Lin Xia, who was responsible for city news, chose the early shift. She arrived at the office at 7:30 a.m. and finished work before 4 p.m. This made it easier for her to contact schools, hospitals, and other organizations that operated during the day. Zhou Ming, who covered cultural news, chose the late shift because performances and interviews were mostly scheduled in the evening. In the past, he had to write early the next morning after seeing a performance; now he could organize his notes that same day, and the details in his articles were more complete.

However, after one week, problems gradually appeared. When early-shift reporters left work, late-shift reporters might have only just arrived, so important information was sometimes not handed over promptly. On one occasion, Lin Xia learned that an event had been canceled at short notice, but she recorded it only in her own notes. Zhou Ming did not know about the change and continued preparing the report according to the original plan, wasting two hours. The editor-in-chief did not immediately cancel the new rule, but instead asked everyone to discuss how to improve cooperation.

The newsroom eventually added two requirements: every reporter had to complete a brief handover note before leaving work, and at 4 p.m. all staff had to attend a fifteen-minute online meeting. The meeting would discuss only the changes requiring the most attention that day and could not turn into a lengthy work report. To prevent reporters from choosing only the hours they preferred, the editor-in-chief also ruled that schedules had to follow reporting needs during major events.

After the three-month trial, the newsroom did not simply declare the new rule a success or a failure. Internal observations at this stage showed that reporters took less leave and that handover errors decreased significantly after the new requirements were introduced, although the online meetings still occasionally ran overtime. The editor-in-chief believed that the approach could continue because it provided individual choice while preserving shared responsibility. In the next stage, the newsroom would continue recording problems before deciding whether to adopt it officially.

articles.title: 退回书稿之前，先给作者一封说明信
articles.summary: 一家出版社在教学案例中试行新的退稿规则，通过清楚说明理由、提供修改机会，改善了编辑与作者之间的沟通。
articles.topic: 退回书稿之前，先给作者一封说明信
paragraphs: 以下是一则用于课堂讨论的教学案例。春风出版社位于江州市，每年都会收到大量文学书稿。过去，编辑认为不合适的作品通常只会收到一封简短的退稿邮件，上面写着“未达到出版要求”。不少作者因此感到困惑，不知道问题出在哪里，也有人多次修改后仍然寄来内容相似的稿件。
新任编辑部主任林雪发现，这种做法虽然节省时间，却没有真正减少编辑的工作。她提出试行一项新规则：编辑在退回书稿之前，要选择两个最主要的问题，并用具体例子向作者解释。此外，如果作品有一定价值，编辑还可以邀请作者在一个月内修改一次，但不能保证修改后一定出版。
规则试行后，编辑周明负责处理一部描写海边生活的小说。他认为小说中的人物很有特点，可是故事顺序比较乱，开头还出现了太多与主要事件无关的回忆。与其只告诉作者“结构需要调整”，不如指出哪些章节影响了阅读。于是，他在说明信中列出三处内容，并建议作者把一次关键争吵提前。
作者收到信后没有马上修改，而是先打电话询问提前争吵场面的理由。周明解释说，这个场面能让读者更早理解两位主人公为什么互相怀疑。作者接受了建议，同时保留了自己最喜欢的一段回忆。第二次书稿交来时，故事关系清楚了许多，编辑部最终决定继续讨论出版计划。
试行结束时，林雪没有简单地宣布新规则成功。她请编辑记录花费的时间、作者是否愿意修改以及沟通中出现的误解。阶段观察显示，说明信增加了第一次审稿的工作量，却减少了部分重复投稿。出版社因此保留这项规则，但允许编辑根据书稿质量决定说明的详细程度。对林雪来说，规则的意义不是让每位作者满意，而是让拒绝也能提供有用的信息。
pinyin: yǐ xià shì yī zé yòng yú kè táng tǎo lùn de jiào xué àn lì 。 chūn fēng chū bǎn shè wèi yú jiāng zhōu shì ， měi nián dū huì shōu dào dà liàng wén xué shū gǎo 。 guò qù ， biān jí rèn wéi bù hé shì de zuò pǐn tōng cháng zhǐ huì shōu dào yī fēng jiǎn duǎn de tuì gǎo yóu jiàn ， shàng miàn xiě zhe “ wèi dá dào chū bǎn yāo qiú ”。 bù shǎo zuò zhě yīn cǐ gǎn dào kùn huò ， bù zhī dào wèn tí chū zài nǎ lǐ ， yě yǒu rén duō cì xiū gǎi hòu réng rán jì lái nèi róng xiāng sì de gǎo jiàn 。

xīn rèn biān jí bù zhǔ rèn lín xuě fā xiàn ， zhè zhǒng zuò fǎ suī rán jié shěng shí jiān ， què méi yǒu zhēn zhèng jiǎn shǎo biān jí de gōng zuò 。 tā tí chū shì xíng yī xiàng xīn guī zé ： biān jí zài tuì huí shū gǎo zhī qián ， yào xuǎn zé liǎng gè zuì zhǔ yào de wèn tí ， bìng yòng jù tǐ lì zi xiàng zuò zhě jiě shì 。 cǐ wài ， rú guǒ zuò pǐn yǒu yí dìng jià zhí ， biān jí hái kě yǐ yāo qǐng zuò zhě zài yí gè yuè nèi xiū gǎi yī cì ， dàn bù néng bǎo zhèng xiū gǎi hòu yí dìng chū bǎn 。

guī zé shì xíng hòu ， biān jí zhōu míng fù zé chǔ lǐ yī bù miáo xiě hǎi biān shēng huó de xiǎo shuō 。 tā rèn wéi xiǎo shuō zhōng de rén wù hěn yǒu tè diǎn ， kě shì gù shì shùn xù bǐ jiào luàn ， kāi tóu hái chū xiàn le tài duō yǔ zhǔ yào shì jiàn wú guān de huí yì 。 yǔ qí zhǐ gào sù zuò zhě “ jié gòu xū yào tiáo zhěng ”， bù rú zhǐ chū nǎ xiē zhāng jié yǐng xiǎng le yuè dú 。 yú shì ， tā zài shuō míng xìn zhōng liè chū sān chù nèi róng ， bìng jiàn yì zuò zhě bǎ yī cì guān jiàn zhēng chǎo tí qián 。

zuò zhě shōu dào xìn hòu méi yǒu mǎ shàng xiū gǎi ， ér shì xiān dǎ diàn huà xún wèn tí qián zhēng chǎo chǎng miàn de lǐ yóu 。 zhōu míng jiě shì shuō ， zhè ge chǎng miàn néng ràng dú zhě gèng zǎo lǐ jiě liǎng wèi zhǔ rén gōng wèi shén me hù xiāng huái yí 。 zuò zhě jiē shòu le jiàn yì ， tóng shí bǎo liú le zì jǐ zuì xǐ huān de yī duàn huí yì 。 dì èr cì shū gǎo jiāo lái shí ， gù shì guān xì qīng chǔ le xǔ duō ， biān jí bù zuì zhōng jué dìng jì xù tǎo lùn chū bǎn jì huà 。

shì xíng jié shù shí ， lín xuě méi yǒu jiǎn dān dì xuān bù xīn guī zé chéng gōng 。 tā qǐng biān jí jì lù huā fèi de shí jiān 、 zuò zhě shì fǒu yuàn yì xiū gǎi yǐ jí gōu tōng zhōng chū xiàn de wù jiě 。 jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， shuō míng xìn zēng jiā le dì yī cì shěn gǎo de gōng zuò liàng ， què jiǎn shǎo le bù fèn chóng fù tóu gǎo 。 chū bǎn shè yīn cǐ bǎo liú zhè xiàng guī zé ， dàn yǔn xǔ biān jí gēn jù shū gǎo zhì liàng jué dìng shuō míng de xiáng xì chéng dù 。 duì lín xuě lái shuō ， guī zé de yì yì bú shì ràng měi wèi zuò zhě mǎn yì ， ér shì ràng jù jué yě néng tí gōng yǒu yòng de xìn xī 。
translation: The following is a teaching case for classroom discussion. Spring Breeze Publishing House is located in Jiangzhou and receives a large number of literary manuscripts every year. In the past, works considered unsuitable by editors usually received only a brief rejection email stating, “The work does not meet publishing requirements.” Many authors were therefore confused and did not know what the problems were. Some repeatedly revised their work but still submitted manuscripts with similar content.

Lin Xue, the new director of the editorial department, discovered that although this approach saved time, it did not actually reduce the editors’ workload. She proposed testing a new rule: before returning a manuscript, an editor had to select the two main problems and explain them to the author with specific examples. In addition, if a work had some value, the editor could invite the author to revise it once within a month, but could not guarantee publication after the revision.

After the rule was introduced on a trial basis, editor Zhou Ming was assigned a novel about life by the sea. He thought its characters were distinctive, but the sequence of events was rather confusing, and the opening contained too many memories unrelated to the main event. Rather than merely telling the author that the structure needed adjustment, it would be better to identify which chapters interfered with the reading experience. He therefore listed three passages in the explanatory letter and suggested moving a key argument to an earlier point.

After receiving the letter, the author did not revise the manuscript immediately, but first called to ask why the argument scene should be moved forward. Zhou Ming explained that the scene would allow readers to understand earlier why the two main characters distrusted each other. The author accepted the suggestion while keeping a favorite passage of recollection. When the second version was submitted, the relationships in the story were much clearer, and the editorial department ultimately decided to continue discussing publication plans.

At the end of the trial, Lin Xue did not simply declare the new rule a success. She asked the editors to record how much time they spent, whether authors were willing to revise, and what misunderstandings occurred during communication. The observations at that stage showed that explanatory letters increased the workload of the first review but reduced some repeated submissions. The publishing house therefore kept the rule while allowing editors to decide how detailed the explanation should be according to manuscript quality. For Lin Xue, the point of the rule was not to satisfy every author, but to ensure that even a rejection could provide useful information.

articles.title: 三家门店的“小份确认”试行
articles.summary: 一家连锁餐厅先在三家门店试行新的点餐规则，根据顾客和员工的反馈不断调整，最后决定扩大试行范围，而不是立刻长期采用。
articles.topic: 三家门店的“小份确认”试行
paragraphs: 午餐高峰结束后，连锁餐厅“好味家”的几家门店常常剩下不少米饭。有人建议直接减少每份米饭的重量，但总部担心这样会影响顾客体验。负责门店管理的周宁提出另一种办法：点餐时由员工主动询问顾客需要标准份还是小份，小份不够可以免费添加。为了判断这个办法是否合适，公司决定先在三家情况不同的门店试行两周。
试行前，周宁没有只向店长说明规则，而是邀请收银员、厨师和服务员一起讨论。收银员担心多问一句会让队伍变长，厨师则需要提前知道两种分量的标准。大家最后制作了简单的提示牌，并把确认过程缩短为一句话。公司还规定，员工不能劝顾客选择小份，以免节约食物变成给顾客压力。
第一周出现了意外情况。有些顾客听到“小份”时，以为价格也会降低，发现价格不变后感到不理解；还有顾客担心免费添加很麻烦，仍然选择标准份。门店于是修改提示牌，明确说明两种分量价格相同，小份适合食量较小的人，而且添加米饭不需要重新排队。员工也开始根据老人、儿童等不同顾客的反应，用更自然的方式解释规则。
按照这份教学案例中的阶段观察，试行初期的平均点餐时间有所增加，但几天后，员工熟悉流程，速度逐渐恢复。三家门店的剩饭都减少了，不过程度并不相同。办公区门店的变化最明显，车站附近的门店却比较有限，因为赶时间的顾客很少听完整说明。周宁因此认为，不能只看一个结果，还要考虑地点、客流和员工是否容易执行。
两周后，总部没有马上把新规则推广到所有门店，也没有因为问题而完全放弃。与其急着宣布成功，不如先把容易引起误会的内容说清楚。公司决定保留免费添加的安排，重新设计菜单说明，并在另外五家门店继续试行。周宁在总结中写道，试行的价值不只是证明一个想法有效，更重要的是及时发现它在真实服务过程中会遇到什么困难。
pinyin: wǔ cān gāo fēng jié shù hòu ， lián suǒ cān tīng “ hǎo wèi jiā ” de jǐ jiā mén diàn cháng cháng shèng xià bù shǎo mǐ fàn 。 yǒu rén jiàn yì zhí jiē jiǎn shǎo měi fèn mǐ fàn de zhòng liàng ， dàn zǒng bù dān xīn zhè yàng huì yǐng xiǎng gù kè tǐ yàn 。 fù zé mén diàn guǎn lǐ de zhōu níng tí chū lìng yī zhǒng bàn fǎ ： diǎn cān shí yóu yuán gōng zhǔ dòng xún wèn gù kè xū yào biāo zhǔn fèn hái shì xiǎo fèn ， xiǎo fèn bù gòu kě yǐ miǎn fèi tiān jiā 。 wèi le pàn duàn zhè ge bàn fǎ shì fǒu hé shì ， gōng sī jué dìng xiān zài sān jiā qíng kuàng bù tóng de mén diàn shì xíng liǎng zhōu 。

shì xíng qián ， zhōu níng méi yǒu zhǐ xiàng diàn zhǎng shuō míng guī zé ， ér shì yāo qǐng shōu yín yuán 、 chú shī hé fú wù yuán yì qǐ tǎo lùn 。 shōu yín yuán dān xīn duō wèn yī jù huì ràng duì wǔ biàn zhǎng ， chú shī zé xū yào tí qián zhī dào liǎng zhǒng fèn liàng de biāo zhǔn 。 dà jiā zuì hòu zhì zuò le jiǎn dān de tí shì pái ， bìng bǎ què rèn guò chéng suō duǎn wèi yī jù huà 。 gōng sī hái guī dìng ， yuán gōng bù néng quàn gù kè xuǎn zé xiǎo fèn ， yǐ miǎn jié yuē shí wù biàn chéng gěi gù kè yā lì 。

dì yī zhōu chū xiàn le yì wài qíng kuàng 。 yǒu xiē gù kè tīng dào “ xiǎo fèn ” shí ， yǐ wéi jià gé yě huì jiàng dī ， fā xiàn jià gé bù biàn hòu gǎn dào bù lǐ jiě ； hái yǒu gù kè dān xīn miǎn fèi tiān jiā hěn má fán ， réng rán xuǎn zé biāo zhǔn fèn 。 mén diàn yú shì xiū gǎi tí shì pái ， míng què shuō míng liǎng zhǒng fèn liàng jià gé xiāng tóng ， xiǎo fèn shì hé shí liàng jiào xiǎo de rén ， ér qiě tiān jiā mǐ fàn bù xū yào chóng xīn pái duì 。 yuán gōng yě kāi shǐ gēn jù lǎo rén 、 ér tóng děng bù tóng gù kè de fǎn yìng ， yòng gèng zì rán de fāng shì jiě shì guī zé 。

àn zhào zhè fèn jiào xué àn lì zhōng de jiē duàn guān chá ， shì xíng chū qī de píng jūn diǎn cān shí jiān yǒu suǒ zēng jiā ， dàn jǐ tiān hòu ， yuán gōng shú xī liú chéng ， sù dù zhú jiàn huī fù 。 sān jiā mén diàn de shèng fàn dōu jiǎn shǎo le ， bù guò chéng dù bìng bù xiāng tóng 。 bàn gōng qū mén diàn de biàn huà zuì míng xiǎn ， chē zhàn fù jìn de mén diàn què bǐ jiào yǒu xiàn ， yīn wèi gǎn shí jiān de gù kè hěn shǎo tīng wán zhěng shuō míng 。 zhōu níng yīn cǐ rèn wéi ， bù néng zhǐ kàn yí gè jié guǒ ， hái yào kǎo lǜ dì diǎn 、 kè liú hé yuán gōng shì fǒu róng yì zhí xíng 。

liǎng zhōu hòu ， zǒng bù méi yǒu mǎ shàng bǎ xīn guī zé tuī guǎng dào suǒ yǒu mén diàn ， yě méi yǒu yīn wèi wèn tí ér wán quán fàng qì 。 yǔ qí jí zhe xuān bù chéng gōng ， bù rú xiān bǎ róng yì yǐn qǐ wù huì de nèi róng shuō qīng chǔ 。 gōng sī jué dìng bǎo liú miǎn fèi tiān jiā de ān pái ， chóng xīn shè jì cài dān shuō míng ， bìng zài lìng wài wǔ jiā mén diàn jì xù shì xíng 。 zhōu níng zài zǒng jié zhōng xiě dào ， shì xíng de jià zhí bù zhǐ shì zhèng míng yí gè xiǎng fǎ yǒu xiào ， gèng zhòng yào de shì jí shí fā xiàn tā zài zhēn shí fú wù guò chéng zhōng huì yù dào shén me kùn nán 。
translation: After the lunch rush, several branches of the Good Taste Home restaurant chain often had a considerable amount of rice left over. Some people suggested directly reducing the amount of rice in each serving, but headquarters worried that this would affect the customer experience. Zhou Ning, who was responsible for branch management, proposed another approach: when customers ordered, employees would ask whether they wanted a standard or small serving, and customers could receive more rice for free if the small serving was not enough. To determine whether this approach was suitable, the company decided to test it for two weeks at three branches with different conditions.

Before the trial, Zhou Ning did not explain the rule only to the branch managers. Instead, she invited cashiers, cooks, and servers to discuss it together. The cashiers worried that asking an extra question would make the line longer, while the cooks needed clear standards for the two serving sizes in advance. In the end, the team made simple signs and shortened the confirmation process to a single sentence. The company also required employees not to persuade customers to choose a small serving, so that saving food would not become a source of pressure on customers.

Unexpected situations arose during the first week. When some customers heard the words “small serving,” they assumed the price would also be lower and were confused when they found that it remained the same. Others worried that requesting free refills would be troublesome, so they still chose the standard serving. The branches then revised the signs to make clear that both serving sizes had the same price, that the small serving suited people with smaller appetites, and that customers did not need to line up again for more rice. Employees also began explaining the rule more naturally according to the reactions of different customers, such as older adults and children.

According to the stage observations in this teaching case, the average ordering time increased at the beginning of the trial, but after a few days, employees became familiar with the process and the speed gradually returned to normal. Leftover rice decreased at all three branches, although not to the same degree. The change was most noticeable at the branch in the office district, while it was relatively limited at the branch near the station because customers in a hurry rarely listened to the full explanation. Zhou Ning therefore believed that the company should not examine only one result; it also needed to consider location, customer flow, and whether the rule was easy for employees to carry out.

After two weeks, headquarters neither introduced the new rule immediately at every branch nor abandoned it completely because of the problems. Rather than rushing to declare success, it was better to clarify the details that could easily cause misunderstandings. The company decided to keep the free-refill arrangement, redesign the menu explanation, and continue the trial at five additional branches. In her summary, Zhou Ning wrote that the value of a trial was not merely to prove that an idea worked, but, more importantly, to discover in time what difficulties it might encounter during actual service.

articles.title: 把草坪的时间交给一张预约表
articles.summary: 一座城市公园通过线上预约、现场引导和弹性调整，改善团体活动与普通游客之间的场地冲突。
articles.topic: 把草坪的时间交给一张预约表
paragraphs: 以下是一则用于阅读教学的案例。青河市中心有一座湖畔公园，附近居民常来散步、跑步或晒太阳。每到周末，也有不少家庭、学校和兴趣小组在草坪上组织活动。由于团体活动需要较大空间，普通游客有时刚坐下，就被告知附近将举行比赛或表演，双方因此发生争论。
公园管理处没有直接禁止团体活动，而是选择在东侧草坪试行线上预约制度。十人以上的团队可以提前七天申请活动时段，并说明人数、活动内容以及是否使用音响。预约成功后，团队会收到一个号码，到达公园时只需向工作人员出示。个人游客不必预约，仍可自由进入其他草坪。
为了避免预约者占用场地过久，每个团队一次最多使用两个小时。若迟到超过半小时，场地会重新开放。管理处还在入口设置了电子屏，及时显示哪些区域正在使用、哪些区域即将空出。尽管新制度增加了工作人员的任务，他们仍然认为，提前说明规则比现场处理冲突更有效。
试行第二周，一支舞蹈队预约了周六上午的场地，可当天突然下起大雨。队长以为预约能够自动延长到下午，便要求工作人员保留草坪。然而，下午已有亲子游戏小组预约。工作人员没有简单拒绝，而是帮助舞蹈队改到有屋顶的广场，并提醒他们下次可以在系统里选择雨天备用地点。
根据这份教学材料中的阶段观察，预约区的争论有所减少，但新的问题也出现了。有些老年游客不熟悉手机操作，还有团队预约后临时不来，造成场地空着却无人使用。管理处于是保留了服务台，并规定团队若不能参加，应尽早取消；连续两次没有到场，其账号会暂时失去预约资格。
一个月后，管理处没有急着把制度扩大到整个公园，而是邀请游客参加讨论。普通游客希望保留无需预约的安静区域，团体负责人则建议增加傍晚时段。最终，公园决定继续试行，只调整开放时间和取消规则。这个结果说明，新规则是否方便，不能只看技术设计，还要看不同使用者能否表达需要，以及管理者是否愿意根据实际情况作出改变。
pinyin: yǐ xià shì yī zé yòng yú yuè dú jiào xué de àn lì 。 qīng hé shì zhōng xīn yǒu yī zuò hú pàn gōng yuán ， fù jìn jū mín cháng lái sàn bù 、 pǎo bù huò shài tài yáng 。 měi dào zhōu mò ， yě yǒu bù shǎo jiā tíng 、 xué xiào hé xìng qù xiǎo zǔ zài cǎo píng shàng zǔ zhī huó dòng 。 yóu yú tuán tǐ huó dòng xū yào jiào dà kōng jiān ， pǔ tōng yóu kè yǒu shí gāng zuò xià ， jiù bèi gào zhī fù jìn jiāng jǔ xíng bǐ sài huò biǎo yǎn ， shuāng fāng yīn cǐ fā shēng zhēng lùn 。

gōng yuán guǎn lǐ chù méi yǒu zhí jiē jìn zhǐ tuán tǐ huó dòng ， ér shì xuǎn zé zài dōng cè cǎo píng shì xíng xiàn shàng yù yuē zhì dù 。 shí rén yǐ shàng de tuán duì kě yǐ tí qián qī tiān shēn qǐng huó dòng shí duàn ， bìng shuō míng rén shù 、 huó dòng nèi róng yǐ jí shì fǒu shǐ yòng yīn xiǎng 。 yù yuē chéng gōng hòu ， tuán duì huì shōu dào yí gè hào mǎ ， dào dá gōng yuán shí zhǐ xū xiàng gōng zuò rén yuán chū shì 。 gè rén yóu kè bù bì yù yuē ， réng kě zì yóu jìn rù qí tā cǎo píng 。

wèi le bì miǎn yù yuē zhě zhàn yòng chǎng dì guò jiǔ ， měi gè tuán duì yī cì zuì duō shǐ yòng liǎng gè xiǎo shí 。 ruò chí dào chāo guò bàn xiǎo shí ， chǎng dì huì chóng xīn kāi fàng 。 guǎn lǐ chù hái zài rù kǒu shè zhì le diàn zi píng ， jí shí xiǎn shì nǎ xiē qū yù zhèng zài shǐ yòng 、 nǎ xiē qū yù jí jiāng kòng chū 。 jǐn guǎn xīn zhì dù zēng jiā le gōng zuò rén yuán de rèn wù ， tā men réng rán rèn wéi ， tí qián shuō míng guī zé bǐ xiàn chǎng chǔ lǐ chōng tū gèng yǒu xiào 。

shì xíng dì èr zhōu ， yī zhī wǔ dǎo duì yù yuē le zhōu liù shàng wǔ de chǎng dì ， kě dàng tiān tū rán xià qǐ dà yǔ 。 duì zhǎng yǐ wéi yù yuē néng gòu zì dòng yán cháng dào xià wǔ ， biàn yāo qiú gōng zuò rén yuán bǎo liú cǎo píng 。 rán ér ， xià wǔ yǐ yǒu qīn zǐ yóu xì xiǎo zǔ yù yuē 。 gōng zuò rén yuán méi yǒu jiǎn dān jù jué ， ér shì bāng zhù wǔ dǎo duì gǎi dào yǒu wū dǐng de guǎng chǎng ， bìng tí xǐng tā men xià cì kě yǐ zài xì tǒng lǐ xuǎn zé yǔ tiān bèi yòng dì diǎn 。

gēn jù zhè fèn jiào xué cái liào zhōng de jiē duàn guān chá ， yù yuē qū de zhēng lùn yǒu suǒ jiǎn shǎo ， dàn xīn de wèn tí yě chū xiàn le 。 yǒu xiē lǎo nián yóu kè bù shú xī shǒu jī cāo zuò ， hái yǒu tuán duì yù yuē hòu lín shí bù lái ， zào chéng chǎng dì kōng zhe què wú rén shǐ yòng 。 guǎn lǐ chǔ yú shì bǎo liú le fú wù tái ， bìng guī dìng tuán duì ruò bù néng cān jiā ， yīng jǐn zǎo qǔ xiāo ； lián xù liǎng cì méi yǒu dào chǎng ， qí zhàng hào huì zàn shí shī qù yù yuē zī gé 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， guǎn lǐ chù méi yǒu jí zhe bǎ zhì dù kuò dà dào zhěng gè gōng yuán ， ér shì yāo qǐng yóu kè cān jiā tǎo lùn 。 pǔ tōng yóu kè xī wàng bǎo liú wú xū yù yuē de ān jìng qū yù ， tuán tǐ fù zé rén zé jiàn yì zēng jiā bàng wǎn shí duàn 。 zuì zhōng ， gōng yuán jué dìng jì xù shì xíng ， zhǐ tiáo zhěng kāi fàng shí jiān hé qǔ xiāo guī zé 。 zhè ge jié guǒ shuō míng ， xīn guī zé shì fǒu fāng biàn ， bù néng zhǐ kàn jì shù shè jì ， hái yào kàn bù tóng shǐ yòng zhě néng fǒu biǎo dá xū yào ， yǐ jí guǎn lǐ zhě shì fǒu yuàn yì gēn jù shí jì qíng kuàng zuò chū gǎi biàn 。
translation: The following is a case for use in reading instruction. There is a lakeside park in the center of Qinghe City, where nearby residents often walk, run, or enjoy the sunshine. On weekends, many families, schools, and hobby groups also organize activities on the lawns. Because group events require a large area, individual visitors were sometimes told just after sitting down that a competition or performance would soon take place nearby. This led to arguments between the two sides.

Instead of banning group activities outright, the park administration chose to pilot an online reservation system for the eastern lawn. Groups of ten or more people could apply for a time slot seven days in advance and state the number of participants, the type of activity, and whether sound equipment would be used. After a reservation was approved, the group received a number to show to staff upon arrival. Individual visitors did not need reservations and could still enter the other lawns freely.

To prevent reservation holders from occupying a space for too long, each group could use it for no more than two hours at a time. If a group arrived more than half an hour late, the space would be reopened. The administration also installed an electronic screen at the entrance showing which areas were in use and which would soon become available. Although the new system increased the staff's workload, they still believed that explaining the rules in advance was more effective than handling conflicts on the spot.

During the second week of the pilot, a dance group reserved a space for Saturday morning, but heavy rain suddenly began that day. The leader assumed that the reservation would automatically be extended to the afternoon and asked the staff to keep the lawn for the group. However, a parent-child game group had already booked it for the afternoon. Rather than simply refusing, the staff helped the dance group move to a covered plaza and reminded its members that they could choose a backup location for rainy days in the system next time.

According to the interim observations in this teaching material, arguments in the reservation area decreased, but new problems also emerged. Some elderly visitors were unfamiliar with operating smartphones, while some groups made reservations but did not show up, leaving the reserved spaces empty and unused. The administration therefore kept the service desk and required groups to cancel as early as possible if they could not attend. An account would temporarily lose its reservation privileges after two consecutive absences.

One month later, the administration did not rush to expand the system to the entire park. Instead, it invited visitors to take part in a discussion. Individual visitors hoped to preserve quiet areas that required no reservations, while group leaders suggested adding evening time slots. In the end, the park decided to continue the pilot and adjust only the opening hours and cancellation rules. This outcome shows that whether a new rule is convenient depends not only on its technical design, but also on whether different users can express their needs and whether administrators are willing to make changes according to actual conditions.

articles.title: 两批实训课能解决什么问题
articles.summary: 一所职业学校试行早晚两个实训批次，并在发现评分、交通和排课问题后逐步完善规则。
articles.topic: 两批实训课能解决什么问题
paragraphs: 下面是一个教学案例。海州市明远职业学校的汽车维修专业过去把实训课统一安排在下午。由于设备数量有限，二十多名学生常常同时等着使用检测仪，有人直到下课也没完成操作。三个月前，学校开始试行新规则：同一节实训课分成早、晚两个批次，学生可以根据交通、兼职和家庭情况提出申请。
规则公布后，教务处没有马上替每个人决定时间，而是让学生填写选择表，并说明不能只考虑个人方便。如果某一批申请太多，班主任会先和学生商量，再参考上学距离、照顾家人的需要以及前一个月的出勤情况调整。为了避免误会，调整理由必须当面说明，最终名单也可以在两天内申请复查。
最初，不少老师担心晚批学生容易迟到，早批学生则可能因为起得太早而没有精神。实训教师周海却发现，人数减少以后，他能看清每个人的操作过程，也有时间及时指出错误。一名原来很少提问的学生说，以前机器旁边总围着同学，他怕耽误大家，现在终于敢把不懂的步骤问清楚。
新安排也带来了意外问题。两个批次由不同教师记录成绩，同一种操作有时会得到不同评价；晚批结束较迟，住得远的学生还担心错过末班车。与其因为这些问题取消试行，不如把评分标准和离校时间改得更清楚。学校因此统一了操作表，并把晚批提前二十分钟结束，同时保留换批机会。
试行满三个月后，教务处组织了一次讨论会。材料中的阶段观察显示，排队现象明显减少，多数学生认为练习机会增加了，但也有人觉得每周变化的批次不容易记。学校没有把“多数满意”当成成功的唯一证明，而是决定下学期固定个人批次，只在有实际困难时允许临时调整。教师还要比较两批作业，检查评分是否一致。
这项规则并不是简单地把一群人分成两组，它要求学校同时处理公平、效率和安全。对职业学校来说，实训安排能否长期实行，不能只看教室里是否安静，还要看学生是否真正获得练习、教师是否采用相同标准，以及晚回家的学生有没有合适的交通。只有不断听取意见并修正规则，试行才可能成为稳定的制度。
pinyin: xià miàn shì yí gè jiào xué àn lì 。 hǎi zhōu shì míng yuǎn zhí yè xué xiào de qì chē wéi xiū zhuān yè guò qù bǎ shí xùn kè tǒng yī ān pái zài xià wǔ 。 yóu yú shè bèi shù liàng yǒu xiàn ， èr shí duō míng xué shēng cháng cháng tóng shí děng zhe shǐ yòng jiǎn cè yí ， yǒu rén zhí dào xià kè yě méi wán chéng cāo zuò 。 sān gè yuè qián ， xué xiào kāi shǐ shì xíng xīn guī zé ： tóng yī jié shí xùn kè fēn chéng zǎo 、 wǎn liǎng gè pī cì ， xué shēng kě yǐ gēn jù jiāo tōng 、 jiān zhí hé jiā tíng qíng kuàng tí chū shēn qǐng 。

guī zé gōng bù hòu ， jiào wù chù méi yǒu mǎ shàng tì měi gè rén jué dìng shí jiān ， ér shì ràng xué shēng tián xiě xuǎn zé biǎo ， bìng shuō míng bù néng zhǐ kǎo lǜ gè rén fāng biàn 。 rú guǒ mǒu yī pī shēn qǐng tài duō ， bān zhǔ rèn huì xiān hé xué shēng shāng liáng ， zài cān kǎo shàng xué jù lí 、 zhào gù jiā rén de xū yào yǐ jí qián yí gè yuè de chū qín qíng kuàng tiáo zhěng 。 wèi le bì miǎn wù huì ， tiáo zhěng lǐ yóu bì xū dāng miàn shuō míng ， zuì zhōng míng dān yě kě yǐ zài liǎng tiān nèi shēn qǐng fù chá 。

zuì chū ， bù shǎo lǎo shī dān xīn wǎn pī xué shēng róng yì chí dào ， zǎo pī xué shēng zé kě néng yīn wèi qǐ dé tài zǎo ér méi yǒu jīng shén 。 shí xùn jiào shī zhōu hǎi què fā xiàn ， rén shù jiǎn shǎo yǐ hòu ， tā néng kàn qīng měi gè rén de cāo zuò guò chéng ， yě yǒu shí jiān jí shí zhǐ chū cuò wù 。 yī míng yuán lái hěn shǎo tí wèn de xué shēng shuō ， yǐ qián jī qì páng biān zǒng wéi zhe tóng xué ， tā pà dān wù dà jiā ， xiàn zài zhōng yú gǎn bǎ bù dǒng de bù zhòu wèn qīng chǔ 。

xīn ān pái yě dài lái le yì wài wèn tí 。 liǎng gè pī cì yóu bù tóng jiào shī jì lù chéng jì ， tóng yī zhǒng cāo zuò yǒu shí huì dé dào bù tóng píng jià ； wǎn pī jié shù jiào chí ， zhù dé yuǎn de xué shēng huán dān xīn cuò guò mò bān chē 。 yǔ qí yīn wèi zhè xiē wèn tí qǔ xiāo shì xíng ， bù rú bǎ píng fēn biāo zhǔn hé lí xiào shí jiān gǎi dé gèng qīng chǔ 。 xué xiào yīn cǐ tǒng yī liǎo cāo zuò biǎo ， bìng bǎ wǎn pī tí qián èr shí fēn zhōng jié shù ， tóng shí bǎo liú huàn pī jī huì 。

shì xíng mǎn sān gè yuè hòu ， jiào wù chù zǔ zhī le yī cì tǎo lùn huì 。 cái liào zhōng de jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， pái duì xiàn xiàng míng xiǎn jiǎn shǎo ， duō shù xué shēng rèn wéi liàn xí jī huì zēng jiā le ， dàn yě yǒu rén jué de měi zhōu biàn huà de pī cì bù róng yì jì 。 xué xiào méi yǒu bǎ “ duō shù mǎn yì ” dàng chéng chéng gōng de wéi yī zhèng míng ， ér shì jué dìng xià xué qī gù dìng gè rén pī cì ， zhǐ zài yǒu shí jì kùn nán shí yǔn xǔ lín shí diào zhěng 。 jiào shī hái yào bǐ jiào liǎng pī zuò yè ， jiǎn chá píng fēn shì fǒu yí zhì 。

zhè xiàng guī zé bìng bú shì jiǎn dān dì bǎ yī qún rén fēn chéng liǎng zǔ ， tā yāo qiú xué xiào tóng shí chǔ lǐ gōng píng 、 xiào lǜ hé ān quán 。 duì zhí yè xué xiào lái shuō ， shí xùn ān pái néng fǒu cháng qī shí xíng ， bù néng zhǐ kàn jiào shì lǐ shì fǒu ān jìng ， hái yào kàn xué shēng shì fǒu zhēn zhèng huò dé liàn xí 、 jiào shī shì fǒu cǎi yòng xiāng tóng biāo zhǔn ， yǐ jí wǎn huí jiā de xué shēng yǒu méi yǒu hé shì de jiāo tōng 。 zhǐ yǒu bù duàn tīng qǔ yì jiàn bìng xiū zhèng guī zé ， shì xíng cái kě néng chéng wéi wěn dìng de zhì dù 。
translation: The following is a teaching case. In the past, the automotive repair program at Mingyuan Vocational School in Haizhou scheduled all practical training classes in the afternoon. Because the school had limited equipment, more than twenty students often had to wait at the same time to use the diagnostic instruments, and some could not finish their tasks before class ended. Three months ago, the school began testing a new rule: each practical training class was divided into an early and a late session, and students could apply according to their transportation, part-time work, and family circumstances.

After the rule was announced, the academic affairs office did not immediately decide the schedule for everyone. Instead, it asked students to complete a preference form and explained that they could not consider personal convenience alone. If too many students applied for one session, the homeroom teacher would first discuss the matter with them and then make adjustments based on commuting distance, family care responsibilities, and attendance during the previous month. To prevent misunderstandings, the reasons for any adjustment had to be explained in person, and students could request a review of the final list within two days.

At first, many teachers worried that students in the late session would often be late, while those in the early session might lack energy because they had to get up too early. However, practical training teacher Zhou Hai found that with fewer students, he could clearly observe each person's work and had time to point out mistakes promptly. One student who rarely asked questions said that classmates used to crowd around the machines and he was afraid of delaying everyone, but now he finally felt able to ask for a clear explanation of any step he did not understand.

The new arrangement also caused unexpected problems. The two sessions were graded by different teachers, so the same task sometimes received different evaluations. Students who lived far away also worried about missing the last bus because the late session ended relatively late. Rather than canceling the trial because of these problems, it was better to make the grading standards and departure time clearer. The school therefore standardized the task sheet, ended the late session twenty minutes earlier, and continued to give students an opportunity to change sessions.

After the three-month trial, the academic affairs office held a discussion meeting. The preliminary observations in the case materials indicated that waiting in line had decreased noticeably and that most students believed they had more opportunities to practice, although some found it difficult to remember a schedule that changed every week. The school did not treat majority satisfaction as the only proof of success. Instead, it decided to give each student a fixed session in the following semester and permit temporary changes only when genuine difficulties arose. Teachers would also compare assignments from both sessions to check whether grading was consistent.

This rule was not simply a matter of dividing a group into two. It required the school to deal with fairness, efficiency, and safety at the same time. For a vocational school, whether a practical training arrangement can continue over the long term depends not only on whether the classroom is quiet, but also on whether students truly receive practice, whether teachers use the same standards, and whether students returning home late have suitable transportation. Only by continually listening to feedback and revising the rules can a trial possibly become a stable system.

articles.title: 客服能不能跳过标准步骤
articles.summary: 一家软件客服中心试行灵活处理规则，并通过一次争议完善记录与复核要求。
articles.topic: 客服能不能跳过标准步骤
paragraphs: 这是一则用于课堂讨论的管理教学案例。云帆软件的客服中心设在成都，每天要处理账户登录、付款失败和资料恢复等问题。过去，客服人员必须按照固定顺序提问，即使用户已经说明原因，也不能跳过任何一步。这样做便于记录，却常常使着急的用户失去耐心，员工也觉得自己的判断没有受到信任。
今年三月，中心负责人周宁提出试行一项新规则：一般问题仍参考标准流程，遇到情况清楚、风险较低的请求，客服可以根据对话调整提问顺序；如果涉及退款、隐私或账户所有权，则必须交给值班主管复核。为了避免把“灵活”理解成“随便”，她先选了八名经验不同的员工参加，并安排两次案例练习。
试行第一周就出现了争议。一位用户急着在出差前恢复工作文件，客服小林听完描述后，直接提供了操作方法，省去了重复确认设备型号的环节。问题很快解决，但记录表中缺少跳过步骤的理由。质检员认为这是违反规定，小林却解释说，用户已在系统截图里提供相关信息，继续追问只会浪费双方时间。
周宁没有立刻判断谁对谁错，而是查看完整对话，并请试行员工共同讨论。大家最后补充了两项要求：客服调整顺序时，必须在记录中写明依据；只要无法确认信息是否可靠，就应回到标准流程。中心还增加了每天下班前的十分钟交流，让员工分享一次成功处理和一次犹豫不决的情况，而不是只公布速度排名。
一个月后，内部阶段观察显示，重复提问有所减少，关于解释不清的投诉也比试行初期少，不过复杂账户问题的处理时间没有明显变化。周宁因此没有宣布新规则已经成功，而是决定再观察两个月，并重点检查记录是否完整。她认为，合理的规则既要给员工判断空间，也要留下可以检查的依据；试行的价值不在于迅速证明改革正确，而在于尽早发现规则中容易被误解的地方。
pinyin: zhè shì yī zé yòng yú kè táng tǎo lùn de guǎn lǐ jiào xué àn lì 。 yún fān ruǎn jiàn de kè fú zhōng xīn shè zài chéng dū ， měi tiān yào chǔ lǐ zhàng hù dēng lù 、 fù kuǎn shī bài hé zī liào huī fù děng wèn tí 。 guò qù ， kè fú rén yuán bì xū àn zhào gù dìng shùn xù tí wèn ， jí shǐ yòng hù yǐ jīng shuō míng yuán yīn ， yě bù néng tiào guò rèn hé yī bù 。 zhè yàng zuò biàn yú jì lù ， què cháng cháng shǐ zháo jí de yòng hù shī qù nài xīn ， yuán gōng yě jué de zì jǐ de pàn duàn méi yǒu shòu dào xìn rèn 。

jīn nián sān yuè ， zhōng xīn fù zé rén zhōu níng tí chū shì xíng yī xiàng xīn guī zé ： yì bān wèn tí réng cān kǎo biāo zhǔn liú chéng ， yù dào qíng kuàng qīng chǔ 、 fēng xiǎn jiào dī de qǐng qiú ， kè fú kě yǐ gēn jù duì huà tiáo zhěng tí wèn shùn xù ； rú guǒ shè jí tuì kuǎn 、 yǐn sī huò zhàng hù suǒ yǒu quán ， zé bì xū jiāo gěi zhí bān zhǔ guǎn fù hé 。 wèi le bì miǎn bǎ “ líng huó ” lǐ jiě chéng “ suí biàn ”， tā xiān xuǎn le bā míng jīng yàn bù tóng de yuán gōng cān jiā ， bìng ān pái liǎng cì àn lì liàn xí 。

shì xíng dì yī zhōu jiù chū xiàn le zhēng yì 。 yī wèi yòng hù jí zhe zài chū chāi qián huī fù gōng zuò wén jiàn ， kè fú xiǎo lín tīng wán miáo shù hòu ， zhí jiē tí gōng le cāo zuò fāng fǎ ， shěng qù le chóng fù què rèn shè bèi xíng hào de huán jié 。 wèn tí hěn kuài jiě jué ， dàn jì lù biǎo zhōng quē shǎo tiào guò bù zhòu de lǐ yóu 。 zhì jiǎn yuán rèn wéi zhè shì wéi fǎn guī dìng ， xiǎo lín què jiě shì shuō ， yòng hù yǐ zài xì tǒng jié tú lǐ tí gōng xiāng guān xìn xī ， jì xù zhuī wèn zhǐ huì làng fèi shuāng fāng shí jiān 。

zhōu níng méi yǒu lì kè pàn duàn shuí duì shuí cuò ， ér shì chá kàn wán zhěng duì huà ， bìng qǐng shì xíng yuán gōng gòng tóng tǎo lùn 。 dà jiā zuì hòu bǔ chōng le liǎng xiàng yāo qiú ： kè fú tiáo zhěng shùn xù shí ， bì xū zài jì lù zhōng xiě míng yī jù ； zhǐ yào wú fǎ què rèn xìn xī shì fǒu kě kào ， jiù yīng huí dào biāo zhǔn liú chéng 。 zhōng xīn hái zēng jiā le měi tiān xià bān qián de shí fēn zhōng jiāo liú ， ràng yuán gōng fēn xiǎng yī cì chéng gōng chǔ lǐ hé yī cì yóu yù bù jué de qíng kuàng ， ér bú shì zhǐ gōng bù sù dù pái míng 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， nèi bù jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， chóng fù tí wèn yǒu suǒ jiǎn shǎo ， guān yú jiě shì bù qīng de tóu sù yě bǐ shì xíng chū qī shǎo ， bù guò fù zá zhàng hù wèn tí de chǔ lǐ shí jiān méi yǒu míng xiǎn biàn huà 。 zhōu níng yīn cǐ méi yǒu xuān bù xīn guī zé yǐ jīng chéng gōng ， ér shì jué dìng zài guān chá liǎng gè yuè ， bìng zhòng diǎn jiǎn chá jì lù shì fǒu wán zhěng 。 tā rèn wéi ， hé lǐ de guī zé jì yào gěi yuán gōng pàn duàn kōng jiān ， yě yào liú xià kě yǐ jiǎn chá de yī jù ； shì xíng de jià zhí bù zài yú xùn sù zhèng míng gǎi gé zhèng què ， ér zài yú jǐn zǎo fā xiàn guī zé zhōng róng yì bèi wù jiě de dì fāng 。
translation: This is a management case created for classroom discussion. The customer service center of Yunfan Software is located in Chengdu and handles issues such as account login, failed payments, and data recovery every day. In the past, customer service agents had to ask questions in a fixed order. Even if a user had already explained the cause, they could not skip any step. This made record-keeping easier, but it often caused anxious users to lose patience, while employees felt that their judgment was not trusted.

In March, the head of the center, Zhou Ning, proposed testing a new rule. Ordinary issues would still follow the standard process, but when a request was clear and carried little risk, agents could adjust the order of their questions according to the conversation. If a case involved refunds, privacy, or account ownership, it had to be reviewed by the supervisor on duty. To prevent flexibility from being understood as carelessness, she first selected eight employees with different levels of experience and arranged two case-study exercises.

A disagreement arose during the first week of the trial. One user urgently needed to recover work files before a business trip. After hearing the description, the agent Xiao Lin immediately provided instructions and skipped the repeated confirmation of the device model. The problem was solved quickly, but the service record did not explain why the step had been skipped. The quality inspector believed this violated the rules, while Xiao Lin explained that the user had already supplied the relevant information in a system screenshot and that further questions would only waste time for both sides.

Zhou Ning did not immediately decide who was right or wrong. Instead, she reviewed the complete conversation and invited the participating employees to discuss it together. They eventually added two requirements: whenever agents changed the order of the steps, they had to record the reason; whenever they could not confirm whether information was reliable, they had to return to the standard process. The center also added a ten-minute discussion before the end of each workday, allowing employees to share one successful case and one situation in which they had hesitated, rather than merely publishing speed rankings.

After one month, an internal interim observation showed that repetitive questions had decreased and complaints about unclear explanations were less common than at the beginning of the trial. However, the time required to handle complicated account issues had not changed noticeably. Zhou Ning therefore did not announce that the new rule had succeeded. Instead, she decided to observe it for another two months and focus on whether the records were complete. In her view, a reasonable rule should give employees room to make judgments while also leaving evidence that can be examined. The value of a trial is not to prove quickly that a reform is correct, but to discover as early as possible which parts of a rule are likely to be misunderstood.

articles.title: 先试两周的接送规则
articles.summary: 一所社区托儿中心通过短期试行，发现并调整了新的接送登记规则，既提高了安全性，也照顾了不同家庭的实际困难。
articles.topic: 先试两周的接送规则
paragraphs: 在一份社区管理教学案例中，春桥社区托儿中心准备修改孩子的接送规则。过去，老师只要认出家长，就会让家长把孩子接走。可是有一天，一位老师请假，代班老师不熟悉所有家庭，差点把一个孩子交给前来帮忙的邻居。虽然最后没有发生危险，中心负责人周老师还是意识到，只靠老师记住家长并不可靠。
周老师提出，以后接孩子的人必须出示中心发的接送卡，并在门口登记姓名和时间。有些老师建议立刻长期执行，认为安全问题不能等待。周老师却没有马上决定，而是把新规则安排为两周试行。她向家长解释，试行不是降低要求，而是希望在正式采用以前，找出实际操作中可能出现的困难。
第一周，新规则确实减少了老师反复确认身份的时间，但问题也很快出现。一位爷爷忘了带卡，只能给孩子的母亲打电话；另一位家长下班较晚，请同事临时来接孩子，却没有提前登记。门口因此排起了队，有家长觉得手续太麻烦，也有人担心电话确认会泄露家庭信息。
中心没有因为这些意见取消规则。第二周，周老师作了几项调整：家长可以提前在手机系统中增加临时接送人；老人如果不会使用手机，可以到办公室登记；忘带卡的人必须回答预先设置的问题，并由老师打电话确认。中心还把不同情况的处理方法贴在门口，避免家长和代班老师产生误会。
试行结束后，大多数家庭支持继续执行新规则，但中心保留了纸质接送卡，没有要求所有人都使用手机。周老师在总结中写道，一项制度的目标虽然重要，执行方式也必须符合使用者的真实情况。先试行并不表示缺少决心，而是让管理者有机会根据反馈调整细节，使规则既安全又方便。
pinyin: zài yī fèn shè qū guǎn lǐ jiào xué àn lì zhōng ， chūn qiáo shè qū tuō ér zhōng xīn zhǔn bèi xiū gǎi hái zi de jiē sòng guī zé 。 guò qù ， lǎo shī zhǐ yào rèn chū jiā zhǎng ， jiù huì ràng jiā zhǎng bǎ hái zi jiē zǒu 。 kě shì yǒu yī tiān ， yī wèi lǎo shī qǐng jià ， dài bān lǎo shī bù shú xī suǒ yǒu jiā tíng ， chà diǎn bǎ yí gè hái zi jiāo gěi qián lái bāng máng de lín jū 。 suī rán zuì hòu méi yǒu fā shēng wēi xiǎn ， zhōng xīn fù zé rén zhōu lǎo shī hái shì yì shí dào ， zhǐ kào lǎo shī jì zhù jiā zhǎng bìng bù kě kào 。

zhōu lǎo shī tí chū ， yǐ hòu jiē hái zi de rén bì xū chū shì zhōng xīn fā de jiē sòng kǎ ， bìng zài mén kǒu dēng jì xìng míng hé shí jiān 。 yǒu xiē lǎo shī jiàn yì lì kè cháng qī zhí xíng ， rèn wéi ān quán wèn tí bù néng děng dài 。 zhōu lǎo shī què méi yǒu mǎ shàng jué dìng ， ér shì bǎ xīn guī zé ān pái wèi liǎng zhōu shì xíng 。 tā xiàng jiā zhǎng jiě shì ， shì xíng bú shì jiàng dī yāo qiú ， ér shì xī wàng zài zhèng shì cǎi yòng yǐ qián ， zhǎo chū shí jì cāo zuò zhōng kě néng chū xiàn de kùn nán 。

dì yī zhōu ， xīn guī zé què shí jiǎn shǎo le lǎo shī fǎn fù què rèn shēn fèn de shí jiān ， dàn wèn tí yě hěn kuài chū xiàn 。 yī wèi yé yé wàng le dài kǎ ， zhǐ néng gěi hái zi de mǔ qīn dǎ diàn huà ； lìng yī wèi jiā zhǎng xià bān jiào wǎn ， qǐng tóng shì lín shí lái jiē hái zi ， què méi yǒu tí qián dēng jì 。 mén kǒu yīn cǐ pái qǐ le duì ， yǒu jiā zhǎng jué de shǒu xù tài má fán ， yě yǒu rén dān xīn diàn huà què rèn huì xiè lòu jiā tíng xìn xī 。

zhōng xīn méi yǒu yīn wèi zhè xiē yì jiàn qǔ xiāo guī zé 。 dì èr zhōu ， zhōu lǎo shī zuò le jǐ xiàng tiáo zhěng ： jiā zhǎng kě yǐ tí qián zài shǒu jī xì tǒng zhōng zēng jiā lín shí jiē sòng rén ； lǎo rén rú guǒ bú huì shǐ yòng shǒu jī ， kě yǐ dào bàn gōng shì dēng jì ； wàng dài kǎ de rén bì xū huí dá yù xiān shè zhì de wèn tí ， bìng yóu lǎo shī dǎ diàn huà què rèn 。 zhōng xīn hái bǎ bù tóng qíng kuàng de chǔ lǐ fāng fǎ tiē zài mén kǒu ， bì miǎn jiā zhǎng hé dài bān lǎo shī chǎn shēng wù huì 。

shì xíng jié shù hòu ， dà duō shù jiā tíng zhī chí jì xù zhí xíng xīn guī zé ， dàn zhōng xīn bǎo liú le zhǐ zhì jiē sòng kǎ ， méi yǒu yāo qiú suǒ yǒu rén dōu shǐ yòng shǒu jī 。 zhōu lǎo shī zài zǒng jié zhōng xiě dào ， yī xiàng zhì dù de mù biāo suī rán zhòng yào ， zhí xíng fāng shì yě bì xū fú hé shǐ yòng zhě de zhēn shí qíng kuàng 。 xiān shì xíng bìng bù biǎo shì quē shǎo jué xīn ， ér shì ràng guǎn lǐ zhě yǒu jī huì gēn jù fǎn kuì tiáo zhěng xì jié ， shǐ guī zé jì ān quán yòu fāng biàn 。
translation: In a community management teaching case, the Chunqiao Community Childcare Center was preparing to revise its rules for picking up children. In the past, as long as a teacher recognized a parent, the parent was allowed to take the child home. One day, however, a teacher was absent, and the substitute did not know every family. She nearly handed a child over to a neighbor who had come to help. Although no danger ultimately occurred, the center's director, Ms. Zhou, realized that relying only on teachers to remember parents was not dependable.

Ms. Zhou proposed that anyone picking up a child should present a pickup card issued by the center and register their name and time at the entrance. Some teachers suggested putting the rule into permanent effect immediately because safety issues could not wait. Ms. Zhou did not decide at once, however, and instead arranged a two-week trial. She explained to parents that a trial did not mean lowering standards; its purpose was to identify practical difficulties before the rule was formally adopted.

During the first week, the new rule did reduce the time teachers spent repeatedly checking people's identities, but problems soon appeared as well. One grandfather forgot his card and had to call the child's mother. Another parent finished work late and asked a colleague to pick up the child temporarily, but had not registered the colleague in advance. As a result, a line formed at the entrance. Some parents thought the procedures were too troublesome, while others worried that confirmation by phone might reveal private family information.

The center did not cancel the rule because of these comments. In the second week, Ms. Zhou made several adjustments: parents could add temporary pickup persons in advance through a mobile system; elderly people who could not use a phone could register at the office; and anyone who forgot a card had to answer a previously arranged question and be confirmed through a phone call by a teacher. The center also posted instructions for handling different situations at the entrance to prevent misunderstandings between parents and substitute teachers.

After the trial ended, most families supported continuing the new rule, but the center kept the paper pickup cards and did not require everyone to use a mobile phone. In her summary, Ms. Zhou wrote that although the goal of a policy is important, the way it is carried out must also fit users' real circumstances. Conducting a trial first does not show a lack of determination. Instead, it gives managers a chance to adjust details according to feedback, making a rule both safe and convenient.

articles.title: 清晨的市场不再那么拥堵
articles.summary: 一个教学案例介绍农产品市场如何通过预约到货时段改善车辆拥堵，并根据商户遇到的实际问题调整规则。
articles.topic: 清晨的市场不再堵成一团
paragraphs: 以下是一个用于课堂讨论的教学案例，文中的效果只是材料里的阶段观察，并非现实市场的统计结论。城南农产品市场每天清晨都很忙，送货车、采购员和搬运工常常同时到达。过去，商户可以随时送货，入口附近经常堵成一团，有些蔬菜还没卸下来就被太阳晒热了。
市场管理处决定试行预约制度。商户可以用手机选择到货时段，每个时段的车辆数量有限；没有智能手机的人，也可以提前到服务台登记。负责人周岚认为，与其让所有车辆在门口长时间等待，不如合理安排到达时间。为了让商户适应，新规则开始后的前两周只提醒，不处罚。
制度实行的第一天并不顺利。一位卖土豆的商户记错时间，提前一个小时到达，却被要求在市场外等候。他担心耽误生意，当场表示不满。还有几位年纪较大的商户不会使用预约页面，只好请别人帮忙。周岚没有因此处罚他们，而是安排工作人员在入口指导，并把操作步骤印在卡片上。
几天后，管理处发现，下雨时部分货车行驶得慢，即使司机按计划出发，也可能错过预约时间。于是，市场为每个预约时段设置了二十分钟的宽限期，同时要求司机确认会迟到后及时说明情况。这样的调整既保留了规则，也给意外情况留下了处理空间。
一个月后，材料中的阶段观察显示，入口排队的情况有所减少，多数商户也逐渐形成了提前安排送货的习惯。不过，预约没有解决所有问题：节日前订单突然增加时，热门时段仍然不够用；临时送来的少量货物，也很难提前确定准确时间。因此，管理处保留了一个临时通道，但只有经过确认的车辆才能使用。
这次试行说明，新制度不能只追求方便管理，还要考虑使用者的实际困难。如果工作人员只公布规则，却不提供指导，商户可能会把预约看成额外的负担。相反，当规则能根据反馈及时调整，人们就更愿意配合。周岚计划继续收集意见，试行结束后再决定哪些做法应该长期保留。
pinyin: yǐ xià shì yí gè yòng yú kè táng tǎo lùn de jiào xué àn lì ， wén zhōng de xiào guǒ zhǐ shì cái liào lǐ de jiē duàn guān chá ， bìng fēi xiàn shí shì chǎng de tǒng jì jié lùn 。 chéng nán nóng chǎn pǐn shì chǎng měi tiān qīng chén dōu hěn máng ， sòng huò chē 、 cǎi gòu yuán hé bān yùn gōng cháng cháng tóng shí dào dá 。 guò qù ， shāng hù kě yǐ suí shí sòng huò ， rù kǒu fù jìn jīng cháng dǔ chéng yī tuán ， yǒu xiē shū cài hái méi xiè xià lái jiù bèi tài yáng shài rè le 。

shì chǎng guǎn lǐ chǔ jué dìng shì xíng yù yuē zhì dù 。 shāng hù kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī xuǎn zé dào huò shí duàn ， měi gè shí duàn de chē liàng shù liàng yǒu xiàn ； méi yǒu zhì néng shǒu jī de rén ， yě kě yǐ tí qián dào fú wù tái dēng jì 。 fù zé rén zhōu lán rèn wéi ， yǔ qí ràng suǒ yǒu chē liàng zài mén kǒu zhǎng shí jiān děng dài ， bù rú hé lǐ ān pái dào dá shí jiān 。 wèi le ràng shāng hù shì yìng ， xīn guī zé kāi shǐ hòu de qián liǎng zhōu zhǐ tí xǐng ， bù chǔ fá 。

zhì dù shí xíng de dì yī tiān bìng bù shùn lì 。 yī wèi mài tǔ dòu de shāng hù jì cuò shí jiān ， tí qián yí gè xiǎo shí dào dá ， què bèi yāo qiú zài shì chǎng wài děng hòu 。 tā dān xīn dān wù shēng yì ， dāng chǎng biǎo shì bù mǎn 。 hái yǒu jǐ wèi nián jì jiào dà de shāng hù bú huì shǐ yòng yù yuē yè miàn ， zhǐ hǎo qǐng bié rén bāng máng 。 zhōu lán méi yǒu yīn cǐ chǔ fá tā men ， ér shì ān pái gōng zuò rén yuán zài rù kǒu zhǐ dǎo ， bìng bǎ cāo zuò bù zhòu yìn zài kǎ piàn shàng 。

jǐ tiān hòu ， guǎn lǐ chù fā xiàn ， xià yǔ shí bù fèn huò chē xíng shǐ dé màn ， jí shǐ sī jī àn jì huà chū fā ， yě kě néng cuò guò yù yuē shí jiān 。 yú shì ， shì chǎng wèi měi gè yù yuē shí duàn shè zhì le èr shí fēn zhōng de kuān xiàn qī ， tóng shí yāo qiú sī jī què rèn huì chí dào hòu jí shí shuō míng qíng kuàng 。 zhè yàng de tiáo zhěng jì bǎo liú le guī zé ， yě gěi yì wài qíng kuàng liú xià le chǔ lǐ kōng jiān 。

yí gè yuè hòu ， cái liào zhōng de jiē duàn guān chá xiǎn shì ， rù kǒu pái duì de qíng kuàng yǒu suǒ jiǎn shǎo ， duō shù shāng hù yě zhú jiàn xíng chéng le tí qián ān pái sòng huò de xí guàn 。 bù guò ， yù yuē méi yǒu jiě jué suǒ yǒu wèn tí ： jié rì qián dìng dān tū rán zēng jiā shí ， rè mén shí duàn réng rán bù gòu yòng ； lín shí sòng lái de shǎo liàng huò wù ， yě hěn nán tí qián què dìng zhǔn què shí jiān 。 yīn cǐ ， guǎn lǐ chù bǎo liú le yí gè lín shí tōng dào ， dàn zhǐ yǒu jīng guò què rèn de chē liàng cái néng shǐ yòng 。

zhè cì shì xíng shuō míng ， xīn zhì dù bù néng zhǐ zhuī qiú fāng biàn guǎn lǐ ， hái yào kǎo lǜ shǐ yòng zhě de shí jì kùn nán 。 rú guǒ gōng zuò rén yuán zhǐ gōng bù guī zé ， què bù tí gōng zhǐ dǎo ， shāng hù kě néng huì bǎ yù yuē kàn chéng é wài de fù dān 。 xiāng fǎn ， dāng guī zé néng gēn jù fǎn kuì jí shí diào zhěng ， rén men jiù gèng yuàn yì pèi hé 。 zhōu lán jì huà jì xù shōu jí yì jiàn ， shì xíng jié shù hòu zài jué dìng nǎ xiē zuò fǎ yīng gāi cháng qī bǎo liú 。
translation: The following is a teaching case for classroom discussion. The results described are only interim observations from the material, not statistical conclusions about an actual market. The Chengnan agricultural produce market is very busy every morning, with delivery trucks, buyers, and porters often arriving at the same time. In the past, merchants could deliver goods whenever they wished, so the area near the entrance was frequently jammed, and some vegetables became warm in the sun before they could be unloaded.

The market administration decided to test an appointment system. Merchants could use their phones to select an arrival time slot, with a limit on the number of vehicles in each slot. People without smartphones could also register in advance at the service desk. The manager, Zhou Lan, believed that rather than making every vehicle wait at the entrance for a long time, it would be better to arrange arrival times reasonably. To help merchants adapt, the new rules involved reminders rather than penalties during the first two weeks.

The first day of the system did not go smoothly. A potato seller remembered the wrong time and arrived an hour early, but was asked to wait outside the market. Worried that his business would be delayed, he expressed his dissatisfaction on the spot. Several older merchants did not know how to use the appointment page and had to ask others for help. Instead of penalizing them, Zhou Lan arranged for staff to provide guidance at the entrance and had the operating steps printed on cards.

A few days later, the administration discovered that some trucks traveled slowly when it rained, so drivers could miss their appointment times even if they had departed as planned. The market therefore added a twenty-minute grace period to each time slot and required drivers to explain the situation promptly after confirming that they would be late. This adjustment preserved the rules while also leaving room to handle unexpected circumstances.

After one month, the interim observations in the material showed that queues at the entrance had decreased to some extent, and most merchants had gradually developed the habit of arranging deliveries in advance. However, appointments did not solve every problem. When orders suddenly increased before holidays, popular time slots were still insufficient. It was also difficult to determine an exact time in advance for small, unplanned deliveries. Therefore, the administration kept a temporary lane, but only approved vehicles could use it.

This trial shows that a new system should not focus only on making management easier; it must also consider the practical difficulties of its users. If staff merely announce rules without providing guidance, merchants may regard appointments as an additional burden. In contrast, when rules can be adjusted promptly in response to feedback, people become more willing to cooperate. Zhou Lan plans to continue collecting opinions and decide which measures should be retained in the long term after the trial ends.
