articles.title: 北岸区“汇创里”开业后企业注册增加，复核组为何拒绝认定因果关系
articles.summary: 海陵市北岸区引进共享办公空间“汇创里”后，新设企业注册量出现上升。复核组通过核对时间顺序、政策变化、企业来源和对照地区，发现注册增长还受到审批改革、园区搬迁及统计口径调整等因素影响，最终决定撤回原报告中的因果表述，并建立后续跟踪机制。
articles.topic: 北岸区“汇创里”开业后企业注册增加，复核组为何拒绝认定因果关系
paragraphs: 海陵市北岸区曾是以仓储和小型加工厂为主的老工业片区。为了吸引数字服务、文化创意和跨境贸易企业，区政府将江湾路上一座闲置商场改造成共享办公空间“汇创里”，由一家商业运营机构负责出租工位、提供会议室，并协助入驻者办理营业执照。项目开业后的半年内，北岸区市场监管窗口记录的新设企业数量明显高于此前同期。运营机构据此发布文章，宣称共享办公空间降低了创业成本，直接带动了当地创业活动。区发展部门起草的阶段性报告也沿用了这一判断，准备把“引进共享办公空间”列为促进企业注册的有效政策。然而，在报告提交市政府之前，负责政策评估的复核组指出，注册量上升只能说明两个现象在时间上先后出现，尚不足以证明前者导致了后者。围绕这句话，项目运营方与复核组发生了直接冲突：运营方担心否定因果关系会削弱项目成绩，复核组则认为，未经检验的结论一旦进入正式文件，就可能误导今后的预算分配和区域规划。

复核组首先重新确定了需要解释的对象。原报告把“新设企业数量”“实际创业活动”和“共享办公空间的经营成效”混为一谈，仿佛注册一家公司就等于开展了一项稳定业务。事实上，企业注册只是行政记录：有人可能先领执照再寻找客户，有人可能为了申请平台账号而注册，也有外地企业为了享受办事便利而变更登记地址。与此同时，“汇创里”提供的并不只是办公桌，还包括低价租赁、证照代办、政策咨询和招商对接。即使注册增加确实与项目有关，也必须进一步判断究竟是哪一项服务发挥了作用。因此，复核组把问题拆成三个层次：北岸区的注册增长是否超出了全市共同趋势；新增企业是否真正受到“汇创里”的吸引；即使受到吸引，这些企业是新产生的创业主体，还是从其他街道迁入的存量企业。只有依次回答这些问题，才可能接近原报告所声称的因果关系。

随后，复核人员检查了项目开业前后的制度环境。他们发现，同一时期，海陵市上线了企业登记综合平台，申请人不再需要多次前往窗口提交材料；北岸区还调整了政务大厅的审核流程，并集中清理了一批长期积压的申请。此外，邻近的旧软件园开始改造，部分原有企业把注册地址迁到江湾路，而“汇创里”恰好为这些企业提供了接收工商信函的场所。原报告没有记录这些变化，只把项目开业日期画在注册量曲线上，便将之后的上升部分归因于共享办公空间。复核组认为，这种比较遗漏了同期发生的其他因素。假如审批更加便捷，即使没有“汇创里”，全市也可能出现更多登记；假如新增记录主要来自地址迁移，那么北岸区的数字会上升，但全市真实的创业活动并未增加。时间上的接近可以提出假设，却不能自动排除这些替代解释。

为了辨别不同解释，复核组没有急于寻找一个更漂亮的统计结果，而是回到原始登记材料和可核实的业务过程。他们建议将首次设立、跨区迁入、分支机构登记及仅变更地址的记录分开处理，并核对企业申请日期，而不是只看执照发放日期。因为积压申请可能在流程改革后集中获批，发照时间便不能准确代表创业决定发生的时点。复核组还要求运营机构提供入驻合同和服务记录，用来判断企业是在决定创业之前接触“汇创里”，还是注册之后才租用工位。如果一家企业早已完成登记，后来为接待客户而进入共享空间，就不能把它算作项目促成的新创业者。对于通过代办服务注册却从未实际入驻的企业，也应单独标记，不能仅凭地址相同便推断其经营活动发生在北岸区。这样的核查虽然繁琐，却能避免把行政便利、空间使用与创业产生三个不同环节强行合并。

复核组还讨论了如何建立合理的比较对象。仅比较北岸区开业前后，无法区分项目影响与城市整体变化；随意挑选另一个城区，又可能因产业结构、交通条件和租金水平不同而造成新的偏差。更可行的做法，是先观察各街道在项目落地前的注册趋势、办公租金、行业构成和招商政策，再选择变化轨迹相近且同期没有大型共享办公项目的地区进行对照。同时，还要检验一个关键前提：如果“汇创里”尚未开业时，北岸区的企业注册已经提前上升，那么增长可能来自招商宣传、旧园区搬迁或企业对政策的预期，而不是办公空间投入使用本身。复核组特别提醒，不能在看到结果以后反复更换比较地区，直到得到支持原主张的图形。比较方案、记录分类和观察期限都应事先说明，并把不支持预期的证据一并保留。因果检验的目的不是替某个项目寻找功劳，而是判断在其他条件尽量相同时，该项目是否改变了原本可能出现的结果。

经过复核，各方确认现有材料能够支持的结论十分有限：“汇创里”开业与北岸区企业登记增加在时间上相关，项目的代办和地址服务也确实被部分申请者使用；但是，材料无法排除审批改革、积压申请释放、外区企业迁入以及统计分类变化的影响，更无法证明新增登记都代表新创业活动。运营机构提出，既然有企业表示因低租金而选择北岸区，就应保留“项目带动创业”的说法。复核组回应，个别访谈可以说明可能的作用机制，却不能回答如果没有该项目，这些企业是否仍会注册、是否会在其他地点注册。双方最终作出明确决定：正式报告删除“共享办公空间导致创业注册量上升”的句子，改为“项目开业后登记量上升，但现阶段不能据此确认因果关系”；宣传材料也不得把同期变化写成已经证实的政策效果。这个决定并非认定项目无效，而是承认现有证据尚不足以区分多种竞争性解释。

北岸区随后建立了持续观察方案：市场监管部门按登记类型保存记录，运营机构区分实际入驻、仅使用代办服务和后续迁入的企业，发展部门则同步记录审批规则、租金补贴及周边园区调整。未来评估不仅关注注册数量，还将考察企业是否持续经营、是否新增就业以及是否长期留在本区，但这些指标不会被简单拼成一个笼统的“创业活力”分数。复核事件带来的真正结果，是地方政府没有把一次同步上升包装成确定的成功经验，也没有因证据不足就草率否定共享办公空间。它把一个看似直观的问题还原为可以逐步验证的判断：结果发生在项目之后，不等于结果由项目造成；发现其他影响因素，也不等于项目必然没有作用。面对公共政策中的因果主张，负责任的结论应当与证据强度相匹配。只有说明比较对象、时间顺序、替代解释和数据口径，决策者才能知道哪些成效已经得到支持，哪些仍需等待后续观察。
pinyin: hǎi líng shì běi àn qū céng shì yǐ cāng chǔ hé xiǎo xíng jiā gōng chǎng wéi zhǔ de lǎo gōng yè piàn qū 。 wèi le xī yǐn shù zì fú wù 、 wén huà chuàng yì hé kuà jìng mào yì qǐ yè ， qū zhèng fǔ jiāng jiāng wān lù shàng yī zuò xián zhì shāng chǎng gǎi zào chéng gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān “ huì chuàng lǐ ”， yóu yī jiā shāng yè yùn yíng jī gòu fù zé chū zū gōng wèi 、 tí gōng huì yì shì ， bìng xié zhù rù zhù zhě bàn lǐ yíng yè zhí zhào 。 xiàng mù kāi yè hòu de bàn nián nèi ， běi àn qū shì chǎng jiān guǎn chuāng kǒu jì lù de xīn shè qǐ yè shù liàng míng xiǎn gāo yú cǐ qián tóng qī 。 yùn yíng jī gòu jù cǐ fā bù wén zhāng ， xuān chēng gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān jiàng dī le chuàng yè chéng běn ， zhí jiē dài dòng liǎo dàng dì chuàng yè huó dòng 。 qū fā zhǎn bù mén qǐ cǎo de jiē duàn xìng bào gào yě yán yòng le zhè yī pàn duàn ， zhǔn bèi bǎ “ yǐn jìn gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān ” liè wèi cù jìn qǐ yè zhù cè de yǒu xiào zhèng cè 。 rán ér ， zài bào gào tí jiāo shì zhèng fǔ zhī qián ， fù zé zhèng cè píng gū de fù hé zǔ zhǐ chū ， zhù cè liàng shàng shēng zhǐ néng shuō míng liǎng gè xiàn xiàng zài shí jiān shàng xiān hòu chū xiàn ， shàng bù zú yǐ zhèng míng qián zhě dǎo zhì le hòu zhě 。 wéi rào zhè jù huà ， xiàng mù yùn yíng fāng yǔ fù hé zǔ fā shēng le zhí jiē chōng tū ： yùn yíng fāng dān xīn fǒu dìng yīn guǒ guān xì huì xuē ruò xiàng mù chéng jì ， fù hé zǔ zé rèn wéi ， wèi jīng jiǎn yàn de jié lùn yí dàn jìn rù zhèng shì wén jiàn ， jiù kě néng wù dǎo jīn hòu de yù suàn fēn pèi hé qū yù guī huà 。

fù hé zǔ shǒu xiān chóng xīn què dìng le xū yào jiě shì de duì xiàng 。 yuán bào gào bǎ “ xīn shè qǐ yè shù liàng ”“ shí jì chuàng yè huó dòng ” hé “ gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān de jīng yíng chéng xiào ” hùn wéi yī tán ， fǎng fú zhù cè yī jiā gōng sī jiù děng yú kāi zhǎn le yī xiàng wěn dìng yè wù 。 shì shí shàng ， qǐ yè zhù cè zhǐ shì xíng zhèng jì lù ： yǒu rén kě néng xiān lǐng zhí zhào zài xún zhǎo kè hù ， yǒu rén kě néng wèi le shēn qǐng píng tái zhàng hào ér zhù cè ， yě yǒu wài dì qǐ yè wèi le xiǎng shòu bàn shì biàn lì ér biàn gēng dēng jì dì zhǐ 。 yǔ cǐ tóng shí ，“ huì chuàng lǐ ” tí gōng de bìng bù zhǐ shì bàn gōng zhuō ， hái bāo kuò dī jià zū lìn 、 zhèng zhào dài bàn 、 zhèng cè zī xún hé zhāo shāng duì jiē 。 jí shǐ zhù cè zēng jiā què shí yǔ xiàng mù yǒu guān ， yě bì xū jìn yí bù pàn duàn jiū jìng shì nǎ yī xiàng fú wù fā huī le zuò yòng 。 yīn cǐ ， fù hé zǔ bǎ wèn tí chāi chéng sān gè céng cì ： běi àn qū de zhù cè zēng zhǎng shì fǒu chāo chū le quán shì gòng tóng qū shì ； xīn zēng qǐ yè shì fǒu zhēn zhèng shòu dào “ huì chuàng lǐ ” de xī yǐn ； jí shǐ shòu dào xī yǐn ， zhè xiē qǐ yè shì xīn chǎn shēng de chuàng yè zhǔ tǐ ， hái shì cóng qí tā jiē dào qiān rù de cún liàng qǐ yè 。 zhǐ yǒu yī cì huí dá zhè xiē wèn tí ， cái kě néng jiē jìn yuán bào gào suǒ shēng chēng de yīn guǒ guān xì 。

suí hòu ， fù hé rén yuán jiǎn chá le xiàng mù kāi yè qián hòu de zhì dù huán jìng 。 tā men fā xiàn ， tóng yī shí qī ， hǎi líng shì shàng xiàn le qǐ yè dēng jì zōng hé píng tái ， shēn qǐng rén bù zài xū yào duō cì qián wǎng chuāng kǒu tí jiāo cái liào ； běi àn qū hái tiáo zhěng le zhèng wù dà tīng de shěn hé liú chéng ， bìng jí zhōng qīng lǐ le yī pī cháng qī jī yā de shēn qǐng 。 cǐ wài ， lín jìn de jiù ruǎn jiàn yuán kāi shǐ gǎi zào ， bù fèn yuán yǒu qǐ yè bǎ zhù cè dì zhǐ qiān dào jiāng wān lù ， ér “ huì chuàng lǐ ” qià hǎo wèi zhè xiē qǐ yè tí gōng le jiē shōu gōng shāng xìn hán de chǎng suǒ 。 yuán bào gào méi yǒu jì lù zhè xiē biàn huà ， zhǐ bǎ xiàng mù kāi yè rì qī huà zài zhù cè liàng qū xiàn shàng ， biàn jiāng zhī hòu de shàng shēng bù fèn guī yīn yú gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān 。 fù hé zǔ rèn wéi ， zhè zhǒng bǐ jiào yí lòu le tóng qī fā shēng de qí tā yīn sù 。 jiǎ rú shěn pī gèng jiā biàn jié ， jí shǐ méi yǒu “ huì chuàng lǐ ”， quán shì yě kě néng chū xiàn gèng duō dēng jì ； jiǎ rú xīn zēng jì lù zhǔ yào lái zì dì zhǐ qiān yí ， nà me běi àn qū de shù zì huì shàng shēng ， dàn quán shì zhēn shí de chuàng yè huó dòng bìng wèi zēng jiā 。 shí jiān shàng de jiē jìn kě yǐ tí chū jiǎ shè ， què bù néng zì dòng pái chú zhè xiē tì dài jiě shì 。

wèi le biàn bié bù tóng jiě shì ， fù hé zǔ méi yǒu jí yú xún zhǎo yí gè gèng piào liàng de tǒng jì jié guǒ ， ér shì huí dào yuán shǐ dēng jì cái liào hé kě hé shí de yè wù guò chéng 。 tā men jiàn yì jiāng shǒu cì shè lì 、 kuà qū qiān rù 、 fēn zhī jī gòu dēng jì jí jǐn biàn gēng dì zhǐ de jì lù fēn kāi chǔ lǐ ， bìng hé duì qǐ yè shēn qǐng rì qī ， ér bú shì zhǐ kàn zhí zhào fā fàng rì qī 。 yīn wèi jī yā shēn qǐng kě néng zài liú chéng gǎi gé hòu jí zhōng huò pī ， fā zhào shí jiān biàn bù néng zhǔn què dài biǎo chuàng yè jué dìng fā shēng de shí diǎn 。 fù hé zǔ hái yāo qiú yùn yíng jī gòu tí gōng rù zhù hé tóng hé fú wù jì lù ， yòng lái pàn duàn qǐ yè shì zài jué dìng chuàng yè zhī qián jiē chù “ huì chuàng lǐ ”， hái shì zhù cè zhī hòu cái zū yòng gōng wèi 。 rú guǒ yī jiā qǐ yè zǎo yǐ wán chéng dēng jì ， hòu lái wèi jiē dài kè hù ér jìn rù gòng xiǎng kōng jiān ， jiù bù néng bǎ tā suàn zuò xiàng mù cù chéng de xīn chuàng yè zhě 。 duì yú tōng guò dài bàn fú wù zhù cè què cóng wèi shí jì rù zhù de qǐ yè ， yě yīng dān dú biāo jì ， bù néng jǐn píng dì zhǐ xiāng tóng biàn tuī duàn qí jīng yíng huó dòng fā shēng zài běi àn qū 。 zhè yàng de hé chá suī rán fán suǒ ， què néng bì miǎn bǎ xíng zhèng biàn lì 、 kōng jiān shǐ yòng yǔ chuàng yè chǎn shēng sān gè bù tóng huán jié qiáng xíng hé bìng 。

fù hé zǔ hái tǎo lùn le rú hé jiàn lì hé lǐ de bǐ jiào duì xiàng 。 jǐn bǐ jiào běi àn qū kāi yè qián hòu ， wú fǎ qū fēn xiàng mù yǐng xiǎng yǔ chéng shì zhěng tǐ biàn huà ； suí yì tiāo xuǎn lìng yí gè chéng qū ， yòu kě néng yīn chǎn yè jié gòu 、 jiāo tōng tiáo jiàn hé zū jīn shuǐ píng bù tóng ér zào chéng xīn de piān chā 。 gèng kě xíng de zuò fǎ ， shì xiān guān chá gè jiē dào zài xiàng mù luò dì qián de zhù cè qū shì 、 bàn gōng zū jīn 、 háng yè gòu chéng hé zhāo shāng zhèng cè ， zài xuǎn zé biàn huà guǐ jì xiāng jìn qiě tóng qī méi yǒu dà xíng gòng xiǎng bàn gōng xiàng mù dì dì qū jìn xíng duì zhào 。 tóng shí ， hái yào jiǎn yàn yí gè guān jiàn qián tí ： rú guǒ “ huì chuàng lǐ ” shàng wèi kāi yè shí ， běi àn qū de qǐ yè zhù cè yǐ jīng tí qián shàng shēng ， nà me zēng zhǎng kě néng lái zì zhāo shāng xuān chuán 、 jiù yuán qū bān qiān huò qǐ yè duì zhèng cè de yù qī ， ér bú shì bàn gōng kōng jiān tóu rù shǐ yòng běn shēn 。 fù hé zǔ tè bié tí xǐng ， bù néng zài kàn dào jié guǒ yǐ hòu fǎn fù gēng huàn bǐ jiào dì qū ， zhí dào dé dào zhī chí yuán zhǔ zhāng de tú xíng 。 bǐ jiào fāng àn 、 jì lù fēn lèi hé guān chá qī xiàn dōu yīng shì xiān shuō míng ， bìng bǎ bù zhī chí yù qī de zhèng jù yī bìng bǎo liú 。 yīn guǒ jiǎn yàn de mù dì bú shì tì mǒu gè xiàng mù xún zhǎo gōng láo ， ér shì pàn duàn zài qí tā tiáo jiàn jǐn liàng xiāng tóng shí ， gāi xiàng mù shì fǒu gǎi biàn le yuán běn kě néng chū xiàn de jié guǒ 。

jīng guò fù hé ， gè fāng què rèn xiàn yǒu cái liào néng gòu zhī chí de jié lùn shí fēn yǒu xiàn ：“ huì chuàng lǐ ” kāi yè yǔ běi àn qū qǐ yè dēng jì zēng jiā zài shí jiān shàng xiàng guān ， xiàng mù dì dài bàn hé dì zhǐ fú wù yě què shí bèi bù fèn shēn qǐng zhě shǐ yòng ； dàn shì ， cái liào wú fǎ pái chú shěn pī gǎi gé 、 jī yā shēn qǐng shì fàng 、 wài qū qǐ yè qiān rù yǐ jí tǒng jì fēn lèi biàn huà de yǐng xiǎng ， gèng wú fǎ zhèng míng xīn zēng dēng jì dōu dài biǎo xīn chuàng yè huó dòng 。 yùn yíng jī gòu tí chū ， jì rán yǒu qǐ yè biǎo shì yīn dī zū jīn ér xuǎn zé běi àn qū ， jiù yīng bǎo liú “ xiàng mù dài dòng chuàng yè ” de shuō fǎ 。 fù hé zǔ huí yìng ， gè bié fǎng tán kě yǐ shuō míng kě néng de zuò yòng jī zhì ， què bù néng huí dá rú guǒ méi yǒu gāi xiàng mù ， zhè xiē qǐ yè shì fǒu réng huì zhù cè 、 shì fǒu huì zài qí tā dì diǎn zhù cè 。 shuāng fāng zuì zhōng zuò chū míng què jué dìng ： zhèng shì bào gào shān chú “ gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān dǎo zhì chuàng yè zhù cè liàng shàng shēng ” de jù zi ， gǎi wéi “ xiàng mù kāi yè hòu dēng jì liàng shàng shēng ， dàn xiàn jiē duàn bù néng jù cǐ què rèn yīn guǒ guān xì ”； xuān chuán cái liào yě bù dé bǎ tóng qī biàn huà xiě chéng yǐ jīng zhèng shí de zhèng cè xiào guǒ 。 zhè ge jué dìng bìng fēi rèn dìng xiàng mù wú xiào ， ér shì chéng rèn xiàn yǒu zhèng jù shàng bù zú yǐ qū fēn duō zhǒng jìng zhēng xìng jiě shì 。

běi àn qū suí hòu jiàn lì le chí xù guān chá fāng àn ： shì chǎng jiān guǎn bù mén àn dēng jì lèi xíng bǎo cún jì lù ， yùn yíng jī gòu qū fēn shí jì rù zhù 、 jǐn shǐ yòng dài bàn fú wù hé hòu xù qiān rù de qǐ yè ， fā zhǎn bù mén zé tóng bù jì lù shěn pī guī zé 、 zū jīn bǔ tiē jí zhōu biān yuán qū tiáo zhěng 。 wèi lái píng gū bù jǐn guān zhù zhù cè shù liàng ， hái jiāng kǎo chá qǐ yè shì fǒu chí xù jīng yíng 、 shì fǒu xīn zēng jiù yè yǐ jí shì fǒu cháng qī liú zài běn qū ， dàn zhè xiē zhǐ biāo bú huì bèi jiǎn dān pīn chéng yí gè lǒng tǒng de “ chuàng yè huó lì ” fēn shù 。 fù hé shì jiàn dài lái de zhēn zhèng jié guǒ ， shì dì fāng zhèng fǔ méi yǒu bǎ yī cì tóng bù shàng shēng bāo zhuāng chéng què dìng de chéng gōng jīng yàn ， yě méi yǒu yīn zhèng jù bù zú jiù cǎo shuài fǒu dìng gòng xiǎng bàn gōng kōng jiān 。 tā bǎ yí gè kàn shì zhí guān de wèn tí huán yuán wèi kě yǐ zhú bù yàn zhèng de pàn duàn ： jié guǒ fā shēng zài xiàng mù zhī hòu ， bù děng yú jié guǒ yóu xiàng mù zào chéng ； fā xiàn qí tā yǐng xiǎng yīn sù ， yě bù děng yú xiàng mù bì rán méi yǒu zuò yòng 。 miàn duì gōng gòng zhèng cè zhōng de yīn guǒ zhǔ zhāng ， fù zé rèn de jié lùn yīng dāng yǔ zhèng jù qiáng dù xiāng pǐ pèi 。 zhǐ yǒu shuō míng bǐ jiào duì xiàng 、 shí jiān shùn xù 、 tì dài jiě shì hé shù jù kǒu jìng ， jué cè zhě cái néng zhī dào nǎ xiē chéng xiào yǐ jīng dé dào zhī chí ， nǎ xiē réng xū děng dài hòu xù guān chá 。
translation: Beian District in Hailing City was once an old industrial area dominated by warehouses and small processing plants. To attract digital services, cultural and creative businesses, and cross-border trade companies, the district government converted a vacant shopping mall on Jiangwan Road into a coworking space called Huichuangli. A commercial operator was put in charge of renting out workstations, providing meeting rooms, and helping tenants obtain business licenses. During the first six months after the project opened, the number of newly established companies recorded by Beian District's market regulation service desk was significantly higher than in the corresponding period before the opening. On this basis, the operator published an article claiming that the coworking space had lowered startup costs and directly stimulated local entrepreneurial activity. A preliminary report drafted by the district development department adopted the same conclusion and was set to list the introduction of coworking spaces as an effective policy for encouraging business registrations. Before the report was submitted to the municipal government, however, the review team responsible for policy evaluation pointed out that the increase in registrations showed only that the two phenomena had occurred one after the other, which was not yet sufficient to prove that the former had caused the latter. This statement triggered a direct conflict between the project operator and the review team. The operator feared that rejecting the causal relationship would diminish the project's achievements, while the review team believed that if an untested conclusion entered an official document, it could misdirect future budget allocations and regional planning.

The review team first redefined what needed to be explained. The original report conflated the number of newly established companies, actual entrepreneurial activity, and the business performance of the coworking space, as though registering a company were equivalent to launching a stable business. In reality, company registration is merely an administrative record: some people may obtain a license before looking for customers, some may register in order to apply for an account on a platform, and companies from other areas may change their registered addresses to take advantage of more convenient administrative services. Meanwhile, Huichuangli provided more than just desks; its offerings also included low-cost rentals, assistance with licenses and permits, policy consultation, and business recruitment support. Even if the increase in registrations was indeed related to the project, it would still be necessary to determine which particular service had produced the effect. The review team therefore divided the issue into three levels: whether the growth in registrations in Beian District exceeded the citywide trend; whether the newly added companies had genuinely been attracted by Huichuangli; and, even if they had been attracted by it, whether these companies were newly created entrepreneurial entities or existing businesses that had relocated from other subdistricts. Only by answering these questions in sequence would it be possible to approach the causal relationship claimed in the original report.

The reviewers then examined the institutional environment before and after the project opened. They found that during the same period, Hailing City had launched an integrated business registration platform, eliminating the need for applicants to visit service counters repeatedly to submit documents. Beian District had also adjusted the review procedures at its government service hall and cleared a batch of applications that had been backlogged for a long time. In addition, a nearby former software park began undergoing redevelopment, and some of its existing companies moved their registered addresses to Jiangwan Road. Huichuangli happened to provide these companies with a place to receive official business correspondence. The original report had not recorded any of these changes. It had simply marked the project's opening date on the registration-volume curve and attributed the subsequent increase to the coworking space. The review team concluded that this comparison had omitted other factors occurring during the same period. If the approval process had become more convenient, registrations might have increased throughout the city even without Huichuangli. If the new records mainly resulted from address changes, Beian District's figures would rise without any increase in genuine entrepreneurial activity across the city. Temporal proximity can generate a hypothesis, but it cannot automatically rule out these alternative explanations.

To distinguish among the different explanations, the review team did not rush to find a more appealing statistical result. Instead, it returned to the original registration materials and verifiable business processes. The team recommended separating records of first-time establishments, relocations into the district, branch registrations, and address-only changes, and checking companies' application dates rather than looking only at the dates on which licenses were issued. Because backlogged applications might have been approved in a concentrated period after the procedural reform, the issuance date could not accurately represent when the decision to start a business had been made. The review team also required the operator to provide occupancy contracts and service records so that it could determine whether companies had encountered Huichuangli before deciding to start a business or had rented workstations only after registering. If a company had already completed its registration and later moved into the coworking space to receive clients, it could not be counted as a new startup created by the project. Companies that registered through the assistance service but never physically moved in should also be marked separately; the fact that they shared the same address was not, by itself, grounds for inferring that their business activities took place in Beian District. Although this verification was laborious, it prevented administrative convenience, use of the space, and the creation of a new business from being forcibly merged into a single process.

The review team also discussed how to establish an appropriate basis for comparison. Merely comparing Beian District before and after the opening could not distinguish the project's effects from changes occurring across the city. Arbitrarily selecting another urban district could introduce new bias because of differences in industrial structure, transportation conditions, and rent levels. A more feasible approach would be to first examine each subdistrict's pre-project trends in business registrations, office rents, industry composition, and business recruitment policies, and then choose as controls areas with similar trajectories that had no major coworking projects during the same period. A crucial assumption would also need to be tested: if business registrations in Beian District had already begun rising before Huichuangli opened, the growth might have resulted from business recruitment campaigns, relocations from the former industrial park, or companies' expectations regarding policy, rather than from the coworking space becoming operational. The review team specifically warned against repeatedly changing the comparison area after seeing the results until a graph supporting the original claim emerged. The comparison plan, record classifications, and observation period should all be specified in advance, and evidence that did not support expectations should be retained as well. The purpose of causal testing is not to find credit for a particular project, but to determine whether, with other conditions kept as similar as possible, the project changed the outcome that would otherwise likely have occurred.

After the review, all parties confirmed that the existing materials supported only a very limited conclusion: the opening of Huichuangli was temporally associated with an increase in business registrations in Beian District, and some applicants had indeed used the project's registration assistance and address services. However, the materials could not rule out the effects of approval-process reforms, the clearance of backlogged applications, the relocation of companies from other districts, or changes in statistical classification, much less prove that all new registrations represented new entrepreneurial activity. The operator argued that because some companies had said they chose Beian District because of its low rents, the claim that the project had stimulated entrepreneurship should be retained. The review team responded that individual interviews could illustrate a possible mechanism, but could not establish whether those companies would still have registered without the project or whether they would have registered elsewhere. The two sides ultimately made a clear decision: the official report would delete the sentence stating that the coworking space had caused the increase in startup registrations and replace it with, "Registrations increased after the project opened, but this does not, at the present stage, establish a causal relationship." Promotional materials would likewise be prohibited from presenting simultaneous changes as a proven policy effect. This decision did not amount to finding the project ineffective; it acknowledged that the existing evidence was not sufficient to distinguish among several competing explanations.

Beian District subsequently established an ongoing monitoring plan. The market regulation department would preserve records by registration type, the operator would distinguish among companies that physically occupied the space, those that used only registration assistance, and those that relocated there later, while the development department would simultaneously record approval rules, rent subsidies, and adjustments to surrounding industrial parks. Future evaluations would consider not only the number of registrations but also whether companies remained in operation, created new jobs, and stayed in the district over the long term. These indicators, however, would not simply be combined into a vague score for "entrepreneurial vitality." The real outcome of the review was that the local government neither packaged a simultaneous increase as a definitive success story nor hastily dismissed the coworking space merely because the evidence was insufficient. It restored an apparently intuitive question to a judgment that could be tested step by step: an outcome occurring after a project does not mean that the project caused it, while identifying other contributing factors does not mean that the project necessarily had no effect. When addressing causal claims in public policy, responsible conclusions should match the strength of the evidence. Only by specifying the comparison group, temporal sequence, alternative explanations, and data definitions can decision-makers know which effects are already supported and which still require further observation.

vocabulary.meaning: 未被使用或没有得到充分利用。
进入某个园区、平台或办公场所开展业务的人或企业。
属于某一发展阶段、只反映特定时期情况的。
对已有材料、结论或结果再次检查核实。
一个事件或因素引起另一个事件或结果的关系。
按照计划把有限资金分派给不同项目或部门。
把性质不同的事物当作相同事物来讨论。
在相关政策或项目实施前就已经存在的企业。
大量事务因未能及时处理而累积下来。
把某种结果解释为由某个因素造成。
除原有解释之外，同样可能说明某种现象的其他解释。
检查信息或情况是否真实、准确。
事情复杂、步骤多，处理起来麻烦。
某项指标随时间发生变化的路径或趋势。
针对同一现象提出的、彼此竞争的不同原因说明。
统计数据所采用的范围、标准和分类方式。

grammar.explanation: 表示让步关系，承认前一情况成立，但指出后一判断或要求仍然不变。
grammar.example: 即使注册增加确实与项目有关，也必须进一步判断究竟是哪一项服务发挥了作用。

grammar.explanation: 用于否定一种目的、原因或判断，并肯定另一种更准确的说法。
grammar.example: 因果检验的目的不是替某个项目寻找功劳，而是判断在其他条件尽量相同时，该项目是否改变了原本可能出现的结果。

grammar.explanation: 表示必要条件，说明必须满足前面的条件，后面的结果才可能实现。
grammar.example: 只有依次回答这些问题，才可能接近原报告所声称的因果关系。

questions.prompt: 复核组为什么认为注册量上升不能直接证明“汇创里”带动了创业活动？
options: 因为两个现象先后出现只表明时间相关，尚不能证明因果关系
因为“汇创里”没有向任何企业提供办公场所
因为北岸区开业后的企业登记量实际低于此前同期
因为运营机构拒绝公布项目开业日期
questions.explanation: 复核组区分了时间上的先后关系与因果关系；登记量在项目开业后上升，并不自动意味着上升由该项目造成。
questions.evidence: 然而，在报告提交市政府之前，负责政策评估的复核组指出，注册量上升只能说明两个现象在时间上先后出现，尚不足以证明前者导致了后者。

questions.prompt: 复核组建议核对企业申请日期而不只看执照发放日期，主要原因是什么？
options: 申请日期能够直接证明企业一定受到低租金吸引
积压申请可能在流程改革后集中获批，发照日期未必代表创业决定发生的时间
营业执照发放日期无法用于区分企业所属行业
运营机构只保存申请日期，没有保存执照发放日期
questions.explanation: 流程改革可能使过去积压的申请集中获批，因此发照时间反映的可能是审批完成时间，而不是企业作出创业决定的真实时点。
questions.evidence: 因为积压申请可能在流程改革后集中获批，发照时间便不能准确代表创业决定发生的时点。

questions.prompt: 各方最终如何处理正式报告和宣传材料中的因果表述？
options: 保留“项目带动创业”的说法，但删除所有登记数据
认定项目完全无效，并停止共享办公空间运营
删除已经确认因果关系的表述，改为说明登记量上升但暂时不能确认因果关系
把审批改革和企业迁入全部认定为项目产生的间接效果
questions.explanation: 最终决定没有断言项目无效，也没有继续把同期上升写成已证实的项目效果，而是采用与现有证据强度相匹配的谨慎表述。
questions.evidence: 双方最终作出明确决定：正式报告删除“共享办公空间导致创业注册量上升”的句子，改为“项目开业后登记量上升，但现阶段不能据此确认因果关系”；宣传材料也不得把同期变化写成已经证实的政策效果。

articles.title: 一张下降曲线能证明什么：青岚中学空气净化项目的因果审查
articles.summary: 青岚中学安装空气净化设备后，学生缺勤记录有所下降，但同期流感强度、通风制度、请假登记和校外暴露都发生了变化。校方在发布宣传结论前，组织教师、家长和公共卫生顾问审查证据，最终放弃简单归因，转而采用分阶段实施、统一记录和补充调查来检验净化设备的真实效果。
articles.topic: 一张下降曲线能证明什么：青岚中学空气净化项目的因果审查
paragraphs: 初春，青岚中学准备公布上一学期的健康管理总结。后勤处制作的图表显示，自从教学楼安装空气净化设备后，因呼吸道不适而缺勤的学生比安装前少了。校长认为，这条下降曲线足以说明设备发挥了作用，并打算在家长会上宣布“空气净化项目显著降低了学生缺勤”。这项表述看似顺理成章：净化器能够过滤部分颗粒物，室内空气改善，学生患病或症状加重的机会似乎也会随之减少。然而，负责审核材料的语文教师周岚注意到，图表只是把两个相邻时期放在一起，并没有回答一个关键问题：如果学校当时没有安装设备，缺勤是否也会下降？因果判断所需要的，正是这个无法直接观察的对照情形。安装发生在前、缺勤下降发生在后，只能说明时间顺序一致，不能自动排除其他解释。她建议校方暂缓发布结论，先查清同一时期还有哪些变化。

审查小组随后调阅校历、值班记录、晨检表和后勤通知，发现安装设备并不是那段时间唯一发生的事情。上一轮流感传播较为集中，而设备启用后的流感季相对平稳；学校还修改了通风制度，要求课间开窗，并把午休后的集中通风列入班主任检查项目。与此同时，请假流程从纸质假条改为线上登记，部分过去被归为“生病”的缺席，如今被细分为家庭事务、交通延误和体育比赛。也就是说，缺勤总量和缺勤分类都受到了制度变化的影响。如果只比较安装前后的数字，流感强度、开窗通风和登记口径便会与净化设备的作用纠缠在一起。校长反驳说，设备启用后空气检测仪上的颗粒物读数确实更稳定。周岚承认这可以支持“设备改变了部分室内环境”，却不能直接推出“这种改变导致学生更少缺勤”。从空气指标到健康症状，再从症状到是否请假，中间还隔着病毒传播、个体体质、家庭决定和登记方式等多个环节。

争议很快扩展到校外暴露。研究材料只记录学生在校期间所在的班级，却不知道他们放学后去了哪里。有的学生乘坐拥挤的公共交通工具，有的长期参加室内培训，有的家中有人吸烟，还有的周末频繁往返医院照顾亲属。这些经历都可能影响呼吸道健康。如果安装净化器后恰好有更多家庭减少了聚集活动，缺勤下降就可能被错误地归功于学校设备；反过来，如果学生在校外遭遇严重污染，设备的实际保护作用也可能被掩盖。家长代表担心，询问家庭环境会侵犯隐私。公共卫生顾问因此提出，学校不应收集详细地址、病历或家庭成员身份，而可以采用自愿、匿名的简短问卷，只记录与分析直接相关的暴露类别，并允许跳过问题。这样做仍无法完整还原每名学生的生活轨迹，却能判断校外因素是否在不同班级或不同时段出现明显失衡。证据的边界必须被坦率承认，不能因为某些信息难以取得，就假装它们不存在。

小组还发现，设备并非同时、同样地影响所有教室。靠近操场的旧楼先完成安装，新楼则因电路改造延后；有些班级全天开启设备，有些班级因噪声在考试时关闭；滤芯更换也没有统一记录。这种不整齐原本被视为管理缺陷，却为更可靠的比较提供了可能。顾问建议，不要笼统地把全校分成“安装前”和“安装后”，而应依据实际启用日期，比较同一时期已经启用和尚未启用的班级，同时考察各班在启用前是否具有相近的缺勤变化趋势。若两组在设备启用前走势差异很大，后来的差距便难以解释为设备造成。即使启用后出现分化，也要检查班级位置、年级课程、学生人数和通风执行情况。对于因施工安排形成的先后顺序，学校还须判断它是否与健康风险有关：假如缺勤较多的旧楼被优先安装，直接比较两组反而可能低估设备效果；假如管理更严格的班级优先使用，则可能高估效果。任何统计方法都不能替代对实施过程的了解。

经过讨论，校方作出两个决定。第一，删除宣传稿中“安装设备使缺勤减少”的确定说法，改为“设备启用后观察到缺勤下降，但现有记录不足以确认下降由设备单独造成”。第二，把尚未完成的安装工程转化为一项预先规划的评估。学校不会为了研究故意让学生长期处于较差空气中，而是在安全标准一致的前提下，按施工能力分批启用设备；各批次采用相同的请假分类、通风要求、滤芯维护表和室内空气记录。评估方案在查看结果前写明主要观察指标、比较时段和排除规则，避免事后挑选最有利的日期或病种。匿名问卷只询问近期公共交通、家庭吸烟和校外密集活动等概括信息，健康数据则由校医去除姓名后汇总。若某段时间出现全市性流感变化，分析时应单独标记，而不是把它悄悄并入设备效果。小组还决定同时观察空气质量、症状报告与缺勤记录，因为三者若朝同一方向变化，解释会更连贯；若只有登记数字改变，就应首先检查制度和行为因素。

家长会当天，校长没有展示一句醒目的成功口号，而是解释了观察、关联与因果之间的差别。他承认，学校最初急于证明采购值得，险些把有利的时间顺序当成充分证据。家长并未因此否定净化设备，反而更关心学校是否会按时更换滤芯、处理噪声并公开评估方法。最终，设备继续使用，通风制度也被保留；此前的缺勤下降被写入报告，但被明确标注为尚待检验的现象，而不是已经证实的功效。这个结果没有给出一个轻率而漂亮的答案，却使后续决定更稳妥：若分阶段比较显示，设备启用后室内指标持续改善，并且在流感强度、通风、登记口径和校外暴露得到合理控制后，相关缺勤仍出现一致变化，因果主张才会更有说服力；若这种关系消失，学校也应接受设备并非主要原因。严谨检验的意义，不是阻止行动，而是防止一个值得实施的措施被不可靠的论证支撑。只有把替代解释、测量误差和证据限制公开摆上桌面，学校才能知道自己究竟改善了什么，又有哪些变化不能据为己功。
pinyin: chū chūn ， qīng lán zhōng xué zhǔn bèi gōng bù shàng yī xué qī de jiàn kāng guǎn lǐ zǒng jié 。 hòu qín chù zhì zuò de tú biǎo xiǎn shì ， zì cóng jiào xué lóu ān zhuāng kōng qì jìng huà shè bèi hòu ， yīn hū xī dào bù shì ér quē qín de xué shēng bǐ ān zhuāng qián shǎo le 。 xiào zhǎng rèn wéi ， zhè tiáo xià jiàng qū xiàn zú yǐ shuō míng shè bèi fā huī le zuò yòng ， bìng dǎ suàn zài jiā zhǎng huì shàng xuān bù “ kōng qì jìng huà xiàng mù xiǎn zhù jiàng dī le xué shēng quē qín ”。 zhè xiàng biǎo shù kàn shì shùn lǐ chéng zhāng ： jìng huà qì néng gòu guò lǜ bù fèn kē lì wù ， shì nèi kōng qì gǎi shàn ， xué shēng huàn bìng huò zhèng zhuàng jiā zhòng de jī huì sì hū yě huì suí zhī jiǎn shǎo 。 rán ér ， fù zé shěn hé cái liào de yǔ wén jiào shī zhōu lán zhù yì dào ， tú biǎo zhǐ shì bǎ liǎng gè xiāng lín shí qī fàng zài yì qǐ ， bìng méi yǒu huí dá yí gè guān jiàn wèn tí ： rú guǒ xué xiào dāng shí méi yǒu ān zhuāng shè bèi ， quē qín shì fǒu yě huì xià jiàng ？ yīn guǒ pàn duàn suǒ xū yào de ， zhèng shì zhè ge wú fǎ zhí jiē guān chá de duì zhào qíng xíng 。 ān zhuāng fā shēng zài qián 、 quē qín xià jiàng fā shēng zài hòu ， zhǐ néng shuō míng shí jiān shùn xù yí zhì ， bù néng zì dòng pái chú qí tā jiě shì 。 tā jiàn yì xiào fāng zàn huǎn fā bù jié lùn ， xiān chá qīng tóng yī shí qī hái yǒu nǎ xiē biàn huà 。

shěn chá xiǎo zǔ suí hòu diào yuè xiào lì 、 zhí bān jì lù 、 chén jiǎn biǎo hé hòu qín tōng zhī ， fā xiàn ān zhuāng shè bèi bìng bú shì nà duàn shí jiān wéi yī fā shēng de shì qíng 。 shàng yī lún liú gǎn chuán bō jiào wéi jí zhōng ， ér shè bèi qǐ yòng hòu de liú gǎn jì xiāng duì píng wěn ； xué xiào hái xiū gǎi le tōng fēng zhì dù ， yāo qiú kè jiān kāi chuāng ， bìng bǎ wǔ xiū hòu de jí zhōng tōng fēng liè rù bān zhǔ rèn jiǎn chá xiàng mù 。 yǔ cǐ tóng shí ， qǐng jià liú chéng cóng zhǐ zhì jià tiáo gǎi wéi xiàn shàng dēng jì ， bù fèn guò qù bèi guī wèi “ shēng bìng ” de quē xí ， rú jīn bèi xì fēn wéi jiā tíng shì wù 、 jiāo tōng yán wù hé tǐ yù bǐ sài 。 yě jiù shì shuō ， quē qín zǒng liàng hé quē qín fēn lèi dōu shòu dào le zhì dù biàn huà de yǐng xiǎng 。 rú guǒ zhǐ bǐ jiào ān zhuāng qián hòu de shù zì ， liú gǎn qiáng dù 、 kāi chuāng tōng fēng hé dēng jì kǒu jìng biàn huì yǔ jìng huà shè bèi de zuò yòng jiū chán zài yì qǐ 。 xiào zhǎng fǎn bó shuō ， shè bèi qǐ yòng hòu kōng qì jiǎn cè yí shàng de kē lì wù dú shù què shí gèng wěn dìng 。 zhōu lán chéng rèn zhè kě yǐ zhī chí “ shè bèi gǎi biàn le bù fèn shì nèi huán jìng ”， què bù néng zhí jiē tuī chū “ zhè zhǒng gǎi biàn dǎo zhì xué shēng gèng shǎo quē qín ”。 cóng kōng qì zhǐ biāo dào jiàn kāng zhèng zhuàng ， zài cóng zhèng zhuàng dào shì fǒu qǐng jià ， zhōng jiān hái gé zhe bìng dú chuán bō 、 gè tǐ tǐ zhì 、 jiā tíng jué dìng hé dēng jì fāng shì děng duō gè huán jié 。

zhēng yì hěn kuài kuò zhǎn dào xiào wài bào lù 。 yán jiū cái liào zhǐ jì lù xué shēng zài xiào qī jiān suǒ zài de bān jí ， què bù zhī dào tā men fàng xué hòu qù le nǎ lǐ 。 yǒu de xué shēng chéng zuò yōng jǐ de gōng gòng jiāo tōng gōng jù ， yǒu de cháng qī cān jiā shì nèi péi xùn ， yǒu de jiā zhōng yǒu rén xī yān ， hái yǒu de zhōu mò pín fán wǎng fǎn yī yuàn zhào gù qīn shǔ 。 zhè xiē jīng lì dōu kě néng yǐng xiǎng hū xī dào jiàn kāng 。 rú guǒ ān zhuāng jìng huà qì hòu qià hǎo yǒu gèng duō jiā tíng jiǎn shǎo le jù jí huó dòng ， quē qín xià jiàng jiù kě néng bèi cuò wù dì guī gōng yú xué xiào shè bèi ； fǎn guò lái ， rú guǒ xué shēng zài xiào wài zāo yù yán zhòng wū rǎn ， shè bèi de shí jì bǎo hù zuò yòng yě kě néng bèi yǎn gài 。 jiā zhǎng dài biǎo dān xīn ， xún wèn jiā tíng huán jìng huì qīn fàn yǐn sī 。 gōng gòng wèi shēng gù wèn yīn cǐ tí chū ， xué xiào bù yīng shōu jí xiáng xì dì zhǐ 、 bìng lì huò jiā tíng chéng yuán shēn fèn ， ér kě yǐ cǎi yòng zì yuàn 、 nì míng de jiǎn duǎn wèn juǎn ， zhǐ jì lù yǔ fēn xī zhí jiē xiāng guān de bào lù lèi bié ， bìng yǔn xǔ tiào guò wèn tí 。 zhè yàng zuò réng wú fǎ wán zhěng huán yuán měi míng xué shēng de shēng huó guǐ jì ， què néng pàn duàn xiào wài yīn sù shì fǒu zài bù tóng bān jí huò bù tóng shí duàn chū xiàn míng xiǎn shī héng 。 zhèng jù de biān jiè bì xū bèi tǎn shuài chéng rèn ， bù néng yīn wèi mǒu xiē xìn xī nán yǐ qǔ dé ， jiù jiǎ zhuāng tā men bù cún zài 。

xiǎo zǔ hái fā xiàn ， shè bèi bìng fēi tóng shí 、 tóng yàng dì yǐng xiǎng suǒ yǒu jiào shì 。 kào jìn cāo chǎng de jiù lóu xiān wán chéng ān zhuāng ， xīn lóu zé yīn diàn lù gǎi zào yán hòu ； yǒu xiē bān jí quán tiān kāi qǐ shè bèi ， yǒu xiē bān jí yīn zào shēng zài kǎo shì shí guān bì ； lǜ xīn gēng huàn yě méi yǒu tǒng yī jì lù 。 zhè zhǒng bù zhěng qí yuán běn bèi shì wéi guǎn lǐ quē xiàn ， què wèi gèng kě kào de bǐ jiào tí gōng le kě néng 。 gù wèn jiàn yì ， bú yào lǒng tǒng dì bǎ quán xiào fēn chéng “ ān zhuāng qián ” hé “ ān zhuāng hòu ”， ér yīng yī jù shí jì qǐ yòng rì qī ， bǐ jiào tóng yī shí qī yǐ jīng qǐ yòng hé shàng wèi qǐ yòng de bān jí ， tóng shí kǎo chá gè bān zài qǐ yòng qián shì fǒu jù yǒu xiāng jìn de quē qín biàn huà qū shì 。 ruò liǎng zǔ zài shè bèi qǐ yòng qián zǒu shì chā yì hěn dà ， hòu lái de chā jù biàn nán yǐ jiě shì wèi shè bèi zào chéng 。 jí shǐ qǐ yòng hòu chū xiàn fēn huà ， yě yào jiǎn chá bān jí wèi zhì 、 nián jí kè chéng 、 xué shēng rén shù hé tōng fēng zhí xíng qíng kuàng 。 duì yú yīn shī gōng ān pái xíng chéng de xiān hòu shùn xù ， xué xiào hái xū pàn duàn tā shì fǒu yǔ jiàn kāng fēng xiǎn yǒu guān ： jiǎ rú quē qín jiào duō de jiù lóu bèi yōu xiān ān zhuāng ， zhí jiē bǐ jiào liǎng zǔ fǎn ér kě néng dī gū shè bèi xiào guǒ ； jiǎ rú guǎn lǐ gèng yán gé de bān jí yōu xiān shǐ yòng ， zé kě néng gāo gū xiào guǒ 。 rèn hé tǒng jì fāng fǎ dōu bù néng tì dài duì shí shī guò chéng de liǎo jiě 。

jīng guò tǎo lùn ， xiào fāng zuò chū liǎng gè jué dìng 。 dì yī ， shān chú xuān chuán gǎo zhōng “ ān zhuāng shè bèi shǐ quē qín jiǎn shǎo ” dí què dìng shuō fǎ ， gǎi wéi “ shè bèi qǐ yòng hòu guān chá dào quē qín xià jiàng ， dàn xiàn yǒu jì lù bù zú yǐ què rèn xià jiàng yóu shè bèi dān dú zào chéng ”。 dì èr ， bǎ shàng wèi wán chéng de ān zhuāng gōng chéng zhuǎn huà wèi yī xiàng yù xiān guī huà de píng gū 。 xué xiào bú huì wèi le yán jiū gù yì ràng xué shēng zhǎng qī chǔ yú jiào chà kōng qì zhōng ， ér shì zài ān quán biāo zhǔn yí zhì de qián tí xià ， àn shī gōng néng lì fēn pī qǐ yòng shè bèi ； gè pī cì cǎi yòng xiāng tóng de qǐng jià fēn lèi 、 tōng fēng yāo qiú 、 lǜ xīn wéi hù biǎo hé shì nèi kōng qì jì lù 。 píng gū fāng àn zài chá kàn jié guǒ qián xiě míng zhǔ yào guān chá zhǐ biāo 、 bǐ jiào shí duàn hé pái chú guī zé ， bì miǎn shì hòu tiāo xuǎn zuì yǒu lì de rì qī huò bìng zhǒng 。 nì míng wèn juǎn zhǐ xún wèn jìn qī gōng gòng jiāo tōng 、 jiā tíng xī yān hé xiào wài mì jí huó dòng děng gài kuò xìn xī ， jiàn kāng shù jù zé yóu xiào yī qù chú xìng míng hòu huì zǒng 。 ruò mǒu duàn shí jiān chū xiàn quán shì xìng liú gǎn biàn huà ， fēn xī shí yīng dān dú biāo jì ， ér bú shì bǎ tā qiāo qiāo bìng rù shè bèi xiào guǒ 。 xiǎo zǔ hái jué dìng tóng shí guān chá kōng qì zhì liàng 、 zhèng zhuàng bào gào yǔ quē qín jì lù ， yīn wèi sān zhě ruò cháo tóng yī fāng xiàng biàn huà ， jiě shì huì gèng lián guàn ； ruò zhǐ yǒu dēng jì shù zì gǎi biàn ， jiù yīng shǒu xiān jiǎn chá zhì dù hé xíng wéi yīn sù 。

jiā zhǎng huì dàng tiān ， xiào zhǎng méi yǒu zhǎn shì yī jù xǐng mù dì chéng gōng kǒu hào ， ér shì jiě shì le guān chá 、 guān lián yǔ yīn guǒ zhī jiān de chā bié 。 tā chéng rèn ， xué xiào zuì chū jí yú zhèng míng cǎi gòu zhí de ， xiǎn xiē bǎ yǒu lì de shí jiān shùn xù dàng chéng chōng fèn zhèng jù 。 jiā zhǎng bìng wèi yīn cǐ fǒu dìng jìng huà shè bèi ， fǎn ér gèng guān xīn xué xiào shì fǒu huì àn shí gēng huàn lǜ xīn 、 chǔ lǐ zào shēng bìng gōng kāi píng gū fāng fǎ 。 zuì zhōng ， shè bèi jì xù shǐ yòng ， tōng fēng zhì dù yě bèi bǎo liú ； cǐ qián de quē qín xià jiàng bèi xiě rù bào gào ， dàn bèi míng què biāo zhù wèi shàng dài jiǎn yàn de xiàn xiàng ， ér bú shì yǐ jīng zhèng shí de gōng xiào 。 zhè ge jié guǒ méi yǒu gěi chū yí gè qīng shuài ér piào liàng de dá àn ， què shǐ hòu xù jué dìng gèng wěn tuǒ ： ruò fēn jiē duàn bǐ jiào xiǎn shì ， shè bèi qǐ yòng hòu shì nèi zhǐ biāo chí xù gǎi shàn ， bìng qiě zài liú gǎn qiáng dù 、 tōng fēng 、 dēng jì kǒu jìng hé xiào wài bào lù dé dào hé lǐ kòng zhì hòu ， xiāng guān quē qín réng chū xiàn yí zhì biàn huà ， yīn guǒ zhǔ zhāng cái huì gèng yǒu shuō fú lì ； ruò zhè zhǒng guān xì xiāo shī ， xué xiào yě yìng jiē shòu shè bèi bìng fēi zhǔ yào yuán yīn 。 yán jǐn jiǎn yàn de yì yì ， bú shì zǔ zhǐ xíng dòng ， ér shì fáng zhǐ yí gè zhí de shí shī de cuò shī bèi bù kě kào de lùn zhèng zhī chēng 。 zhǐ yǒu bǎ tì dài jiě shì 、 cè liáng wù chā hé zhèng jù xiàn zhì gōng kāi bǎi shàng zhuō miàn ， xué xiào cái néng zhī dào zì jǐ jiū jìng gǎi shàn le shén me ， yòu yǒu nǎ xiē biàn huà bù néng jù wèi jǐ gōng 。
translation: In early spring, Qinglan Middle School was preparing to publish its health management summary for the previous semester. A chart produced by the logistics office showed that since air purification equipment had been installed in the teaching buildings, fewer students had been absent because of respiratory discomfort than before the installation. The principal believed that this downward curve was sufficient to show that the equipment had worked and planned to announce at the parent meeting that “the air purification project has significantly reduced student absenteeism.” The statement seemed perfectly logical: air purifiers can filter out some particulate matter, improved indoor air should seemingly reduce the likelihood that students will fall ill or that their symptoms will worsen. However, Zhou Lan, the Chinese language teacher responsible for reviewing the materials, noticed that the chart merely placed two consecutive periods side by side and did not answer a crucial question: if the school had not installed the equipment at that time, would absenteeism have fallen anyway? Causal inference requires precisely this counterfactual situation, which cannot be observed directly. The fact that the installation came first and the decline in absenteeism followed establishes only a consistent time sequence; it does not automatically rule out other explanations. She advised the school to postpone publishing its conclusion and first determine what other changes had occurred during the same period.

The review panel then examined the school calendar, duty logs, morning health-check forms, and notices from the logistics office, and found that installing the equipment was not the only event during that period. The previous wave of influenza transmission had been relatively concentrated, whereas the flu season after the equipment was put into operation was comparatively mild. The school had also revised its ventilation policy, requiring windows to be opened between classes and adding coordinated ventilation after the lunch break to the items homeroom teachers had to inspect. Meanwhile, the leave-request process had changed from paper notes to online registration, and some absences previously classified as “illness” were now divided into family matters, transportation delays, and athletic competitions. In other words, both the total number and the classification of absences were affected by institutional changes. If only the figures before and after installation were compared, influenza intensity, window ventilation, and registration criteria would become entangled with the effects of the purification equipment. The principal countered that particulate-matter readings on the air monitors had indeed become more stable after the equipment went into operation. Zhou Lan acknowledged that this could support the proposition that “the equipment changed some aspects of the indoor environment,” but it could not directly establish that “this change caused students to be absent less often.” Between air-quality indicators and health symptoms, and then between symptoms and the decision to request leave, there are multiple intervening factors, including viral transmission, individual constitution, family decisions, and registration methods.

The debate soon expanded to exposure outside school. The research materials recorded only the classes students attended while at school, not where they went after school. Some students traveled on crowded public transportation, some regularly attended indoor tutoring programs, some lived with smokers, and others frequently visited hospitals on weekends to care for relatives. All of these experiences could affect respiratory health. If more families happened to reduce participation in crowded activities after the purifiers were installed, the decline in absenteeism might be mistakenly credited to the school’s equipment. Conversely, if students encountered severe pollution outside school, the equipment’s actual protective effect might be obscured. Parent representatives worried that asking about home environments would infringe on privacy. The public health adviser therefore proposed that the school should not collect detailed addresses, medical records, or the identities of family members. Instead, it could use a brief, voluntary, anonymous questionnaire that recorded only categories of exposure directly relevant to the analysis and allowed respondents to skip questions. This approach still could not fully reconstruct every student’s daily movements, but it could reveal whether off-campus factors were markedly unbalanced across classes or periods. The limits of the evidence had to be acknowledged candidly; the difficulty of obtaining certain information did not justify pretending that it did not exist.

The panel also found that the equipment did not affect every classroom at the same time or in the same way. Installation was completed first in the old building near the athletic field, while work in the new building was delayed because its electrical system was being upgraded. Some classes kept the equipment running all day, while others turned it off during examinations because of the noise. Filter replacements were not recorded consistently either. This unevenness had originally been regarded as a management failure, but it created an opportunity for more reliable comparisons. The adviser recommended that the school not simply divide the entire campus into “before installation” and “after installation.” Instead, it should use the actual activation dates to compare, within the same period, classes in which the equipment had already been activated with those in which it had not, while also examining whether the classes had shown similar trends in absenteeism before activation. If the two groups had followed substantially different trajectories before the equipment was activated, it would be difficult to attribute any later gap to the equipment. Even if their patterns diverged after activation, the school would still need to examine classroom location, grade-level curricula, student numbers, and compliance with ventilation requirements. The school would also have to determine whether the installation sequence produced by the construction schedule was related to health risks. If the old building, which had higher absenteeism, was given priority, a direct comparison between the two groups might actually underestimate the equipment’s effect. If classes with stricter management received the equipment first, the effect might be overestimated. No statistical method can substitute for understanding how a measure was implemented.

After discussion, the school made two decisions. First, it removed the definitive claim that “installing the equipment reduced absenteeism” from the promotional copy and replaced it with: “A decline in absenteeism was observed after the equipment was activated, but existing records are insufficient to confirm that the decline was caused by the equipment alone.” Second, it turned the unfinished installation project into a prospectively planned evaluation. The school would not deliberately expose students to poorer air for an extended period for research purposes. Instead, while maintaining uniform safety standards, it would activate the equipment in batches according to construction capacity. Every batch would use the same leave classifications, ventilation requirements, filter-maintenance forms, and indoor-air records. Before examining the results, the evaluation plan would specify the primary outcomes, comparison periods, and exclusion rules, thereby preventing the retrospective selection of the most favorable dates or illnesses. The anonymous questionnaire would ask only for general information about recent use of public transportation, smoking in the home, and participation in crowded off-campus activities, while the school doctor would aggregate health data after removing names. If a citywide change in influenza occurred during any period, it would be identified separately in the analysis rather than quietly folded into the equipment’s effect. The panel also decided to monitor air quality, symptom reports, and absence records together, because an explanation would be more coherent if all three changed in the same direction. If only the registration figures changed, institutional and behavioral factors should be examined first.

On the day of the parent meeting, the principal did not display an eye-catching slogan proclaiming success. Instead, he explained the differences among observation, association, and causation. He acknowledged that the school had initially been so eager to prove that the purchase was worthwhile that it had nearly treated a favorable sequence in time as sufficient evidence. The parents did not reject the purification equipment as a result. Instead, they became more concerned about whether the school would replace the filters on schedule, address the noise, and make its evaluation methods public. Ultimately, the equipment remained in use, and the ventilation policy was retained as well. The earlier decline in absenteeism was included in the report, but it was clearly labeled as a phenomenon still requiring verification rather than a proven benefit. This outcome did not provide a hasty but appealing answer, yet it made subsequent decisions more prudent. A causal claim would become more persuasive only if phased comparisons showed sustained improvement in indoor indicators after the equipment was activated and absenteeism related to those indicators still changed consistently after influenza intensity, ventilation, registration criteria, and off-campus exposure had been reasonably controlled. If that relationship disappeared, the school should also accept that the equipment was not the primary cause. The purpose of rigorous testing is not to prevent action, but to prevent a worthwhile measure from being supported by unreliable reasoning. Only by openly placing alternative explanations, measurement errors, and evidentiary limitations on the table can the school determine what it has actually improved and which changes it cannot claim as its own achievement.

统计、分类或解释数据时采用的统一标准。
多种因素混合在一起，难以分辨各自作用。

概括而不具体，缺少细致区分。
原本相近的对象逐渐出现不同的发展趋势。

对实际程度、价值或作用估计得过高。

grammar.example: 后勤处制作的图表显示，自从教学楼安装空气净化设备后，因呼吸道不适而缺勤的学生比安装前少了。

grammar.explanation: 表示让步关系，强调即便前一条件成立，后一项要求或结论仍然不变。
grammar.example: 即使启用后出现分化，也要检查班级位置、年级课程、学生人数和通风执行情况。

grammar.explanation: 通过否定前一种理解并肯定后一种理解，突出真正的目的、性质或原因。
grammar.example: 严谨检验的意义，不是阻止行动，而是防止一个值得实施的措施被不可靠的论证支撑。

articles.title: 一场被暂停发布的词汇实验：短视频真的带来了进步吗
articles.summary: 江州市明川中学的一项阶段性报告认为，使用短视频学习的学生词汇测验进步更快。校方在准备推广课程时发现，分组方式、额外练习、测验重复和退出情况都可能影响结果。项目组随后改变研究方案，通过重新分组、统一学习条件和延迟测验，检验短视频与词汇增长之间是否存在真正的因果关系。
articles.topic: 一场被暂停发布的词汇实验：短视频真的带来了进步吗
paragraphs: 六月初，位于江州市南岸区的明川中学举行学期课程评审会。会上，语文教研组展示了一份关于短视频学习的阶段报告。报告称，参加短视频词汇课程的学生在测验中进步较快，因此建议学校下学期把这种课程推广到整个年级。所谓短视频课程，是指教师把词语解释、使用场景和辨析题制作成几分钟的视频，学生可在晚自习前用手机或平板观看。报告一公布，许多教师感到振奋：传统词汇课常被学生嫌枯燥，而视频中的情境、声音和字幕似乎更能吸引注意。负责技术采购的副校长甚至提出，应尽快购买拍摄设备，以免错过课程改革的时机。然而，评审组成员周岚没有立即同意。她指出，报告只能证明使用短视频的学生进步较快，却不能直接证明进步是短视频造成的。两句话表面相近，逻辑含义却截然不同。如果这一差别没有被澄清，学校就可能把相关关系误当成因果关系，并据此作出成本不低的决定。

周岚首先查看了学生进入课程的过程。原来，项目开始时并没有随机分组，而是由学生自愿报名。愿意参加短视频课程的人，大多本来就对新工具感兴趣，也更愿意利用零散时间学习。没有报名的学生则继续上普通词汇课，其中有些人还要参加体育训练，课后可支配时间较少。这样一来，两组学生在课程开始之前就可能存在学习动机、时间安排和数字设备使用习惯等差异。即使短视频本身毫无作用，积极报名的学生也可能因为更勤奋而取得较大进步。更值得注意的是，视频组的教师建立了线上讨论区，每晚回答学生提问；普通组教师却只在课堂上集中讲解。阶段报告把两组成绩变化都归因于视频形式，却没有区分视频、答疑和练习频率各自产生的影响。教研组负责人起初认为，只要两组入学时的词汇成绩接近，就可以排除这些问题。周岚解释说，起点成绩接近并不等于其他条件相同，更不意味着后来的差异只来自短视频。一次测验无法完整反映注意力、坚持程度和课外投入，而这些因素恰好可能同时影响课程选择与学习结果。

评审组随后检查了测验。前后两次测试虽然更换了题目顺序，却反复考查视频里出现过的例句。视频组学生已经在画面和字幕中多次见到这些句子，因而更容易凭熟悉感作答。这能说明他们记住了视频内容，却未必说明其总体词汇量得到扩展。如果学生只会识别原句中的词语，换到新闻评论、说明文或正式书面表达中便无法理解，那么所谓进步只是对特定材料的适应。此外，阶段报告只统计了完成两次测验的学生，没有充分说明中途退出者的情况。普通组有学生因训练和请假未参加后测，视频组也有人观看几次后不再登录。若留下来的恰好是更有毅力、成绩更稳定的人，最终比较就会高估课程效果。面对这些质疑，项目负责人担心推迟发布会削弱教师改革的热情。他强调，短视频至少提高了课堂参与度，没有必要用过于严格的标准否定实践经验。周岚并未否认这种可能性。她认为，参与度提升本身值得观察，但不能用它替代词汇增长，更不能因为一种工具受欢迎，就断言它是成绩变化的原因。争论的核心不是是否支持创新，而是学校愿意用什么证据支撑推广决定。

经过讨论，校长决定暂停公布“短视频提高词汇量”的结论，也暂缓设备采购，但允许课程继续试行。教研组重新设计了下一阶段的检验方案。学生在知情并同意参加后，由电脑在同一年级内随机安排到两种课程：一组观看短视频，另一组阅读内容相同、学习时间相近的图文材料。两组都由同一批教师轮流负责，获得相同次数的答疑和练习提醒，避免把教师投入误认为媒介效果。研究人员事先确定主要观察结果，不再根据测验表现临时挑选最有利的指标。新测验尽量使用课程中没有原样出现的语境，既检查词义识别，也要求学生在短文中推断含义、辨析近义词并完成恰当表达。为了区别短期记忆与较稳定的掌握，学校还安排延迟测验，不只在课程结束后立即检查。对于缺席或退出的学生，项目组记录原因，并尽量保留其已产生的学习信息，而不是悄悄从结果中删除。这样的设计不能消除一切误差，却能使两组之间最重要的系统差异集中在学习媒介上，从而更接近对因果关系的检验。

新方案实施后，教师又遇到一个现实困难：学生会互相转发视频，图文组也可能在课外观看同样的内容。如果强行禁止交流，研究环境固然更整齐，却会偏离真实校园生活。项目组没有假装这种干扰不存在，而是通过学习日志和平台记录了解实际接触情况，并分别回答两个问题。第一个问题是，把学生安排进短视频课程，会不会在现实条件下改善词汇表现；第二个问题是，学生实际观看更多视频，是否会获得更多收益。前者保留最初分组进行比较，较少受到学生主动选择的干扰；后者则必须谨慎，因为观看次数高的人可能本来就更自律。项目组还提醒教师，不要只关注平均表现。有些基础较弱的学生需要较慢的解释速度，连续出现的字幕反而增加理解负担；有些基础较好的学生则认为视频节奏太慢，更喜欢直接检索词义。这些差异可以帮助学校调整课程，却不应在看到结果以后随意切分群体，再把偶然出现的差别包装成确定规律。任何补充发现都应被视为后续检验的线索，而不是立即宣传的新结论。

学期结束时，明川中学没有召开原计划中的成果发布会，而是在教师会上提交了一份措辞克制的复核说明。说明没有把短视频描述成必然有效的教学工具，而是明确区分了即时测验、迁移能力、长期保持和学习意愿。校方最终决定保留短视频资源，但不以它全面替代阅读讲解，也不把学生的观看次数作为硬性考核。教师可在词义容易借助场景呈现时使用视频，在需要细读、比较和反复推敲时提供文字材料；后续是否扩大投入，则依据重新设计的检验结果和实际教学成本决定。这场争论带来的结论并不是“短视频无效”，也不是“只有随机实验才值得相信”，而是一个更审慎的判断原则：当人们声称某种学习方式导致成绩提高时，必须追问比较对象是否公平、其他条件是否一致、测量是否真正对应目标，以及缺失信息会把结果推向何方。承认现有证据的边界，并不妨碍创新；相反，它能防止学校把一时的热度当成稳定效果，让有限的时间和经费用在经得起检验的改进上。
pinyin: liù yuè chū ， wèi yú jiāng zhōu shì nán àn qū de míng chuān zhōng xué jǔ xíng xué qī kè chéng píng shěn huì 。 huì shàng ， yǔ wén jiào yán zǔ zhǎn shì le yī fèn guān yú duǎn shì pín xué xí de jiē duàn bào gào 。 bào gào chēng ， cān jiā duǎn shì pín cí huì kè chéng de xué shēng zài cè yàn zhōng jìn bù jiào kuài ， yīn cǐ jiàn yì xué xiào xià xué qī bǎ zhè zhǒng kè chéng tuī guǎng dào zhěng gè nián jí 。 suǒ wèi duǎn shì pín kè chéng ， shì zhǐ jiào shī bǎ cí yǔ jiě shì 、 shǐ yòng chǎng jǐng hé biàn xī tí zhì zuò chéng jǐ fēn zhōng de shì pín ， xué shēng kě zài wǎn zì xí qián yòng shǒu jī huò píng bǎn guān kàn 。 bào gào yī gōng bù ， xǔ duō jiào shī gǎn dào zhèn fèn ： chuán tǒng cí huì kè cháng bèi xué shēng xián kū zào ， ér shì pín zhōng de qíng jìng 、 shēng yīn hé zì mù sì hū gèng néng xī yǐn zhù yì 。 fù zé jì shù cǎi gòu de fù xiào zhǎng shèn zhì tí chū ， yīng jǐn kuài gòu mǎi pāi shè shè bèi ， yǐ miǎn cuò guò kè chéng gǎi gé de shí jī 。 rán ér ， píng shěn zǔ chéng yuán zhōu lán méi yǒu lì jí tóng yì 。 tā zhǐ chū ， bào gào zhǐ néng zhèng míng shǐ yòng duǎn shì pín de xué shēng jìn bù jiào kuài ， què bù néng zhí jiē zhèng míng jìn bù shì duǎn shì pín zào chéng de 。 liǎng jù huà biǎo miàn xiàng jìn ， luó jí hán yì què jié rán bù tóng 。 rú guǒ zhè yī chā bié méi yǒu bèi chéng qīng ， xué xiào jiù kě néng bǎ xiāng guān guān xì wù dàng chéng yīn guǒ guān xì ， bìng jù cǐ zuò chū chéng běn bù dī de jué dìng 。

zhōu lán shǒu xiān chá kàn le xué shēng jìn rù kè chéng de guò chéng 。 yuán lái ， xiàng mù kāi shǐ shí bìng méi yǒu suí jī fēn zǔ ， ér shì yóu xué shēng zì yuàn bào míng 。 yuàn yì cān jiā duǎn shì pín kè chéng de rén ， dà duō běn lái jiù duì xīn gōng jù gǎn xìng qù ， yě gèng yuàn yì lì yòng líng sǎn shí jiān xué xí 。 méi yǒu bào míng de xué shēng zé jì xù shàng pǔ tōng cí huì kè ， qí zhōng yǒu xiē rén hái yào cān jiā tǐ yù xùn liàn ， kè hòu kě zhī pèi shí jiān jiào shǎo 。 zhè yàng yī lái ， liǎng zǔ xué shēng zài kè chéng kāi shǐ zhī qián jiù kě néng cún zài xué xí dòng jī 、 shí jiān ān pái hé shù zì shè bèi shǐ yòng xí guàn děng chà yì 。 jí shǐ duǎn shì pín běn shēn háo wú zuò yòng ， jī jí bào míng de xué shēng yě kě néng yīn wèi gèng qín fèn ér qǔ dé jiào dà jìn bù 。 gèng zhí de zhù yì de shì ， shì pín zǔ de jiào shī jiàn lì le xiàn shàng tǎo lùn qū ， měi wǎn huí dá xué shēng tí wèn ； pǔ tōng zǔ jiào shī què zhǐ zài kè táng shàng jí zhōng jiǎng jiě 。 jiē duàn bào gào bǎ liǎng zǔ chéng jì biàn huà dōu guī yīn yú shì pín xíng shì ， què méi yǒu qū fēn shì pín 、 dá yí hé liàn xí pín lǜ gè zì chǎn shēng de yǐng xiǎng 。 jiào yán zǔ fù zé rén qǐ chū rèn wéi ， zhǐ yào liǎng zǔ rù xué shí de cí huì chéng jì jiē jìn ， jiù kě yǐ pái chú zhè xiē wèn tí 。 zhōu lán jiě shì shuō ， qǐ diǎn chéng jì jiē jìn bìng bù děng yú qí tā tiáo jiàn xiāng tóng ， gèng bù yì wèi zhe hòu lái de chā yì zhǐ lái zì duǎn shì pín 。 yī cì cè yàn wú fǎ wán zhěng fǎn yìng zhù yì lì 、 jiān chí chéng dù hé kè wài tóu rù ， ér zhè xiē yīn sù qià hǎo kě néng tóng shí yǐng xiǎng kè chéng xuǎn zé yǔ xué xí jié guǒ 。

píng shěn zǔ suí hòu jiǎn chá le cè yàn 。 qián hòu liǎng cì cè shì suī rán gēng huàn le tí mù shùn xù ， què fǎn fù kǎo chá shì pín lǐ chū xiàn guò de lì jù 。 shì pín zǔ xué shēng yǐ jīng zài huà miàn hé zì mù zhōng duō cì jiàn dào zhè xiē jù zi ， yīn ér gèng róng yì píng shú xī gǎn zuò dá 。 zhè néng shuō míng tā men jì zhù le shì pín nèi róng ， què wèi bì shuō míng qí zǒng tǐ cí huì liàng dé dào kuò zhǎn 。 rú guǒ xué shēng zhǐ huì shí bié yuán jù zhōng de cí yǔ ， huàn dào xīn wén píng lùn 、 shuō míng wén huò zhèng shì shū miàn biǎo dá zhōng biàn wú fǎ lǐ jiě ， nà me suǒ wèi jìn bù zhǐ shì duì tè dìng cái liào de shì yìng 。 cǐ wài ， jiē duàn bào gào zhǐ tǒng jì le wán chéng liǎng cì cè yàn de xué shēng ， méi yǒu chōng fèn shuō míng zhōng tú tuì chū zhě de qíng kuàng 。 pǔ tōng zǔ yǒu xué shēng yīn xùn liàn hé qǐng jià wèi cān jiā hòu cè ， shì pín zǔ yě yǒu rén guān kàn jǐ cì hòu bù zài dēng lù 。 ruò liú xià lái de qià hǎo shì gèng yǒu yì lì 、 chéng jì gèng wěn dìng de rén ， zuì zhōng bǐ jiào jiù huì gāo gū kè chéng xiào guǒ 。 miàn duì zhè xiē zhì yí ， xiàng mù fù zé rén dān xīn tuī chí fā bù huì xuē ruò jiào shī gǎi gé de rè qíng 。 tā qiáng diào ， duǎn shì pín zhì shǎo tí gāo le kè táng cān yù dù ， méi yǒu bì yào yòng guò yú yán gé de biāo zhǔn fǒu dìng shí jiàn jīng yàn 。 zhōu lán bìng wèi fǒu rèn zhè zhǒng kě néng xìng 。 tā rèn wéi ， cān yù dù tí shēng běn shēn zhí de guān chá ， dàn bù néng yòng tā tì dài cí huì zēng zhǎng ， gèng bù néng yīn wèi yī zhǒng gōng jù shòu huān yíng ， jiù duàn yán tā shì chéng jì biàn huà de yuán yīn 。 zhēng lùn de hé xīn bú shì shì fǒu zhī chí chuàng xīn ， ér shì xué xiào yuàn yì yòng shén me zhèng jù zhī chēng tuī guǎng jué dìng 。

jīng guò tǎo lùn ， xiào zhǎng jué dìng zàn tíng gōng bù “ duǎn shì pín tí gāo cí huì liàng ” de jié lùn ， yě zàn huǎn shè bèi cǎi gòu ， dàn yǔn xǔ kè chéng jì xù shì xíng 。 jiào yán zǔ chóng xīn shè jì le xià yī jiē duàn de jiǎn yàn fāng àn 。 xué shēng zài zhī qíng bìng tóng yì cān jiā hòu ， yóu diàn nǎo zài tóng yī nián jí nèi suí jī ān pái dào liǎng zhǒng kè chéng ： yī zǔ guān kàn duǎn shì pín ， lìng yī zǔ yuè dú nèi róng xiāng tóng 、 xué xí shí jiān xiāng jìn de tú wén cái liào 。 liǎng zǔ dōu yóu tóng yī pī jiào shī lún liú fù zé ， huò dé xiāng tóng cì shù de dá yí hé liàn xí tí xǐng ， bì miǎn bǎ jiào shī tóu rù wù rèn wèi méi jiè xiào guǒ 。 yán jiū rén yuán shì xiān què dìng zhǔ yào guān chá jié guǒ ， bù zài gēn jù cè yàn biǎo xiàn lín shí tiāo xuǎn zuì yǒu lì de zhǐ biāo 。 xīn cè yàn jǐn liàng shǐ yòng kè chéng zhōng méi yǒu yuán yàng chū xiàn de yǔ jìng ， jì jiǎn chá cí yì shí bié ， yě yāo qiú xué shēng zài duǎn wén zhōng tuī duàn hán yì 、 biàn xī jìn yì cí bìng wán chéng qià dàng biǎo dá 。 wèi le qū bié duǎn qī jì yì yǔ jiào wěn dìng de zhǎng wò ， xué xiào hái ān pái yán chí cè yàn ， bù zhǐ zài kè chéng jié shù hòu lì jí jiǎn chá 。 duì yú quē xí huò tuì chū de xué shēng ， xiàng mù zǔ jì lù yuán yīn ， bìng jǐn liàng bǎo liú qí yǐ chǎn shēng de xué xí xìn xī ， ér bú shì qiāo qiāo cóng jié guǒ zhōng shān chú 。 zhè yàng de shè jì bù néng xiāo chú yī qiè wù chā ， què néng shǐ liǎng zǔ zhī jiān zuì zhòng yào de xì tǒng chā yì jí zhōng zài xué xí méi jiè shàng ， cóng ér gèng jiē jìn duì yīn guǒ guān xì de jiǎn yàn 。

xīn fāng àn shí shī hòu ， jiào shī yòu yù dào yí gè xiàn shí kùn nán ： xué shēng huì hù xiāng zhuǎn fā shì pín ， tú wén zǔ yě kě néng zài kè wài guān kàn tóng yàng de nèi róng 。 rú guǒ qiáng xíng jìn zhǐ jiāo liú ， yán jiū huán jìng gù rán gèng zhěng qí ， què huì piān lí zhēn shí xiào yuán shēng huó 。 xiàng mù zǔ méi yǒu jiǎ zhuāng zhè zhǒng gān rǎo bù cún zài ， ér shì tōng guò xué xí rì zhì hé píng tái jì lù liǎo jiě shí jì jiē chù qíng kuàng ， bìng fēn bié huí dá liǎng gè wèn tí 。 dì yí gè wèn tí shì ， bǎ xué shēng ān pái jìn duǎn shì pín kè chéng ， huì bú huì zài xiàn shí tiáo jiàn xià gǎi shàn cí huì biǎo xiàn ； dì èr gè wèn tí shì ， xué shēng shí jì guān kàn gèng duō shì pín ， shì fǒu huì huò dé gèng duō shōu yì 。 qián zhě bǎo liú zuì chū fēn zǔ jìn xíng bǐ jiào ， jiào shǎo shòu dào xué shēng zhǔ dòng xuǎn zé de gān rǎo ； hòu zhě zé bì xū jǐn shèn ， yīn wèi guān kàn cì shù gāo de rén kě néng běn lái jiù gèng zì lǜ 。 xiàng mù zǔ hái tí xǐng jiào shī ， bú yào zhǐ guān zhù píng jūn biǎo xiàn 。 yǒu xiē jī chǔ jiào ruò de xué shēng xū yào jiào màn de jiě shì sù dù ， lián xù chū xiàn de zì mù fǎn ér zēng jiā lǐ jiě fù dān ； yǒu xiē jī chǔ jiào hǎo de xué shēng zé rèn wéi shì pín jié zòu tài màn ， gèng xǐ huān zhí jiē jiǎn suǒ cí yì 。 zhè xiē chā yì kě yǐ bāng zhù xué xiào tiáo zhěng kè chéng ， què bù yīng zài kàn dào jié guǒ yǐ hòu suí yì qiē fēn qún tǐ ， zài bǎ ǒu rán chū xiàn de chā bié bāo zhuāng chéng què dìng guī lǜ 。 rèn hé bǔ chōng fā xiàn dōu yīng bèi shì wéi hòu xù jiǎn yàn de xiàn suǒ ， ér bú shì lì jí xuān chuán de xīn jié lùn 。

xué qī jié shù shí ， míng chuān zhōng xué méi yǒu zhào kāi yuán jì huà zhōng de chéng guǒ fā bù huì ， ér shì zài jiào shī huì shàng tí jiāo le yī fèn cuò cí kè zhì de fù hé shuō míng 。 shuō míng méi yǒu bǎ duǎn shì pín miáo shù chéng bì rán yǒu xiào de jiào xué gōng jù ， ér shì míng què qū fēn le jí shí cè yàn 、 qiān yí néng lì 、 cháng qī bǎo chí hé xué xí yì yuàn 。 xiào fāng zuì zhōng jué dìng bǎo liú duǎn shì pín zī yuán ， dàn bù yǐ tā quán miàn tì dài yuè dú jiǎng jiě ， yě bù bǎ xué shēng de guān kàn cì shù zuò wéi yìng xìng kǎo hé 。 jiào shī kě zài cí yì róng yì jiè zhù chǎng jǐng chéng xiàn shí shǐ yòng shì pín ， zài xū yào xì dú 、 bǐ jiào hé fǎn fù tuī qiāo shí tí gōng wén zì cái liào ； hòu xù shì fǒu kuò dà tóu rù ， zé yī jù chóng xīn shè jì de jiǎn yàn jié guǒ hé shí jì jiào xué chéng běn jué dìng 。 zhè chǎng zhēng lùn dài lái de jié lùn bìng bú shì “ duǎn shì pín wú xiào ”， yě bú shì “ zhǐ yǒu suí jī shí yàn cái zhí de xiāng xìn ”， ér shì yí gè gèng shěn shèn de pàn duàn yuán zé ： dāng rén men shēng chēng mǒu zhǒng xué xí fāng shì dǎo zhì chéng jì tí gāo shí ， bì xū zhuī wèn bǐ jiào duì xiàng shì fǒu gōng píng 、 qí tā tiáo jiàn shì fǒu yí zhì 、 cè liáng shì fǒu zhēn zhèng duì yìng mù biāo ， yǐ jí quē shī xìn xī huì bǎ jié guǒ tuī xiàng hé fāng 。 chéng rèn xiàn yǒu zhèng jù de biān jiè ， bìng bù fáng ài chuàng xīn ； xiāng fǎn ， tā néng fáng zhǐ xué xiào bǎ yī shí de rè dù dàng chéng wěn dìng xiào guǒ ， ràng yǒu xiàn de shí jiān hé jīng fèi yòng zài jīng dé qǐ jiǎn yàn de gǎi jìn shàng 。
translation: In early June, Mingchuan Middle School, located in Nan'an District of Jiangzhou City, held its semester curriculum review meeting. At the meeting, the Chinese language teaching research group presented an interim report on learning through short videos. The report stated that students who participated in the short-video vocabulary course improved more rapidly on tests and therefore recommended that the school expand the course to the entire grade the following semester. The short-video course involved teachers making videos several minutes long that explained words, presented contexts in which they were used, and included questions distinguishing between similar terms. Students could watch them on a phone or tablet before evening study sessions. After the report was released, many teachers felt encouraged: students often found traditional vocabulary lessons dull, whereas the situations, sounds, and captions in the videos seemed better able to hold their attention. The vice principal responsible for technology procurement even proposed purchasing filming equipment as soon as possible so that the school would not miss the opportunity for curriculum reform. However, Zhou Lan, a member of the review panel, did not immediately agree. She pointed out that the report could prove only that students using short videos improved more rapidly, not that the short videos had directly caused the improvement. The two statements appeared similar but had entirely different logical implications. Unless this distinction was clarified, the school might mistake correlation for causation and make a costly decision on that basis.

Zhou Lan first examined how students had entered the course. It turned out that when the project began, students had not been randomly assigned to groups but had enrolled voluntarily. Most of those willing to join the short-video course were already interested in new tools and more willing to use spare moments for study. Students who did not enroll continued taking ordinary vocabulary lessons, and some of them also had to attend sports training, leaving them with less discretionary time after class. As a result, the two groups might already have differed in learning motivation, time management, and habits of using digital devices before the course began. Even if the short videos themselves had no effect, the students who actively enrolled might still have made greater progress because they worked harder. More importantly, the teachers of the video group had created an online discussion forum and answered students' questions every evening, whereas the teachers of the ordinary group provided explanations only during class. The interim report attributed the changes in both groups' scores to the video format without separating the respective effects of the videos, question answering, and frequency of practice. At first, the head of the teaching research group believed that these problems could be ruled out as long as the two groups had similar vocabulary scores at the outset. Zhou Lan explained that similar starting scores did not mean that all other conditions were the same, much less that later differences resulted solely from the short videos. A single test could not fully capture attention, persistence, or extracurricular effort, yet these very factors might affect both course selection and learning outcomes.

The review panel then examined the tests. Although the order of the questions had been changed between the pretest and post-test, both repeatedly assessed example sentences that had appeared in the videos. Students in the video group had already seen these sentences many times in the images and captions, making it easier for them to answer on the basis of familiarity. This could show that they remembered the video content, but it did not necessarily show that their overall vocabulary had expanded. If students could recognize words only in the original sentences but could not understand them in news commentary, expository writing, or formal written expression, then the supposed improvement merely reflected adaptation to specific materials. In addition, the interim report counted only students who completed both tests and did not adequately explain what had happened to those who dropped out along the way. Some students in the ordinary group missed the post-test because of training or leave, while some in the video group stopped logging in after watching only a few times. If those who remained happened to be more persistent and to have more stable grades, the final comparison would overestimate the course's effect. Faced with these questions, the project leader worried that postponing the presentation would weaken teachers' enthusiasm for reform. He emphasized that short videos had at least increased classroom participation and that there was no need to dismiss practical experience by applying excessively strict standards. Zhou Lan did not deny that possibility. She believed that increased participation was itself worth observing, but it could not be used as a substitute for vocabulary growth, nor could the popularity of a tool justify concluding that it caused the change in scores. The central issue in the debate was not whether to support innovation, but what evidence the school was willing to use to support its decision to expand the program.

After discussion, the principal decided not to publish the conclusion that short videos increased vocabulary and also postponed the equipment purchase, while allowing the course trial to continue. The teaching research group redesigned the evaluation plan for the next stage. After being informed and consenting to participate, students were randomly assigned by computer within the same grade to one of two courses: one group watched short videos, while the other read illustrated text materials with the same content and a similar study duration. Both groups were taught in rotation by the same pool of teachers and received the same number of question-and-answer sessions and practice reminders, preventing differences in teacher effort from being mistaken for effects of the medium. The researchers specified the primary outcomes in advance rather than selecting the most favorable indicators after seeing the test results. The new tests used contexts that had not appeared verbatim in the course materials whenever possible. They assessed not only recognition of word meanings but also required students to infer meanings in short passages, distinguish between synonyms, and produce appropriate expressions. To distinguish short-term memory from more stable mastery, the school also scheduled a delayed test rather than assessing students only immediately after the course ended. For students who were absent or withdrew, the project team recorded the reasons and retained as much of their existing learning data as possible instead of quietly removing them from the results. This design could not eliminate every source of error, but it could concentrate the most important systematic difference between the two groups on the learning medium itself, thereby coming closer to testing a causal relationship.

After the new plan was implemented, the teachers encountered another practical difficulty: students shared videos with one another, so members of the illustrated-text group might also watch the same content outside class. Strictly prohibiting communication would make the research setting more orderly, but it would also move it away from real school life. Rather than pretending that this interference did not exist, the project team used learning logs and platform records to determine what content students had actually accessed and addressed two questions separately. The first was whether assigning students to the short-video course would improve their vocabulary performance under real-world conditions. The second was whether students who actually watched more videos would obtain greater benefits. For the first question, comparisons retained the original group assignments and were therefore less affected by students' own choices. The second required caution because students who watched more frequently might already have been more self-disciplined. The project team also reminded teachers not to focus solely on average performance. Some students with weaker foundations needed explanations delivered at a slower pace, and continuously appearing captions instead increased their difficulty in understanding. Some students with stronger foundations thought the videos were too slow and preferred to look up word meanings directly. These differences could help the school adjust the course, but groups should not be divided arbitrarily after the results were known, with chance differences then presented as established patterns. Any supplementary findings should be treated as leads for subsequent testing rather than as new conclusions to be publicized immediately.

At the end of the semester, Mingchuan Middle School did not hold the originally planned presentation of results. Instead, it submitted a cautiously worded review statement at a teachers' meeting. The statement did not describe short videos as an inevitably effective teaching tool but explicitly distinguished among immediate test performance, transfer ability, long-term retention, and willingness to learn. The school ultimately decided to retain its short-video resources but not to use them as a complete replacement for reading and explanation or to make the number of videos students watched a mandatory assessment criterion. Teachers could use videos when word meanings could readily be conveyed through situations, while providing written materials when close reading, comparison, and repeated consideration were needed. Whether to expand investment later would depend on the results of the redesigned evaluation and the actual cost of instruction. The conclusion of the debate was neither that short videos were ineffective nor that only randomized experiments deserved to be trusted. Instead, it produced a more cautious principle of judgment: when people claim that a particular method of learning causes higher scores, they must ask whether the comparison is fair, whether other conditions are consistent, whether the measurements truly correspond to the objective, and in which direction missing information might push the results. Acknowledging the limits of existing evidence does not obstruct innovation. On the contrary, it can prevent schools from mistaking temporary enthusiasm for a stable effect and allow their limited time and funding to be devoted to improvements that can withstand scrutiny.

vocabulary.meaning: 对方案、成果或资格进行审查并作出评价。
单调乏味，缺少趣味。
彼此差异非常明显，完全不一样。
把含混或容易误解的问题解释清楚。
两个变量之间存在共同变化，但不一定具有因果联系。
一种现象作为原因导致另一种现象发生的关系。
可以由个人自行安排和使用的时间。
把某种结果解释为由某个因素造成。
因为曾经接触过而产生的熟悉体验。
把已经掌握的知识或技能应用到新情境中的能力。
长期坚持完成目标、不轻易放弃的意志。
暂时推迟，不立即进行。
由信息呈现或传播媒介本身产生的影响。
主动约束和管理自己的行为。
反复思考、比较并斟酌内容是否恰当。
使用语言谨慎而有分寸，不过度夸大结论。
按照不可变通的明确标准进行评价。
周密而谨慎，不轻率作出判断。

grammar.explanation: 表示让步关系，先提出一种假设情况，再说明即便该情况成立，后面的结果仍然可能出现。
grammar.example: 即使短视频本身毫无作用，积极报名的学生也可能因为更勤奋而取得较大进步。

grammar.explanation: 用于否定一种理解，并突出真正需要关注的内容。
grammar.example: 争论的核心不是是否支持创新，而是学校愿意用什么证据支撑推广决定。

grammar.explanation: 表示两个方面同时存在，强调新测验兼顾多种能力。
grammar.example: 新测验尽量使用课程中没有原样出现的语境，既检查词义识别，也要求学生在短文中推断含义、辨析近义词并完成恰当表达。
